notes.title: Update 1.20.0 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

1.20.0 is finally here with some big new features!

With this update we have added the [b]Skin & Dye system[/b], which currently offers 2 unlockable skins for each class, and 8 unique dyes for each class - 4 of which are unlocked from the start. We plan to expand on this system with more skins and dyes being added in the future, too!

Tinka's Domain also got a makeover and is now much larger and has some space reserved for [i]Secret Future Things[/i], as well as having a brand new soundtrack that makes it a very atmospheric place to hang out and theorycraft :-)

Speaking of theorycrafting - several sets have been buffed and many items and runes got tweaked, changed, and a few even got replaced with something more suitable (or usable). There's also a few [b]new items and runes[/b] for you to discover!

There's also a new Death Recap system, which is a log of what happened to your character before it died, which you can read to figure out what defenses you may need to improve etc.

Along with that comes also a bunch of QoL improvements and fixes, such as being able to lower the amount of particles from spells & effects, always loading in to the last visited hub (Chronicon or Tinka's) when loading up your character, and more.

Last but not least, Endless Tier Boosting is now adaptive and will let you boost more tiers the further you get, up to a maximum of 10 tiers per run!


And now we begin work on the [b]first DLC[/b] which will expand upon the endgame content quite a bit. We will have more info to share as things progress, but you can refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/2962769352266207429/]roadmap[/url] to see the overall plans for the rest of the year.

And as you may have noticed, this text is full of "we" and not "I" - that's because as of a few months ago, my fiancée has officially joined Subworld and the development of Chronicon! She's been with us the entire way since before the Early Access launch in 2015, giving me feedback and painstakingly helping me test things. And as of this year she's been taking on larger responsibilities like world & system design! We've worked on some pretty cool things lately, which you'll see in the first DLC, later this year! I'll remain the outward voice but you'll probably see her pop up on the forums or in support email from time to time under the nickname "Marruu". Yes, the same as Commander Marruu from Act  2 :-) 

Anyway, please give her a warm welcome!


And, as always, thank you for the bug reports, suggestions, comments, and fun discussions!

That's all for now, I hope you enjoy the update!

https://youtu.be/688oCpiPnXo

Here are the full notes of this update:

[h1]1.20.0[/h1]
[b]Big Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Tinka's Domain! Complete with a brand new music track for it.
[*]Added Skin & Dye system (Wardrobe) - access it by interacting with the new red Wardrobe in Tinka's Domain or The Chronicon (near your stash).
[*]Added 2 additional skins for each class, unlockable via story and endgame progression on a per-class basis (account-wide unlock).
[*]Added 32 dyes: 8 per class - 4 base dyes that are always available, and 4 dyes that drop from bosses randomly (account-wide unlock).
[*]Note: Your character is no longer automatically dyed based on skill point distribution - the new dye system overwrites this! But the base 4 dyes are very similar to the old system.
[*]Added a Death Recap system! Click the new Death Recap button after you've died to see the last 25 changes to your health, including detailed information such as damage element, direct/indirect, absorbs, healing, and more.
[/list]
[b]Linux:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now (finally) up to date!
[/list]
[b]Endgame Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]For every 50 Endless Tiers beaten, the Boost Tier boosts and additional Tier, ie at T50 you can boost 4 at a time, at 100 5 at a time, etc. Caps at 10 at a time.
[/list]
[b]QoL Stuff:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stash and Dummies are now marked on map in both Tinka's Domain and the Chronicon.
[*]Tinka's Domain and The Chronicon maps no longer gets fogged up (always fully explored).
[*]Loading a character now puts you in your last visited hub (Tinka's Domain or The Chronicon) rather than always in The Chronicon.
[*]Added a new scale setting for the item, spell, and tooltip cards. (so it can be scaled independently from your inventory scale setting)

[*]Cataclysm set: 3) Stalagmites instead form in a nova around the Berserker, releasing after 2 seconds to deal 300% of the total built up damage of all Stalagmites. Each hit of Quake increases the damage the Stalagmite nova deals by 15% to that target.

notes.title: Update 1.11.0 is live with fixes, tweaks, and Spanish language!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update mainly focuses on fixing issues and improving QoL, but it also adds the second official translation: Spanish!

If you play with click-to-move I think you will find that it's much more responsive, and I'd love to get your feedback on the changes. I've also changed the item cards when you hover items on the ground to be the same as the one you see in the inventory, and I've moved it to the bottom right corner so it doesn't obscure your vision in fights.

Aside from that, a bunch of recent and old issues alike have been fixed. Some were hard to reproduce and confirm so please let me know if any issue persists and I will get back on that!

Next big update will be 1.20 - check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/2962769352266207429/]roadmap here[/url] for more info on the coming updates!

Thanks!

[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Christmas event now live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The in-game Christmas event is now live!

During this event you'll be able to go into Tinka's Workshop to help him with a slight corruption problem... in here you'll face a Unique foe which can drop several Legendary Christmas-themed items - including a max sized bag!

You'll also get a lot of wrapped gifts, which when opened will reveal random items. Keep in mind that your loot filter setting will affect these gifts, so they may appear empty when opened!

Lastly you'll find that some locations, including Anomalies, will have some decoration fitting the season, and that your Crystals appear a lot more edible... [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9566989/d9d46e26b1578d44c17ada95f9ecf0b5e6f1ad39.png[/img]

The event will last through the rest of the year.

I hope you enjoy this special event!



A bugfix update is also scheduled for later this week - so stay tuned for that!

Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.10.6 is live - fixes, tweaks, and performance
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Update 1.10.6 is now live with fixes for recent issues, as well as some general tweaks and performance increases.

Notably, the game is now also 64-bit! 
[i]If you are running an older 32-bit system, you can find a 32-bit version in the BETA branches on steam, but please be aware that 32-bit will not be supported indefinitely.[/i]

Linux users: 1.10.6 will be rolled out to Linux systems sometime later, as we are having some problems compiling in the latest engine version. I hope this will not delay us too much.


[b]A time-limited Christmas event[/b] will go live on December 15th, so keep an eye out for that!
During this event you'll find extra loot - as neatly wrapped gifts! You'll also be able to visit a special location, and you'll find that the denizens of the word of Chronicon has decorated for the season. More info coming on the 15th!

notes.title: Update 1.10.0 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Update 1.10.0 is now live!

This update features a revamped difficulty for the Story, a new backup system for your saves, improved Anomalies, a tier skip for the Endless Anomalies, some new Transmutation recipes - and much more!

Originally I was planning even more things for this update, however I decided to split it into two, so expect another update of similar size some time later. Planned features for the next update include build balance/buffs, and unlockable character skins!

Also, if you are not yet on the Discord, [url=https://discord.gg/nSKhPEA]please join![/url]
We are currently taking a vote on the first DLC!

I hope you enjoy!

Here's the full notes:
[h1]1.10.0:[/h1]
[b]Anomalies:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a tier skip feature to Endless tiers, where you can spend crystals to enter a special Endless Dungeon Anomaly that advances you 3 tiers when completed, but boots you if you die.
[*]Added some more Anomaly boss fight rooms.
[*]Improved Anomaly boss intros (they are now skipable).
[*]Added a new Crater anomaly layout that is smaller and has more variation.
[*]Added a new Forest layout for anomalies.
[*]Gave the Space Forest anomalies a new base layout.
[*]Removed the "Lushlands" layout from the Space Forest tileset because the water and ground were too similar.
[*]Removed the pointy dead ends of Hellfort anomalies.
[/list]
[b]Backup system:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an automatic backup system that now keeps up to 2 rolling backups of all your characters, stash, progression, etc. files.
[*]This system automatically checks for save failures and corruptions, and will automatically restore backups if any problem is found.
[/list]
[b]Difficulty & Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added some experimental anti-snapshot changes, destroying any active spell when changing equipment.
[*]Adjusted damage scaling of non-boss enemy attacks granted via random affixes.
[*]Added a slight delay to Eruption and Poison Bomb enemy affixes.
[*]Increased movement speed of all enemies.
[*]Increased enemy damage scaling on Epic and Legendary difficulties.
[*]Increased enemy health scaling from Heroic to Mythic 2.
[*]Increased base movement speed of players by 25%.
[*]Movement speed enchants lowered accordingly to give approx the same theoretical max speed.
[*]Staggered damage now has a base 30% damage reduction to the staggered ticks (the effect that previously was on Balgar's Binding).
[*]Changed how enchant values are rolled on items - they are no longer weighted towards the max roll, and are now more evenly spread between min and max.
[*]Tweaked the growth of Bonus Crystals stat and the Memory Essence rewards in the Endless Anomalies.
[*]Anomaly bosses should now be recognized as bosses for effects such as Mantle of The Dragonkin.
[*]Increased Dummy health so maybe you guys don't explode them.
[*]Increased maximum buff stacks of infinite stacking buffs (most would cap at 9.9k stacks before, I assumed no one would have the patience to reach that - I was wrong)
[*]Removed ultimate skill player skin changes, in preparation for a new permanent skin system - coming soon. (unlockable skins!)
[*]Removed item Power stat (was misleading).
[*]Shady Dealer no longer sells unlimited amounts of boxes, but are more likely to have boxes in stock.
[/list]
[b]Hardcore:[/b]
[list]
[*]Graveyard graves now show the Endless Tier reached on dead heroes (that died after this update).
[/list]
[b]Transmutation:[/b]
[list]
[b]Added new Transmutation recipes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Destroy Rune
[*]Destroy Prismatic Socket
[*]Random True Legendary
[*]Random Lesser Rune
[/list]
[*]More Transmutation recipes are now known from the start, making it easier to figure out how Transmutation works.
[*]Transmutation no longer automatically fails when an item marked as Favorite is involved, but will now fail when *equipment* marked as Favorite is *consumed* in the transmutation.
[*]Transmutation will now tell you if it fails because of a Favorited item.
[/list]
[b]Items & Skills:[/b]
[list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new Major enchant: Increased Healing from all sources. Can be rolled on Helmet, Armor, and Boots.
[*]Added new item: Heart of The Community, granted to all new characters.
[*]Added new item: Cosmic Cape (TL accessory): Turns x% of Mana into Damage.
[*]Added two new rare crafting materials: Runelord's Remorse and Prismatic Liquid.
[*]Indirect Chain Lightning on hit enchants/gems now have a 25% trigger rate, up from 15%.
[*]Jeopardy (TL Ring) no longer has an ICD, but is limited to 1 stack per frame.
[*]Tome of Knowledge is now called Chronicle of Knowledge to not be confused for a Tome (off-hand item).
[*]Advancing Army buffed to 330/430 A/GA to compensate lowered movement speed enchant values.
[*]Battle Boots and Lesser Rune of Lethal Mobility now trigger before other effects, letting them interact with skill-specific effects, such as Lesser Rune of Acrobatic Barrage.
[*]Mightcap now also increases the strength of all Ultimate skills.
[*]Balgar's Binding no longer reduces damage taken from staggered damage, and increases damage by up to 25% of held Staggered Damage (buffed from 20%).
[/list]
[b]Templar:[/b]
[list]
[*]Divine Link (ring) now increases healing from all sources by up to 200% (GA).
[*]Thorn Orbs mastery is now affected by Satellite Strength.
[*]Purged Through Holy Flames (synergy skill) is now affected by mastery proc rate increment passives.
[/list]
[b]Berserker:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lesser Rune of The Blue Bolt now also affects Hop.
[*]Molten Medallion now adds damage per 22 MPR, up from per 33 MPR.
[*]Cooling Off is now affected by the Blizzards Mastery (+Frost Winds Proc Rate).
[*]Earth and Sky and Dragon's Might (synergy skills) are now affected by mastery proc rate increment passives.
[*]Berserker synergy passives no longer chain together.
[*]Increased the Hitbox size for Thunder Punch.
[*]Increased range of Lightning Fist to 5.5/6/6.5/7/7.5, was 5.3/5.6/5.9/6.2/6.5 meters. Also increased projectile speed.
[*]Dragmageddon is no longer a Sentry skill.
[/list]
[b]Warden:[/b]
[list]
[*]Life Link now heals for 1% of max HP per hit.
[*]Volley no longer have diminishing returns on damage.
[*]Storm Mender use effect is now affected by Companion Passive and Use Effect stat.
[/list]
[b]Warlock:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Masochist 2p bonus is now reflected in tooltips and interact with bonuses towards the affected skills properly (such as Bone Skill Damage).
[*]Icecrown satellite spears now target the player's target.
[*]The Bone Spear (staff) is now reflected in tooltips and interact with bonuses towards Bone Spear properly (such as Bone Skill Damage).
[*]Reduced the effect of Death Knight (ulti) to 20%, down from 30%.
[*]Ruin will now deal damage correctly within the listed range on the tooltip.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]General QoL stuff:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now change difficulty by talking to Tinka.
[*]Items now use silver stars to reflect if their base stats are at max value for their rarity, and gold stars if they are at max possible value (TL and/or empowered to max).
[*]Navigating the waypoint with a gamepad now wraps around, so you can go upwards to get to the bottom quick.
[*]Rare loot effects (shines) are now always drawn on top, showing the items clearly when behind walls and such.
[*]Clarified some item, rune, and enchant descriptions.
[*]Ancient Sickle (Halloween Event quest item) is now Unique, so it appears on your map when dropped.
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added support for Japanese community translations. (Please let me know if there are problems presenting the text or if something is missing!)
[*]Added a small tutorial when opening the endgame interface for the first time.
[*]Added map cycle options to the interface menu (all on by default).
[*]Added more "short number" letters so it doesn't break when you pass Q.
[*]Stat page (not the inventory quick reference) now also show uncapped values on resistances.
[*]Minimap and area info is now transparent like the quest tracker.
[*]Added a HUD clock (can be toggled on/off in interface settings).
[*]Added a cursor color setting to interface settings.
[*]Improved locale support by adding a "suffix only" mode for enemies and items, solving problems with gendered words for some languages.
[*]Improved difficulty select menu (performance, text placement, added notice on being able to change later).
[*]FPS display now scales with HUD scale.
[*]Made several improvements to text handling, please let me know if you spot any oddities.
[/list]
[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved performance of HUD updates.
[*]Improved performance of damage numbers displays and updates.
[*]Improved performance of static light rendering like torches, lanterns, etc.
[*]Experimental change to tile handling that may improve overall performance, mostly noticable on lower end hardware.
[*]Improved texture handling.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed how the "Trapped!" quest works so it now spawns the Unique foe with the Zombies, and killing it is the trigger to complete the quest, event, and unlock the door. Should prevent future lockouts.
[*]Fixed issue where changing language did not update fully until after a game restart.
[*]Fixed Revert and Magnetic Lock not having damage listed on the tooltip.
[*]Fixed issue where stash changes might not be saved if you quit to menu too fast after accessing the stash or if your character saves super fast following a stash access.
[*]Fixed poor performance during new character creation.
[*]Fixed some setting buttons being out of place and not in order when using controller.
[*]Fixed issue where disconnecting a controller might not let you use the keyboard again.
[*]Fixed issue where you could get softlocked if a controller disconnected when your character died.
[*]Fixed some issues with "click-throughs" on menus with a controller.
[*]Fixed weird crash from the endgame waypoint when using a controller.
[*]Fixed some incorrect stat displays in stat page / inventory quick reference.
[*]Fixed Fizzbang's mortars ignoring resistances (Act 5 boss 1).
[*]Fixed bug where you could bind one controller to multiple players when starting local co-op.
[*]Fixed crash if having too many auras in local co-op.
[*]Fixed issue where Moving Prayer would not remove the applied stats after wearing off.
[*]Fixed stairs down portals being rendered underneath ground effects from spells, making them hard to see.
[*]Fixed early companion stat Mastery nodes not working for some classes.
[*]Fixed issue with quest/achievement updates with NPC "Semmy" in Act 5.
[*]Fixed quest overwrite issues when using characters with different progression in local co-op.
[*]Fixed Lesser Rune of Blood Explosion stacking on itself.
[*]Fixed being able to open Challenge Portals anywhere, leading to some weird problems and in some cases, crashes.
[*]Fixed issue where co-op players' saves would in some cases be considered the "most recent" save and be set as the "continue as ..." for solo quick resume.
[*]Fixed issue with some Highlands anomalies when using water or lava tiles in the mix.
[*]Fixed crash on hitting (A) on empty equipment slot when in the transmutation alter with a controller.
[*]Fixed incorrect interface updates when in Gemma's interface with a controller.
[*]Fixed some inconsistent stat rounding on the interface.
[*]Fixed multiple missing ds errors/crashes.
[*]Fixed some issues with buying 10x and 100x items with keyboard & mouse.
[*]Fixed issue where spell scroll/codex might use the wrong rank spell.
[*]Possible fix for Wings of Sziirk dropping you inside walls sometimes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.00.6: Chinese support, tweaks, and fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I am back in health and back at work, fixing issues and tweaking stuff!

This update improves support for custom translations by adding an in-game menu to change language from, and it also adds the first official translation: Simplified Chinese! In the future I plan on adding support for more community translations by adding additional fonts, such as Korean. I may be adding more official translations down the line as well.

This update also fixes a few crashes and tweaks a few things. Thanks for all the reports, comments, and suggestions! I am now shifting focus entirely to 1.1, which will bring a lot of new QoL features, buff/tweak a lot of sets and items, add a save backup system, endgame improvements, and also fix a large amount of bugs - among other things!

Thanks everyone!

[h1]1.00.6:[/h1]
[b]Enchants & Powers:[/b]
[list]
[*]All enchants & powers that required a silly amount of Greater Augments to reach cap no longer do so.
[/list]
[b]Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tuned down some enemy AoE effects that were likely to one-shot you.
[*]Added a few frames of invulnerability after a "save from death" effect has triggered so you don't die regardless before being able to react due to rapid/queued hits.
[/list]
[b]Translations:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the first official translation: Simplified Chinese!
[*]Your custom translations will now be discovered by the game and selectable from the in-game menu, so you don't have to manually edit the config file to change language anymore.
[*]Incorrectly set up languages will default to English.
[*]Help index can now be translated and have been moved to locale/help.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed memory leak related to belt items.
[*]Fixed a few crashes related to corrupt characters.
[*]Fixed a some loading problems.
[*]Fixed being able to drop items on the current stash tab and the stash eating them.
[*]Fixed The Last Word (Berserker fist) not working.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.00.5: QoL & Fixes + info
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for your continued support and reports!

This is another bugfix update that takes care of a large amount of issues.
I've also added some slight QoL features that were requested in the past few days.

I have been asked about a roadmap with future plans so I will be making one sometime soon, where I will list my plans for some time ahead. However here's a short summary of the next few steps:
I will soon shift my focus entirely to 1.1 which will largely be a huge QoL update with skill tweaks, interface tweaks, improved anomaly layouts, wider language support, and much more!
And after that, I shift my focus to something bigger. 

More on this later!


Thanks everyone, I hope you enjoy!

Here's the full notes:
[h1]1.00.5:[/h1]
[b]Loot:[/b]
[list]
[*]Swapping items between inventory and Stash now lets the Favorite mark take precedence (if either the source or target stack is favorited, the new stack will be favorited).
[*]You can no longer transmute or drop favorited items, preventing accidents.
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved some skill descriptions and fixed some grammar errors.
[*]Minimap scale now goes down to 50% (was minimum 100%).
[*]Most UI elements have had their max scale setting increased from 300% to 400% to accommodate huge screens & resolutions.
[*]Clicking a Grave in the Graveyard now autoscales the popup a bit to allow for larger numbers (and longer translations) to fit.
[*]The unfinished stash icon feature I added by accident earlier (oops) now lets you loop the icons by right clicking continuously.
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Plague Spinner spiders now spawn in Forgotten Chambers in Act 1 (they only appeared in Anomalies before).
[*]Castle Guards now spawn in The Courtyard and Clairebourg Halls in Act 3 (they only spawned in challenge areas before).
[*]Caecus Dolo (The high Priest) now laughs a lot less frequently during combat.
[*]Lowered the damage of Fizzbang's skills (first boss Act 5).
[*]Lowered the volume of all bats and rats high-pitched squealing.
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Poison Arrow is now called Poison Shot to further emphasize that it is not an "Archery" skills (Druid tree has no Archery skills).
[*]Improved pathing and behavior of Seeking Arrow (Warden) so it should no longer get stuck.
[/list]
[b]World:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved spawn locations of some NPC's so they dont end up in walls.
[*]Going into The Sacrificial Grounds and rescuing the Sorcerers without accepting the quest now auto-starts the quest upon rescuing them.
[*]Anomaly hellfort layouts with a lot of dead ends have been made more rare (1.1 will bring improved layouts!).
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Talisman of Spines not counting Utility skills.
[*]Fixed Amulet of Despair not working with lower value slowing effects (such as 30% slows from Tangled Growth (Warden), etc).
[*]Fixed the damage reduction from the Bloodbinder Set (Warlock) not working.
[*]Fixed players doing more powerful attack grunts when using Utility skills.
[*]Fixed Thornbough not always spawning in Thornbough Garden.
[*]Fixed issue where on-hit effects such as "Smite" etc would trigger the diminishing return feature for the direct hit that trigered the Smite, causing it to deal less damage.
[*]Fixed exploit with the Blood Explosion rune.
[*]Fixed crash from Pylon beam spells.
[*]Fixed Satellite enchants not being affected by dynamic crit rate chances, from buffs, passives, and powers like Jeopardy, etc.
[*]Fixed Tesla (Templar) and other chain-lightning effects not working.
[*]Fixed Widespread Inferno (Warlock) not spreading stacks (it does not add stacks by triggering, but now correctly spreads existing stacks to nearby foes with lower stacks).
[*]Fixed being able to move bosses with Lightning Wyrms (Berserker/Codex).
[*]Fixed game unpausing or sometimes even crashing when a controller is disconnected while the game is paused.
[*]Fixed the Codex not recording deaths.
[*]Fixed Mechanical foes not being affected by dots, debuffs, etc.
[*]Fixed Diana Jones in act 4 saying the wrong lines after finding the key.
[*]Fixed some area portals which play sounds as you find them playing these sounds on repeat.
[*]Fixed some mobility/teleport skills such as Dragon Warp and Snow Blast not going the correct distance when using a gamepad.
[*]Fixed scrolling in dialogue scrolling at different speed with different text scaling settings.
[*]Fixed player dismissing dialogue with negative voice lines even if you had read it through.
[*]Fixed getting stuck after talking to some act 5 npc's.
[*]Fixed old GMS logo on startup.
[*]Fixed crashes due to bad data in graveyard.
[*]Fixed some overlay problems in the New Hero screen.
[*]Fixed a missing text debuff from Act 5.
[*]Fixed incorrect mouse shortcuts listed for selling x10 items.
[*]Fixed crash when exiting Room of Abundance.
[*]Possible fix for people who were unable to import their exported builds.
[*]Another possible fix for the silly missing doors in Hellfort anomaly layouts.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0 is live! Full release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9566989/2ae0ed379557f4f5df915c3b1e9670eb005e3f62.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

After 5 long years in Early Access, we are launching fully!
Amazing. Thank you everyone who has supported me & the game over the years, and thank you for being part of the journey!

As with all of my larger updates you can expect some issues slipping through the cracks, so I will be hovering the forums for the next few hours, ready to help & note any issues. Hopefully it should go smoothly though! Expect fixes in the next week for anything that might pop up!

And after that, well, I got some cool stuff planned. More on this later...
Let's go!


[h1]1.00.0:[/h1]
[b]Major Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Act 5, complete with 29 new areas, 23 quests (8 optional), 12 new unique items from 12 unique monster spawns, 7 new enemy types with a total of 27 variations, 6 new troves to find, and 5 new big bosses to fight!
[*]Added 24 new Legendary+ items.
[*]Added 24 new endgame Runes.
[*]Updated 26 items with new powers, improved powers, or power tweaks.
[*]Updated & improved 14 sets.
[*]Updated & improved 9 Runes.
[*]Added new Anomaly bosses, layouts, and rare modifiers.
[*]Added 20 new Achievements.
[*]Added many suggestions and QoL improvements.
[*]Added over 120 new sound effects to monsters, bosses, interface, etc.
[*]Improved performance.
[*]Fixed a bazillion issues, and probably introduced some new :-)
[/list]
[b]Items, Sets, & Runes:[/b]
[list]
[b]Items:[/b]
[list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Normalized all Legendary weapon attack speeds to 100% - with a few exceptions where attack speed is a focal point.
[*]Normalized all unique+ power roll ranges.
[*]Life Guard (TL Helm): Now also reduces damage taken from indirect sources. GA buffed to 50%, up from 40%.
[*]Hydrascale Boots (TL Boots): The HPR increment based on missing health is now always active.
[*]Weyrick's Crown (TL Helm): Has been nerfed to 3/4% A/GA (down from 5/6%).
[*]Crown of Solitude (Helm): Now has an extra strong Crown Slaying power (rune-able) and drops at level 20 (up from 1).
[*]Gaia's Binding (Ring): Renamed Terra's Binding and now has a combined +all res and +all elements enchant (rune-able).
[/list]
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Boots of Hazard (Boots): Tick Health on Hit when standing in hostile ground effects, and take much less damage from ground effects.
[*]Aspect of the Ethereal (TL Ring): All indirect damage enchants apply a debuff dealing the same amount of damage per second as Ethereal, stacking infinitely and lasting 7 seconds.
[*]Crown of Innate Probability (TL Helm): All skills with any chance effects, proc rates, etc, have a x% increased chance to trigger.
[*]Talisman of Spines (TL Amulet): For each assigned skill that is Utility, Ultimate, Companion, Aura, Heritage, or Ritual, thorns is increased by x%.
[*]Primordial Rose (TL ring): Every 3 seconds, resistance to a random element is increased by X% for 3 seconds.
[*]Stormchasers (TL Boots): Damage increased by x% for each twister, gust, whirlwind and similar type of effect within 5 meters.
[*]Gemstone Tiara (Helm): Any gems inserted into this helm also provide the bonuses from being in a weapon or jewelry slot.
[/list]
[b]New Unique Foe Drops (Act 5):[/b]
[list]
[*]Skin of Terror (Armor): Has 3x Star sockets, and comes socketed with gems.
[*]Fang of Alucard (Accessory): HoH is xxx% more effective.
[*]Ancient Bone (Accessory, Warlock): Bone skills deal increased damage.
[*]Eye of Hazioxth (Amulet): Reveals nearby invisible foes.
[*]Shizbuk's Tail (Accessory): Provokes and pulls random nearby foes when attacking.
[*]Ring of Hunger (Ring): Mana Regeneration is increased for each nearby foe. Bosses count as 15 foes.
[*]Skull of Harlon (Helm): Vastly increased Projectile skill range & damage.
[*]Molten Skin Boots (Boots): Vastly increased Ground Effect Skill duration and damage.
[*]Sight Beyond (Accessory): +Reach, +Pickup Radius, +Light Radius
[*]Stone of Tephra (Accessory): Thrown skills and Stone skills (Berserker) deal greatly increased damage.
[*]Skull of Grimm (Relic): Use: Cast Bone Curse V.
[*]Wing of Sziirk (Relic): Use: Teleport up to 10 meters forwards and deal 300% fire damage to all foes teleported through.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Templar:[/b]
[list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Ring of Blades (Ring): Now also commands the Blades to attack the Templar's target.
[*]Phantoma (TL Sword): Is now Sword-only, and now greater augments up to 100% (was 45%).
[*]Crown of Justice: Now Greater Augments up to 30% (was 25%).
[/list]
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Contra (TL Shield): Each time a foe is stricken by a Shield skill they suffer x% increased damage from all Shield skills, stacking infinitely.
[*]Venerata (TL Sword): Magic skills attack x% faster and have 25% chance to doublecast.
[*]Prayer Beads (TL Accessory): While still, Auras have x% increased range. While moving, Auras have x% increased effect & damage. Effect has a 3 second overlap.

[b]Warden:[/b]
[list]

[*]Windcaller's Regalia: The merging effect of the Whirlwinds have been moved to the 2) bonus, and the 3) bonus now makes Windwalker last until death, and makes it cast rank 5 Gale every 5 seconds.

[list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[b]Changes:[/b]

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lesser Rune of The Bombardier: Bombardment skills deal x% increased damage for each second of duration, however their base duration is halved. Bombardment skills without a duration gain 3 seconds worth of bonus damage.
[*]Lesser Rune of Relentless Assault: Assault skills no longer cost any mana, restore 3% mana on use, and have their cooldowns reduced by x%.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]

[list]

[b]Berserker:[/b]
[list]
[b]New:[/b]

[b]Warden:[/b]
[list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]

[list]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]

[list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]

[list]

[*]Removed target circles from some companion spells.
[*]Improved coloring of many monster variations.
[*]Camera now zooms on player on death.
[*]Game Over screen made more clear.
[*]Added Golem gibs.
[*]Gibs and breakable object fragments that fall into pits/void no longer stops mid-air, and now fades and falls down. If landing in water, they will cause a small splash.
[*]Added spawning animations for 5 more monsters (some new, some existing).
[*]Reduced collision box on some Warden companions so they get around corners easier.
[*]Removed Sticky Targeting.
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Re-ordered the item codex to place all non-set items in the same order based on class, slot, and quality.

[*]Removed some old tips from the loadscreens that no longer apply.
[*]Added some new loadscreen tips.
[*]Shifted mouse tooltips on buffs a few pixels to the right.
[*]Improved minimap icon display so that icons are revealed in a slightly larger radius than tiles are.
[*]Improved item tooltips so skills referenced are highlighted with their element color.
[*]Drastically improved item card visual clarity when scaling down large cards to fit the screen.
[*]Moved some stats on the inventory quick stat pages to make them fit better.

[*]Damage numbers are now depth sorted with the highest value being on top.
[*]Damage number auto-cleanup will now remove lower numbers before bigger ones.
[*]You can now ctrl-click items in the inventory and stash to quickly drop them.
[*]You can now alt-click items in the inventory and stash to favorite them. Favorited items cannot be sold or auto-sorted until un-favorited again.
[*]You can now buyback a full stack (shift + lmb), or buy 100x from stackable stuff in sotres (also shift + lmb).
[*]Improved the buff tooltips, fixing some alignment and spacing issues.
[*]The text saying "all enemies have been granted the X affix" when entering unstable dimensions and rare anomalies now says "all crowned foes" instead, to clarify.
[*]Fixed Codex cards not being named correctly when printed (f10).
[/list]
[b]Endgame:[/b]
[list]

[*]Slime King anomalies are now more rare.
[*]Added more special spawn setups to anomalies.
[*]Added a new tier of monsters to anomalies (Act 5 monsters) that appear on Mythic and up.

[b]Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]HoH and MoH triggers will restore based on the most powerful attack made during its internal cooldown (5 frames), so you always get maximum sustain from it.
[*]Tweaked the movement speed applied by knockback effects.
[*]Puzzles now periodically push away nearby companions so they won't get in the way as much.
[*]Companions now stop idle moving if they are nearby puzzles.
[/list]
[b]Misc & World:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed an unobtainable Berserker armor from the Codex. (old and no power)
[*]Added some consumable items to early quest rewards.
[*]Added a Legendary item to the Act 4 final quest reward. You can get this item *once* if you have already finished the quest before it had a reward, by just talking to Korem.
[*]Added a same-area portal system that allows short-range portals within the same area without any loadscreens. (You'll find this in Act 5 but it moight pop up elsewhere in the game as well for more interesting layouts)
[*]Levers are now color-coded with red and green depending on state.
[*]The button puzzles towards the end of Act 3 are now using colored levers.
[*]Updated some quest texts to add location names so you can find your way back at a later time.
[*]Updated some older quest rewards with newer enchants.
[*]Added some missing player speech (text) upon entering certain zones in acts 1,2, and 4.
[*]Tweaked rare mob spawning to prevent them spawning into walls.
[*]Improved detection and filtering of externally modded/hacked items (as unfortunately these modded items may cause crashes).
[/list]
[b]Sound & Music:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added drop sounds for Unique and TL equipment and rare materials.
[*]Added new sounds for performing and learning transmutation recipes.
[*]Added 5 new music tracks for Act 5 and Anomalies.
[*]Added 120 new sound effects to enemies and bosses.
[/list]
[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved lighting system so it's slightly faster, and also supports ambient light sources such as lava.
[*]Improved texture memory handling to try and keep the memory allocation lower.
[*]Improved framerate on death.
[*]Improved performance for many instant on-hit triggers by making them auto-cleanup their visual effects sooner if there are very many being triggered.
[*]Improved performance for Berserker by queuing and batching rage-based effect updates.
[*]Improved performance for for Berserker and Warlock by delaying some instant UI updates a few frames.
[*]Improved internal handling of Gems & stat calculations.
[*]Improved performance of rapid interface updates.
[*]Improved temp data handling, removing some redundant data or stuff that can be easily recreated from saving, reducing disk access somewhat.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed gibbed foes still drawing their shadows and auras etc after they've exploded.
[*]Fixed the Assistant spawning in Act 3 even after the point where he shouldn't.
[*]Fixed Magnetic Orbs and Magnetic Field sometimes disappearing before the effect ended.

[*]Fixed crash from enemies using taunt and dying in the same frame(ish).

[*]Fixed issue where levers could be in the wrong state after re-entering an area.
[*]Fixed right-clicking vendors also selling any item under the cursor if the resolution and scaling was set so it would overlap.
[*]Fixed a permanent loot radius indicator if disabling the toggle setting while it was toggled on.

[*]Fixed incorrect gamepad mappings being shown in various vendor interfaces.
[*]Fixed some overlapping text on vendor interfaces when using a controller.
[*]Fixed some scaling problems with item cards.
[*]Fixed issue causing negative skill points when saving and loading some builds.

[*]Fixed Heat Wave (Warlock) and Shatter Shield (Templar) not properly adjusting their visuals for reach stat changes.
[*]Fixed issue causing all skills firing Frost Spears (Warlock) requiring a LOS to the caster to deal damage.
[*]Fixed the Boomstick power (Warlock staff) not working as intended.
[*]Fixed issue where ice spears from Shattering Punch (Berserker) would go through walls.

[*]Fixed Holy Hammer going through walls.
[*]Fixed players 2-4 not being able to refund skill points in co-op.
[*]Fixed spawning sounds playing when enemies spawned offscreen in an "un-spawned" state.
[*]Fixed some incorrect shortcut listings in the vendor interface.

notes.title: Impressive 2D action-RPG 'Chronicon' leaves Early Access on August 21
notes.notes: To say I enjoy Chronicon would be quite the understatement, this 2D indie action-RPG has a huge amount of content and it's finally set to leave Early Access.

notes.title: 1.0 Release Date & Pricing Info!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I can't believe I'm typing this.. but I have set a release date!
[b]Chronicon will fully launch as 1.0.0 on August 21st![/b]

The Early Access price [u]will remain with a small launch discount for a few days[/u], to give everyone who's been waiting for full release a last chance to pick it up at lower price point. Afterwards, the game price will increase a few dollars to its intended full price.

What's next?
I hope to be able to continue support to game for a long time with fresh free smaller content updates, as well as paid DLC with major content updates. You can expect more info on this later this year!

Thank you to everyone who has supported me & the game through this very long Early Access period!


And here's a little teaser with some Act 5 content:
[previewyoutube=dxK7JEUDlKs;full][/previewyoutube]

See you on the 21st!

notes.title: Update 0.98.1 - Fixes & New Achievements
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here's a few fixes for a couple recent issues. I've also removed some old achievements and added new, broader ones in the same category, namely kill "X of Y" type achievements. In the future you can expect a few codex-related ones, too. And of course a bunch for Act5! When you see those appear in the achievements list, 1.0 is near....


Thanks for the reports, suggestions, and comments!


Here's the full notes:
[h1]0.98.1:[/h1]
[b]Added new Achievements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed some old very specific kill-related ones and added new kill-type achievements for all enemy types; Beast, Fae, etc.
[/list]
[b]Controllers:[/b]
[list]
[*]Controller default bindings now puts radial loot on left stick pressed, instead of "display all items on ground".
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some enemies (Elves in particular) sliding around after death.
[*]Fixed some enemy affixes that were on "pulse" setting happening even after they had died.
[*]Fixed companion health scaling going backwards after Endless Tier 42.
[*]Fixed "MISSING TEXT" on some locked chests.
[*]Fixed some typos in dialogue.

notes.title: Update 0.98.0 - Endgame difficulty rebalance, tweaks, fixes, new stats
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update should take care of the issues with indirect damage suddenly being extremely lethal, as it was balanced when a bug that was fixed in the previous update was active. I also added two new stats and enchants to specifically let you deal with indirect damage if you find your preferred form of defenses lacking in that area. While I was doing that I figured I'd take a poke at the endless tier scaling, as it rapidly got a bit out of hand, and - as always - I got a bit carried away and made a larger update than intended. I've also fixed a couple issues that popped up, gave Warden some tweaks, and poked at a few other things here and there. 

Anyway, hope you enjoy this update!

Now I'm off to dig myself deep into Act 5 work :-)


Here's the full notes:
[h1]0.98.0:[/h1]
[b]Difficulty & Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Rebalanced all indirect damage and DoT damage from enemies, and gave it an upper cap - indirect damage can no longer deal more than 5% of your health in damage per strike/tick. Best way to combat indirect damage is by your preferred method of sustain (hoh, hpr, healing skill/codex, etc) rather than beefing up your health pool. (And using the new stats, of course!)
[*]Tweaked enemy damage bonus curve through endgame difficulties - once you get high enough (endless T42 and forwards) the curve flattens and becomes liniear, so you can shift focus to doing more damage instead of avoiding pesky one-shots.
[*]Similarly, enemy health bonus flattens on T100, and starts to slowly pick up again as you progress further.
[*]Increased bonus experience per endless tier reached.
[*]Enemy "on hit" affixes are now calculated as the final step in damage calculation, meaning after shields and such has been considered.
[*]Suffering Thorns damage now has an internal cooldown of 20 frames so you don't nuke yourself on Thorn packs.
[*]Thorns still punch through shields (as intended).
[*]Trap damage now scales with difficulty (oops).
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[b]All:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lightfooted (Perk) now also affects companions.
[/list]
[b]Warden:[/b]
[list]
[*]Companion passives buffed:
[list]
[*]Moon Howl (Wolves) damage boost increased to 11/18/25%, up from 9/12/15%
[*]Empowerment (Pixies) damage boost increased to 10/15/20%, up from 6/8/10%
[*]Antivenom (Spiders) resistance boost increased to 20/30/40%, up from 15/20/25%
[*]Thorny (Treants) thorn bonus increased to 30/50/70%, up from 9/12/15%
[*]Oak Wisdom (Treants) mana bonus increased to 10/20/30%, up from 12/15/18%
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Stats & Enchants:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added two new defensive stats: Ground Effect Resistance, and Indirect Damage Resistance.
[*]Added enchants for the new stats: Ground Effect Resistance can be found on Boots and Accessories. Indirect Damage Resistance can be found on Helmets and Amulets. Both are considered Minor enchants.
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved stat panel on the interface by dividing stats into more clear groups.
[*]Help index updated with new stats.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with skill resets causing blank allocated skills.
[*]Fixed characters playing powerful skill shouts/grunts on default attacks (when not having any skill assigned in leftmost slot).
[*]Fixed issue where Act 4 Troves achievement would trigger before the last one was found.
[*]Fixed crash when Trogs smashed urns.
[*]Fixed Codex adding everything in your stash to the counters on each game start.
[/list]
[b]Locale:[/b]

[*]Updated stats locale and enchants locale with the new stats & enchants.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.97.0 - Codex, Build Export/Import, Voice Acting, and much more!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update took a lot longer than intended, simply because I decided to cram in [i]most[/i] of the planned pre-release features into a single update! That's right, aside from fixes, QoL, and smaller updates, the next big one will be 1.0! Of course, it'll be a while before then - it's gonna be a pretty huge update, after all.

So what's in the update? 
In short:
I've added a [b]build export/import system[/b], so you can now save your builds and quickly swap between them. This includes both skills and masteries, and the builds can be loaded up on any character of the same class. Even your friends' characters if you send them your build files. Or attach them to your build guide! Just talk to Korem or Tinka and they'll let you export & import. 

There's an [b]in-game Codex[/b] that tracks and lists progression in terms of areas visited, waypoints found, unique monsters killed, regular monsters killed, unique+ items obtained, runes obtained, and several other nice and helpful stats and tidbits of info, such as rough indicators of how to obtain items you don't have.

I've also added a few [b]new items[/b] and added new and more interesting effects to some existing ones, such as the oddly useless Quadruplets. I think you'll find them more useful now!

Last but not least: I've worked with a [b]number of skilled voice actors[/b] who have added countless of voice lines to bosses, npc's, and --- your characters! Yes, your characters will now grunt and shout at you when you don't have enough mana, and react to certain in-game events, such as killstreaks, and much more!

And as always there is a bunch of requested QoL features and fixes!

And, finally, a [u]big thank you[/u] to everyone who has been reporting bugs, posting suggestions, and participating in the discussions both here on Steam and on Discord!

I hope you enjoy this update - have fun and stay safe!

Here are the full notes:


[h1]0.97.0:[/h1]
[b]New feature - Build export & import!:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now export your current build (skills & masteries) to a .build file (saves to ...\AppData\Local\Chronicon\save\builds\) and name it whatever you want.
[*]You can now import builds (will completely overwrite your current build, but not edit any exported builds) - any build matching your class that is in the builds directory will be available to pick from here.
[*]This is all done by talking to Korem in The Chronicon or Tinka in Tinka's Domain - similarly to how Skill/Mastery resets work.
[*]Note:
[*]Your character must be level 100 to gain access to the import/export features.
[*]This build format will easily work with third party tools, such as build planners (in both directions), and you can easily share your build files and include them in guides, etc.
[/list]
[b]New feature - The Codex!:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Codex will record most aspects of your adventures!
[*]It has a complete list of all enemies and bosses in the game, and will provide useful info and lore on them, as well as showing stats such as kills and deaths.
[*]It also has a complete list of all areas in the game, showing wheter or not you've explored it, found the waypoint, found the zone-specific unique foe (if any), and other neat stats.
[*]In addition to this, it has a complete index over all Runes and equipment of Unique or higher quality. It will list how many times you've found each item, as well as any powers and "implicit" stats on the items.
[*]It'll also tell you the minimum level required to find the item, if it's from a unique foe, quest reward, or from crafting - etc!
[*]All in all it's like a mini wiki and stat tracker at the same time - perfect for the completionist!
[*]Note:
[*]All tracking is done locally and is considered "account wide" - so all your characters will have shared tracking and progression in the Codex.
[*]You'll need to enter the game with each of your characters to have their inventories and personal stashes scanned and added to the Codex!
[*](Unfortunately, monster kills and some area-related stats can not be added retroactively, so you'll have to re-visit areas to fully complete them in the Codex)
[/list]
[b]New feature - player voices![/b]
[*]Player characters now have voices for error speech, pain grunts, attack grunts, misc dialog prompts, low health warning, killstreak "cheers", and more. More details below!
[/list]
[b]Anomalies & Endgame:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new rare Anomaly monster spawn combinations, such as "only King Slimes", and varying types of "only Minions". More things like this to come!
[/list]
[b]Ultrawide Support:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added experimental support for 21:9 2560x1080 and 3440x1440.
[/list]
[b]Enemies & Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new monster affixes:
[list]
[*]Sorcerer and Embershot.
[*]Sorcerer:
[*]Grants them Firebomb and Frost Spear spells.
[*]Embershot:
[*]Grants them the "Embershot" ranged attack - can only be rolled on bow-users (Elves and Skeletons).
[/list]
[*]Added new monster type affixes:

[*]+10% resistance to all but Physical, -10% Resistance to Physical.

[*]All enemies now belong to one type.
[/list]

[*]All kinds of Elves etc: Humanoid, no longer considered Fae.

[*]Beholder: Now Demon.
[*]Stag: Now Beast.
[*]All zombies now have the Grapple affix.

[*]Ghoul (Zombie) now has the Vampiric affix.
[/list]
[*]Elemental monster affixes (Frozen, Poisoned, Static, Plagued, and Infernal) will now also change certain base physical attacks to equivalent elemental attacks, increasing their damage and making it more visually distinct.
[*]Added missing sounds to monsters showing up in endgame content such as Golems and Cerberi.
[*]Replaced the default "strike" attack of most Beasts with a new "bite" attack (visual/particles only).
[/list]
[b]Items & Enchants:[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.96.2 - New runes, QoL, Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here's another small update with some new stuff, some tweaks, some mechanic changes, and fixes. A few issues remain, so you can expect a few more small updates like these going forwards.

0.97.0 will likely be ready sometime (late) next month, and it'll feature the much requested build saving! That means creating, saving, loading, and sharing character builds easily! So stay tuned for that :-)

Thanks for your reports, comments, and suggestions!


Here's the full notes:

[h1]0.96.2:[/h1]
[b]Items & Runes:[/b]
[list]
[b]Added new runes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lesser Rune of Potency (All) - Active skills deal x% increased damage based on their percentage cost in mana.
[*]Lesser Rune of Frozen Graves (Warlock) - Foes affected by Frozen Fate have a 0.xx% chance per missing health percentage to instantly die and cause Corpse Shatter when struck.
[*]Lesser Rune of The Devouring Star (Warlock) - Deathly Barrage now spawns a single powerful star. It will periodically absorb any Frigid Star that comes within 4 meters, refreshing its own duration and gain xxx% of the absorbed spell's damage.
[/list]
[b]Improved item:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tome of Vengeance (Templar) - now allows the Dancing Blades to trigger Sharp Steel at up to 200% efficiency.
[*]Now also rolls Companion Damage instead of Physical damage.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Interface & Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a "reverse nova" type of particle effect, which is used on the following skills (so far):
[*]Revert, Healing Touch, Taunt, and The Devouring Star effect.
[*]Crafted items now have a "Crafted" tag on them - making it much easier to distinguish dropped vs transmuted Runes, for example. (Not retroactive currently)
[/list]
[b]Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Augmenting an enchant that has had its minimum roll increased (or added) in an update now automatically brings it up to the new minimum value, rather than having to augment all the way up from 0. (Normally the changed enchant or power is automatically updated on all your items, however this is not always possible)
[*]Enemies who are not damageable/targetable now skip most checks, such as collisions, buffs, etc. improving performance, pathfinding, and hit checking somewhat.
[*]You can now target and damage enemies which have had their spawn animation triggered, and no longer need to wait for them to "finish" spawning.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the gamepad disconnection popup being able to pop during loadscreens / dungeon generation and kinda wrecking it all. It will now nicely wait until you have loaded in.
[*]Fixed the stat cap visual indication not actually updating.
[*]Fixed skill reset Achievement not popping with the new skill reset method.
[*]Fixed Expulsion visually appearing on the Templar instead of on the target it triggers on.
[*]Fixed many skills targeting enemies which couldn't be targeted or damaged at the time.
[*]Fixed buffs and effects going off on enemies which aren't able to be damaged.
[*]Fixed minor typo in Act 3 summary dialogue.

notes.title: Update 0.96.1 - Fixes, QoL, and some tweaks!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

After a refreshing holiday I am back, and what better way to start off the year than with a big bug fix?

After this update I will be working on getting some more content out, such as new items and runes, and something else... You can also expect small fixes here and there as per usual.

This year will also be a big year for Chronicon - 1.0 release year!
I will be making a post on what that means and what you can expect, sometime in the near future.

Many thanks for the suggestions, reports, and comments!

Here's the full notes of this update:

[h1]0.96.1:[/h1]
[b]Linux:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated the launch script to work on more distributions (thanks to "[Linux] Liam" on Steam!)
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now drag items from equipped slots directly onto stash tab icons to place them in the tab.
[*]Stat system caps made more flexible in order to properly display when an increased cap has been reached, and to allow future cap improvements via skills and powers.
[*]Items with internal cooldowns (Jeopardy, Hellstone, etc) now lists the cooldown in the description.
[/list]
[b]Items, Runes, & Sets:[/b]
[list]
[*]Templar:
[list]
[*]Ring of Blades now notes it is affected by Companion Damage.
[*]Because of some funky interactions between Tenacious Defender and Art of Combat, Tenacious Defender now resets its counter when 3 Cleaves are reached, rather than rolling back 3.
[*]Shields can now roll Damage Stagger.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Mechanics and AI:[/b]
[list]
[*]Dots/debuffs on players have always had a very low damage cap - this cap now grows with difficulty up to Mythic 1, to approx 65% higher than before.
[*]Effects which require no companion skills now also consider skills that are primarily of a different type (ultimate, passive) and provide companions, such as the Warlock's Infernal Demon Ultimate skill, the Templar's Soul Replica, etc.
[/list]
[b]Performance & System:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved Stash saving timings further.
[*]Improved performance of some heavier particle effects, most notably the spells cast by Blood Mages.
[*]The overlay map setting is now saved per character.
[/list]
[b]Skills & Masteries:[/b]
[list]
[*]Templar:
[list]
[*]The Templar now has access to two Companion Health and Companion Damage nodes in her Mastery tree.
[*]Clarified description of Fulmination that it strikes within melee range.
[*]Consecration is now limited to a single instance.
[*]Soul Purge now allows Expulsion to crit.
[*]Banished Evil (Mastery) now increases the chance of Exorcism to trigger multiplicatively, rather than additively. Additionally, it now goes up to a 100% increase, instead of a +30% chance, resulting in a much lower total.
[/list]
[*]Warden:
[list]
[*]Fairy Ring mushrooms now have a set timer of 5 seconds before they spontaneously explode, and this is now also noted on the skill card.
[/list]
[*]Warlock:
[list]
[*]Volatile, Demonic Strength, and Pestilence are now affected by Companion Use and Passive Effect stat.
[*]Ritual Of Summoning's use effect now affects Infernal Demon and Ritual of Necromancy.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed being able to scroll the gem page with the mouse wheel without actually being on the gem page (caused lag).
[*]Fixed dragging an item to the inventory tabs causing it to get stuck on the cursor.
[*]Fixed not being able to click RMB on equipment to unequip into inventory while accessing the stash.
[*]Fixed not being able to click RMB to deposit an equipped item into the stash.
[*]Fixed some inventory inconsistencies in tooltip delays.
[*]Fixed tooltip delay not being considered when hovering HUD elements such as buffs, skills, belt slots, etc.
[*]Fixed the auto-loot radius display not dynamically updating to reflect changes in pickup radius.
[*]Fixed issue where the overlay map would reset to the default mode when pausing the game.
[*]Fixed containers having the wrong names and texts.
[*]Fixed missing Undead, Crown, etc slaying stats from the stat page.
[*]Fixed issue where using the interface hotkeys (inventory, quest log, etc) from the skill edit mode would remove some interface buttons.
[*]Fixed issue where stats weren't re-calculated when resetting skills via Korem.
[*]Fixed several issues with the skill point removal in local co-op.
[*]Fixed issue where when editing masteries, it was possible to lower a mastery below the minimum required of the next tier.
[*]Fixed Flamebound Armor (Berserker) having a 1-1 roll range on its effect.
[*]Fixed Rune of Shattered Spirits (Warlock) not always triggering as intended. 
[*]Fixed Field Training (Templar Aura) not being properly affected by most +Aura Effect passives.
[*]Fixed Magnetic Orbs (Templar) in some cases fading away before the effect fades, leaving you with the buff and no orbs to deal damage.
[*]Fixed Expulsion, Divine Salvo, and Divine Blade's (Templar) visual effects having incorrect radius.
[*]Fixed Dragon Leap, Thundering Roar, and Dragonwarp  (Berserker) not breaking breakable objects.
[*]Fixed Sporelings (Warden) triggering on hit instead of the intended on attack.
[*]Fixed Bramble Storm (Warden) being able to go over its instance cap.
[*]Fixed Fiery Soul (Warlock) causing combustion for 0 damage on enemies who are not affected by Flaming Hells.
[*]Fixed several Nova skills occasionally changing their visual radius seemingly at random.
[*]Fixed Hand of Death not being affected by enemy DoT damage limiters when cast by enemies.
[*]Fixed most set-related passives being able to trigger without any points in the skills simply by reaching to 100% proc rate set bonus.
[*]Fixed several AoE skills and effects that would target dead, invulnerable, or otherwise non-targetable enemies.
[*]Fixed issue where companion evasion would just stack endlessly in some cases.
[*]Fixed x-mas trees flickering in dungeons (although I guess you won't see this until next year).
[/list]
[b]Locale:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added locale: items/CONTAINERS with container names and texts.
[*]Added locale: stats/STAT NAMES with names for Undead Slaying etc stats
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.96.0 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update adds a much requested way to remove single skill points instead of having to reset all of them at once. The skill reset Elixirs have also been removed, and you'll now either reset all points or remove as many as you wish by speaking to Korem in The Chronicon, or Tinka in Tinka's Domain (endgame). No more accidentally binding a full mastery reset to the belt slot (yikes!).

I've also added a few new items, a rune, and tweaked and improved several existing items by adding more interesting powers to them. 

In addition to this I've also fixed many reported issues and added a lot of requested quality of life features such as spell persistence between loading screen.

And finally, with this update the Holiday event is active! Help Tinka clear out the corruption from his secret workshop, and maybe find some fancy holiday equipment and a bag while you're there!

If the need arises, you can expect some smaller bugfixes in the coming weeks, as usual.

Thanks everyone, and happy holidays!

[h1]0.96.0:[/h1]
[b]New Feature:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now remove single skill points rather than doing a full reset!
[*]Skill and Mastery resets are now also free.
[*]You can reset and edit Skills & Masteries by talking to Korem in The Chronicon, or Tinka in Tinka's Domain.
[/list]
[b]Items, Runes, and Sets:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Items:
[list]
[*]Hammerblade (Templar) Legendary Sword (lvl 30+): Chance on attack to cast Hammerstorm. Hammer skills deal x% increased damage and attacks x% faster.
[*]Ring of Blades (Templar) Legendary Ring (lvl 40+): Any active Dancing Blade companions will mimic any Blade Conjuration skills used by the Templar, at x% efficiency.
[*]Dragonring (Berserker) Legendary Ring (lvl 40+): Damage taken from burn effects now trigger Molten Veins. The triggered Molten Veins' damage is increased by x% for each percentage of health lost from the damage taken.
[*]Hydraloop (All) Legendary Ring (lvl 20+): Chance on attack to summon a Rank 5 Magma Hydra.
[/list]
[*]Tweaked Items:
[list]
[*]Demon Claw (Berserker) now rolls +damage to Demons instead of attack speed.
[*]Wrathborn Helmet (Berserker) now automatically generates rage per second in addition to making it never fade.
[*]Flamebound Armor (Berserker) now also grants HPR via Embershield, which is tripled if the Berserker is on fire.
[*]Helm of Might (Berserker) now properly adds to the "rage based passive effect" stat rather than being its own special thing, so it is now additive with similar effects, such as Strong Bloodline (Mastery).
[/list]
[*]New Runes:
[list]
[*]Lesser Rune of The Dragon Flame: Embershield, Flame Roll, and Flamewrath deal x% more damage and no longer have a cooldown, but causes a burn on the Berserker that deals 1% of his Health as fire damage per second, for 7 seconds. This effect stacks up to 10 times.
[/list]
[*]Tweaked Runes:
[list]
[*]Lesser Rune of the Living Forest: Now also provides increased damage and thorns of Treants.
[/list]
[*]Tweaked Sets:
[list]
[*]Master's Command: set bonus companion damage increased to x5, up from x3.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an experimental buff purge to prevent snapshotting abuse and winding up glass cannon builds and switching to tanky builds/gear.
[*]Buffs/Debuffs displayed on your target now use shortened numbers for stack counts.
[/list]
[b]Monsters & Companions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added full sound effects for Imps and Little Devils.
[*]Enemies now grunt less frequently when being critically hit.
[*]Removed internal cooldown of thorns on Companions (enemies have a half second cooldown on thorn procs).
[/list]
[b]NPC's:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Tinka's missing proper dialogue options to both The Chronicon and Tinka's Domain (although he is still not happy to talk to you).
[*]Sarek no longer sells Elixir of The Mind and Elixir of Mastery.
[*]You now talk to Korem or Tinka (endgame) to reset Skills and Masteries, for free. They can also let you edit out individual points.
[/list]
[b]Performance / System:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved auto-save timings - "important event" auto-saves can only happen if no save has happened in the last 15 minutes. Stashes no longer read & write so frequently.
[*]Added controller disconnection detection and a rebind menu that pops up, so you can swap to a different controller or to the keyboard.
[*]You can now also once again swap between controller and keyboard via the pause menu.
[*]Added entry to help index stats about Companion Passive and Use Effect.
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a "spell persistence" system which should make all spells attached to the player follow them through portals and load screens.
[*]Affected spells are:
[list]
[*]Magnetic Blades (Templar)
[*]Magnetic Orbs (Templar)
[*]Magnetic Field (Templar)
[*]Dragon Storm (Berserker)
[*]Dragon Breath (Berserker, when using Firebreather)
[*]Magma Hydra (Berserker, when using associated Rune)
[*]Dragmageddon (Berserker)
[*]Toxic Storm (Warden)
[*]Nimbus (Warden)
[*]Circle of Affliction (Warlock)
[*]Fire Storm (Warlock)
[/list]
[*]Shield Throw, Exploding Shield, Molten Shield, and Shattering Shield (Templar) now lists their throw ranges and they are now affected by Reach.
[*]Dragmageddon (Berserker) now has a slight delay for each fireball dropped.
[*]Shrooms (Warden) of all kinds no longer perform line of sight (LOS) checks, because of their random nature and how they frequently plant around corners and pillars, thus meaning they'll more frequently land hits.
[*]Barbed Spores (Warden Mastery) now only grows Explosive Mushrooms, not Toxic or Hallucinative ones.
[*]Armageddon (Warlock) now has a 15/20/25% chance to reset the cooldown of Meteor/Firestorm/Inferno, up from 12/16/20%.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some minor issues in item generation leading to unintended results.
[*]Fixed Gargoylantuan not spawning during the Cursed Statues fight (probably).
[*]Fixed enemies spawned by Anomaly bosses remaining after the bosses die.
[*]Fixed issue with some stat tracking not being correct when applied to multiple players.
[*]Fixed pull effects sometimes doing a lightning line across the screen (I think).
[*]Fixed some power descriptions not listing spell ranks of auto-casted/procced spells and effects.
[*]Fixed Strong Bloodline (Berserker Perk) not being visually indicated on related skill cards.
[*]Fixed Toxicology (Warden) not properly refreshing DoT damage values vs weakened foes.
[*]Fixed Magma Hydra (Berserker/Scroll) targeting invincible or spawning foes.
[*]Fixed Carriers (Warlock Perk) not properly triggering.
[*]Fixed Charge (Templar) not listing its actual knockback distance.
[*]Fixed Alacrity's use effect (Templar) not correctly considering Aura Effect (stat).
[*]Fixed rounding error which could put you in a deadlock where neither effect would proc when using both Rune of Reaping and Sudden Death (Warlock).
[*]Fixed Plaguebearers dealing lightning damage on death (Warlock).
[*]Fixed AI and companion thorn cooldowns canceling each other out, so companions would at times get stuck in permanent thorns cooldown vs enemies with a thorns affix, and this not proc anything thorn-related.
[*]Fixed several enchants having very low roll ranges compared to their augment caps. (Enrage, Crit Heal, Burst, Kill Hoarder, Kill Explode, Kill Pickups, Kill Damage).
[*]Fixed issue where Sludge Threads would deal direct damage.
[*]Fixed typos, grammar, and coloring errors on skill, item, set, and rune descriptions, as well as clarifying some with multiple interpretations or vague descriptions.
[/list]
[b]Locale changes:[/b]
[list]

notes.title: Update 0.95.5 - Fixes and Fullscreen resolution options
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update should take care of most issues, and also adds a fullscreen resolution setting. This should help people playing on large resolution notebooks and similar, as you now should be able to lower the in-game resolution to gain a higher FPS.

I wasn't able to reproduce nor verify a few of the bugs, so if you have experienced any of the bugs listed as "possible fix" near the bottom of the notes, please let me know if this update helped or not.

Thanks for all the reports, suggestions, and comments!


Here are the full notes:
[h1]0.95.5[/h1]
[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an experimental fullscreen resolution option so you now can downscale for extra frames.
[*]Added fullscreen resolution detection to match desktop resolution, however you may need to lower it if playing on a notebook or similar.
[*]Improved visual of Divine Salvo with Council's Gavel (Templar).
[*]Improved tiling of many area types, preventing ground effects from clipping through ceilings of caves, canopies of forests, etc.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed controller detection on main menu not registering the left/right sticks.
[*]Fixed keyboard detection on main menu repeatedly detecting keyboard keys at all presses, preventing re-binding of keys.
[*]Fixed a large amount of typos and grammar errors on dialogue and lore texts.
[*]Fixed Warlock getting stuck inside pillars and walls sometimes when using Soul Warp with the click-to-move control option.
[*]Fixed The Cursed Statues in Dark Tower 3 not facing the correct direction.
[*]Fixed Gib enchants not being procced from companions and indirect damage.
[*]Fixed summoned companion skills, such as Dancing Blades, not properly re-calculating powers and stats based on companion count (and similar effects).
[*]Fixed effects based on companions not re-calculating after companions die.
[*]Fixed (probably?) the big boss not spawning in Dark Tower 3.
[*]Fixed issue where if saving took too long or too many things were in the save queue at once, a load operation could run on a queued file, loading old data which is then re-saved, meaning for example the stash eating what you just put in it.
[*]Fixed issue where players 2-4 couldn't see objectives of quests they were tracking that player 1 had already finished.
[*]Fixed several tile problems with trees and canopies.
[*]Possible fix for map corruption when repeatedly re-entering zones in co-op. (I still cannot reproduce this one, but it may have been similar to the stash saving bug)
[*]Possible fix for the Retaliating Companions rune power not always working. (Unable to reproduce as of fixing the summon/death effect recalculations of companions)
[*]Treant companions now have a smaller collision box so they are less prone to get stuck on corners.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.95.4 - Improved controller support for remote play, linux fix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update changes how controllers are detected and handled, so you can now freely pick controllers for each player, rather than having to use them in the order they are connected. You can also freely swap between controller and keyboard in the main menu, and your option doesn't get locked in until you enter the game. This also allows the new steam remote play to work as intended, so you can now co-op with friends far away!

The Linux build should also work again! Thanks to everyone for your reports, support, and patience in the matter. And special thanks to liberodark who, once again, solved the problem!

In addition to this I've fixed some of the issues you have reported.

Expect another fix or two before more content updates.

Thanks again for all the reports, comments, and suggestions!


[h1]0.95.4[/h1]
[b]Gamepad and co-op:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new experimental gamepad detection and assigning, which is a bit more fluid:
[*]You should be able to use any controller for any player.
[*]You can now seamlessly swap between controller and keyboard in the main menu, as long as you have not locked in controllers for co-op players.
[*]You now lock controllers to players in co-op in the order they press (A) to join, rather than the order the controllers are indexed.
[*]Player 1 locks their controller simply by using it to enter the co-op menu.
[/list]
[b]Loot Filters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Relic items are no longer filtered due to their rarity.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed "Primatic" typo on Prismatic Transmutation recipes.
[*]Fixed Flutterswarm (Warden Mastery Perk) giving inconsistent amounts of Evasion.
[*]Fixed crash from Wall of Fire (Warlock).
[*]Fixed Slimelings spawning and getting stuck in their spawn animations... again.
[*]Fixed Orcs very rudely covering large sections of the screen with speech bubbles commanding their Hyenas to tear you apart.
[*]Fixed issue where players 2-4 in co-op didn't get a visual confirmation when using radial loot (note: radial auto-loot currently only works for player 1).
[*]Fixed Halloween collect quests only updating for the player that collected the related items.
[*]Fixed damage number setting conflict with indirect/dot numbers and companion hits.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.95.0 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Update 0.95.0 is here to bring you new goodies and another step closer to release!
This update adds a much requested endless mode to the endgame, as well as a bunch of new items and runes! Some item sets have also been buffed, and other have been completely reworked. Of course, with the new anomaly mode comes a fresh new interface that makes it easier to select difficulty and mode, and it also provides some previously hidden information about monster stats. It's pretty neat. All to make the progression into the endless mode all the more enjoyable! 

Oh and this update also brings a [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9566989/4d1b96795722abc51997612ef6e3ad61a1b9a695.png[/img] Halloween Event [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9566989/4d1b96795722abc51997612ef6e3ad61a1b9a695.png[/img] which starts on the 20th! 

Also there are currently some issues with the Ubuntu build that we are trying to solve. Thanks to the Linux community for your efforts in the matter, and for your understanding.

And of course thanks to everyone who has posted bugs, suggestions, and feedback.

Anyway, I hope you enjoy this update!


Here's the full notes:

[h1]0.95.0[/h1]
[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*]New endless Anomaly mode.
[*]New Endgame interface complete with monster stats.
[*]New Halloween event.
[*]Updated and improved Anomaly bosses.
[*]New True Legendary and Legendary items.
[*]Set buffs & revamps.
[/list]
[b]Halloween Event:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a Halloween event complete with decorations, a new area, 5 new quests, new enemies, a season helm, and a rare drop relic from the new area.
[*]The Halloween Event runs from oct 20th to oct 31st.
[/list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted lighting so that lights fade slower, meaning less flickering with rapid cast spells.
[*]Improved monster clearing around Anomaly entrance portals (kinda).
[/list]
[b]Anomalies:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Endless Anomalies - these are similar to Dungeon Anomalies, except they start scaling at the max difficulty (Mythic XV), and each set completed allows you to advance to the next "Tier" beyond that. Each Tier is slightly more difficult, and by every 10th Tier monster stats will have increased by about 150% from the previous 10th Tier. There is no hard cap on tiers, and rewards also increment with each tier.
[/list]
[*]Updated Anomaly Bosses:
[list]
[*]Pyre: Faster attacks, now casts multiple Pyre attacks around the player.
[*]Clattergore: Now also uses Bone Cage and Bone Spiral spells (similar to Act 4 Bone Shaman).
[*]Deathchill: Now drops ice blocks beneath himself and distant players. These deal damage in an increasingly wide radius before fading away. Also tries to keep some distance with his Warps.
[*]Venom: Now put lines of sludge between herself and the player. Now correctly tries to get LOS rather than spam poison bolts at walls between you.
[*]Delen'Mer: Now uses a more dangerous and avoidable Arrow hail (ish) skill.
[*]Nek'rosis: Summons adds more frequently and also casts a lethal Bonestorm.
[*]Bramblebreanch: Now casts Bramble Vine very frequently, and also casts Vine Blast.
[*]Sparkhorn: Now summons a ton of thunder strikes in randomized patterns near and around the player. Sparkhorn also tries to maintain a slightly larger distance to players instead of repeatedly pushing them.
[*]Hopscotch: Now frequently spawns smaller spiders, and occasionally spits poison bolts and novas.
[*]Corpse-Eater: Now summons zombies, and eats them if they are not killed, restoring health. Also drops some hurtful ground effects on himself quite frequently.
[*]Magmuck: Now covers half the arena in lava, swapping sides each time.
[*]The Witness: Warps around rapidly and casts his dazzling shotgun spell like crazy.
[*]Ribshot: Now slows players with chills, and occasionally summons more skeletons to aid him.
[*]Sculptossus: Now occasionally summons large lethal rocks falling over the player.
[*]Blackfang: Now summons ratlings and charges the player when they get out of range.
[*]Grubb: Now creates a slowly growing lethal area of poison clouds.
[*]Boltfur: Now casts 3 randomly orbiting lightning orbs near the player.
[*]Eaglas: Now occasionally spams holy bolt novas very rapidly.
[*]Frostklaww: Now also casts Air Freeze on the player.
[*]Bazz-Wizda: No longer casts Fairy Ring, but instead casts Spore Rain.
[*]Wappa Zappa: Warps around rapidly using random projectile novas.
[*]Makrath: Now summons two orbiting lightning orbs that attract thunder strikes repeatedly. No longer casts lightning novas.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added info on status effects to the Help Index.
[*]Added a new endgame interface.
[*]Added a new save icon.
[*]Added new options to toggle companion damage and heal numbers independently from player numbers.
[*]Added new stat tracking to stats screen for best endless tier.
[*]The most recently selected Anomaly mode is now saved per-character and set upon opening the interface.
[/list]
[b]Items, Enchants, & Powers:[/b]
[list]
[*]Enchants:
[list]
[*]Added new enchants:
[list]
[*]Chance to stun (rings/boots).
[*]Chance to interrupt (weapons/boots).
[/list]
[*]Updated enchants:
[list]
[*]Bleed damage can now roll on staffs.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Runes:
[list]
[*]New Runes:
[list]
[*]Rune of Grand Reprisal (Templar): Increased passive effect of Reprisal, Retribution, and Retaliation.
[*]Lesser Rune of Simplicity (All): Base skills deal increased damage.
[*]Lesser Rune of Assertion (All): Doublecast passives have an increased proc rate.
[/list]

Hey everyone!

Long time no big update.. so here's one!

Some highlights are:
[list]

[*] New True Legendary items
[*] Several new Warden items

The next big update (0.95.0) will focus on adding more endgame content! And expect a few smaller fixes/tweaks between this one and the next, as always. I am also quietly and secretly making progress on Act 5, which will be out with either 0.99.0 or 1.0.0 :-)

Also, next week I will be moving to a new place which as of yet does not have an internet connection (yikes), so there be some radio silence for an undetermined time until I get that fixed. Just a heads up!
