notes.title: Update 0.93.0 coming next week!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!


I wanted to give you a progress update as I've had a lot of questions concerning the next update, and there have been some delays in my earlier estimates.

The next update will be live [u]next week[/u]! I have some fixes and polish left to do, but it's largely complete. Some bugs are more elusive than others, so if you are experience crashes in co-op mode I'd love to hear from you, as I need more information on those issues specifically.

The update focuses on fleshing out the Mastery system a bit with new perks and passive nodes in slots where the options are a bit thin currently. These perks and passives include some new stuff for niche or poorly supported builds, better utility support, some general stuff, and some stuff for mixed builds. A little bit of everything! I'm adding about 20 new options for all classes, and also improving a few existing ones to be more competitive to their options. 

I've also added a bunch of QoL stuff, tweaked the difficulties a little bit with health/damage balance, buffed a few items/sets that have fallen behind, and - as always - fixed a ton of recent issues.

I will also be including an [i]experimental[/i] performance fix for people using laptops or desktops with multiple or integrated GPU's who are seeing absurdly low frame rates.

Thanks for being patient, and see you next week!

notes.title: Update 0.92.0 - Engine update, performance fixes, new save system, keybind profiles, new loot filters, and much more!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while and I got a pretty big update for you!
This update upgrades a ton of internal systems and makes use of the most recent GMS2 engine update. So if you've experience framerate issues or the game running sluggishly, this update should (hopefully!) solve those issues!

If you're playing Chronicon on Linux, you may have to do some tweaks depending on your setup, as the updated engine targets ubuntu 18 LTS instead of 14 LTS. However, thanks to liberodark, Chronicon should support more distros without the need for tinkering. A big thanks to him :)

Additionally some major points of this update are [b]brand new loot filters[/b] that can be saved and shared across characters, computers, guides, etc! You can make one per character, or make several types of filters for different purposes, and switch between them from the pause menu from any character.

There's also a [b]new keybind system[/b] that works in the same way! Per character, per style, per whatever, really. Just set them up and select them from the pause menu. Easy peasy! Both the filters and keybinds are stored as plain text files in a json format (in your Chronicon save directory) so you can easily grab them and share them with friends or copy-paste their contents into guides, for example.

I've also written a new faster and [b]more reliable save system[/b]. It allows more frequent auto-saves, and should prevent loss of data if you experience a sudden shutdown or power outage. Pretty neat. Please also note that [u]starting the game after updating will convert all existing save data to a new format that is not backwards compatible[/u].

On top of all this, [b]Anomalies[/b] have been tweaked a bit (more to come on that front), many items have been given cool new powers, and I've added a few new runes and [b]legendary + true legendary[/b] equipment.

And as always I've fixed a bunch of issues - thank you very much for your reports, suggestions, and support!

As we draw closer to 1.0, I will have more news to share regarding progress, estimated time of "release", and upcoming pricing changes to the game sometime soon!

Enjoy!

Full notes below:

[h1]0.92.0:[/h1]
[b]Performance Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Engine updated to most recent which should fix performance and framerate issues revolving around vsync, high hz monitors, power saving settings, and many similar issues - please let me know how it runs for you!
[/list]
[b]New Save System & Format:[/b]

[*]Autosaves are now more frequent, faster, and safer
[*]An icon has been added to the top left when saving/loading data - don't close the game while this icon is visible!
[*]Data corruption due to sudden PC shutdowns or power outages should now only be a traumatic memory and likely won't happen again
[*]All data will be converted to a new format when launching the game after updating
[*]!Note: The new format is not compatible with older versions of the game!
[/list]
[b]New Loot Filters:[/b]

[*]Added new Loot Filter which can be customized to exclude any rarity (including TL) or misc item types outside of equipment
[*]The display filter and Radial Loot filters are now separate 
[*]A "default" loot filter is generated on first startup on 0.92.0 or later
[*]This can be copied and edited externally or in-game
[*]If there are no filters or the selected filter does no longer exist, the "default" is re-generated and used
[*]Filters can be found in the save directory
[/list]
[b]Keybind Profiles:[/b]
[list]
[*]Similar to loot filters, keybind profiles can now be set up and bound per-character
[*]Note: Changing the profile on one character changes it for all other characters who use the same profile, so if you estimate doing a lot of changes it's worth setting up a few different
[*]Also note that all controller/keybind settings settings, including co-op partners, click to move and controller options, are tied to the same selected profile
[*]Keybind profiles can be found in the save directory
[/list]
[b]Lesser Rune Drops:[/b]

notes.title: Major Content Update #7 - Endgame content, Mastery revamp, new crafting mechanics, and much more!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kcv30C4.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

Major Content Update #7 is finally here!
And it's a big one - in fact so big so the update notes don't fit in this announcement, so you'll find all of them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/1796278072840348391/]over here[/url].
You can also check out [url=https://youtu.be/7RyOBP06gws]this little video[/url] I made to see some cool new stuff and builds.


This update introduces a new Endgame system based around the old Anomalies, however now you manually get to pick the difficulty without having to slog through 2000 floors before your über build faces a challenge. :-)

Numbers has also been squished a lot to be more easily balanced and maintained in the long run, so if you were hitting in the trillions before, you will most likely not do that anymore, though you should be getting through content of the same difficulty at the same pace regardless. Also please note that [i]not all builds have been given the attention they deserve[/i], and there will be a lot of updates leading up to 1.0 that adds new powers, balances sets and existing powers, etc. to bring as many builds as possible to great power and fun!

[b]The Anomalies have been split into 3 different types:[/b]
[list]
[*]Random Anomaly - similar to the old system, with the exception that no bosses appear and they don't automatically scale.
[*]Dungeon Anomaly - generates a 3-floor anomaly with a similar layout on all floors, and ends with a boss fight in a dedicated boss room at the end. Rewards a big chest and special crafting materials and Runes.
[*]Elite Dungeon Anomaly - A Dungeon Anomaly but has a higher concentration of Elites and Champions, better rewards at the end, and you may not leave it until you are done, or die.
[/list]

[b]A new Rune system has been added:[/b]
[list]
[*]Runestones are received as rewards from Elite Dungeon Anomalies, and they can be transmuted with items with powers on them to extract the power from the item onto the rune. The Rune can then be transmuted with any item of the same type to apply the power to it, allowing double powers on items, or moving powers to those precious set items. Unique and Legendary items generate Lesser runes, and True Legendary items generate Greater runes - of which you can only have 3!
[*]Regular Dungeon Anomalies also reward Lesser Runes, however these Lesser Runes are different from the ones you create yourself. They can be applied to a wider array of items, and they hold new powers that aren't on any existing items! 47 such Runes have been added with this update, and more will be added over time.
[/list]

Here's a few examples of new runes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jSRCx2u.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/F0AHbLO.png[/img] 


The Masteries have been totally revamped as well, turning each node in the entire Mastery tree into a multi-skill node allowing you to pick and mix from a large amount of passives and perks. Perks are more powerful, single-point, passives that define, alter, or add to playstyles and mechanics. For the sake of balance, all Masteries except the base stat ones have been capped. However, the base nodes (the ones that increased with each point spent) now increase base skill damage rather than elemental damage, so regardless of how you spend your points, all your skills will improve.

Here's two example of the base nodes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tdgSiRw.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DHQP033.png[/img]


In addition to all this, there has ben a ton of general improvements and balance tweaks, many performance boost, bug fixes, and other general quality of life changes. Not to mention, a ton of new equipment has been added and many existing Legendaries have had powers added to them! Refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/1796278072840348391/]massive update notes[/url] for a full list of changes.

As always, a big thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports, suggestions, and helped to test everything for this huge update!

I'll keep an eye on the forums in case any issues arise - I hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Test Builds and Plans For Next Year
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As discussed in the previous announcement, I have some test builds up where you can try out the new features of the next update. I would like to invite anyone who is interested to check it out, and give an update on what the plans for next year is.

[h1]The Test Builds[/h1]
I've decided to invite everyone to the test build rather than make it a half-finished optional update, as there is still plenty to do so it would be a lesser experience. The test builds are different from the current live ones in a few ways:
[list]
[*]Separate saves are used, and no progress can be carried over to live, and no achievements can be earned
[*]Characters can be boosted to level 100 & mastery 1000
[*]All waypoints and content is unlocked
[*]Vendors carry all legendary sets, and a special vendor carry the new runes
[*]Crafting is largely free of cost
[*]There's various keyboard commands (listed on the Discord pins) to spawn enemies/items/other stuff
[*]Odd bugs :-)
[/list]

I call these builds "Tinka builds". (As reference to the Goblin in the main hub doing maintenance work)

These are designed to make testing easy and comfortable and can easily be tweaked to lock out features or classes for focused testing etc. Currently only a few (new) things are locked out due to not being finished and/or stable.

[h1]What's on the current test build:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New rune system with several runes for Templar and Warden, and a few runes for Warlock and Berserker (many runes are yet to be added)
[*]New endgame system based on difficulty leagues that you can pick from freely, although so far it's only the "Random Anomaly" version that is testable (basically the current system but with controlled difficulty) - it is soon to be expanded with "dungeon anomalies"
[*]The complete new Mastery system
[*]A lot of changes to the base skills - for Templar the changes are pretty significant with new skills, but for others its mostly about number tweaking
[*]A lot of bug fixes
[*]General performance tweaks, however please note that the test build is [b]*not*[/b] running the latest engine version that fixes the 144hz and other framerate issues, but the end goal is to have the update run on the latest engine version when it goes live
[/list]

[h1]Why should I check it out?[/h1]
[list]
[*]If you want to provide feedback or just see what on earth I've been up to all this time.
[/list]

[h1]How do I get the test builds?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Locate Chronicon in your Steam library, then right-click it and select Properties
[*]Go to the BETAS tab, and click the field to enter a code
[*]Enter tinkaistheking and click CHECK CODE to enter the special test builds
[*]Wait for it to download and you're off!
[*]To get back to the normal game you simply pick "NONE - opt out ..." in the dropdown-list under the BETAS tab where you entered the code
[/list]

Here's an invite link to the Discord where we talk a lot about the test builds, the games design (and bugs), and other ARPG's: https://discord.gg/nSKhPEA



[h1]Next year's plans[/h1]
Next year is going to be a big year, because next year is full release!
When? Can't say exactly - as this announcement alone is proof of, I always underestimate the time I need to finish an update, and I don't want to release an unfinished mess. But I am looking at the spring months currently, so I guess Q2 of 2019!

What's coming next year then? 
First off, the current test build is going to go live as soon as it's ready. Then I am working on polishing all existing content and also releasing Act 5 - the last act of the game. I will likely split this up in a series of smaller updates, adding new runes, items, tweaks, fixes, community suggestions, and the items on the roadmap, etc as I am quietly making progress on act 5.

[h1]What happens on release?[/h1]
Well you get the full game, that's what!
The currently lower price will also be adjusted - as is listed in the Early Access info on the store page the current price is with all the bugs and missing content in mind, so expect it to go up a bit on release. I will do another announcement on this when we are getting closer to give everyone an honest chance to grab the game in a cheaper state. The price isn't yet decided but it's not going to be anything crazy - I'll let you know exactly what it's gonna be when the time comes.

[h1]Post-release content and other plans[/h1]
I would love to add more content to the game after 1.0, both as free updates and larger paid DLC. Something that has been requested a lot is "supporter packs" with skins for your characters or other cosmetics, which I must say is very flattering (thank you!), and is also something I will keep in mind. Though my main focus for DLC would be expanded game features, mechanics, areas, and perhaps even a class or two. I am taking all your requests and wishes into account. I am also going to look at porting to consoles! 

The priority of these issues depend entirely on how launch goes so I can't say what's going to happen and when - just know that I'm keeping every option open and I want to keep supporting the game and the awesome community around it for as long as I can.


[h1]Time for some time off[/h1]
I'll keep an eye on the Discord, forums, and other social media, and reply when I can, but I am now going to take some time off. I might get bored and update the test builds a bit but other than that, I'll be trying to relax and spend time with family and friends for the next week or two.

I hope this year has been good for you, and I'll see you in the next one!

Happy Holidays!
-Squarebit

notes.title: Progress Report!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I figured it was a good time to do a progress update. I was planning to have the next update out before Christmas, but I've realized I just don't have enough time to do everything I want to before then.

I don't want to cut anything out either, so the plan now is to upload what I have as an optional update this weekend, so you can check out the work-in-progress new stuff over the holidays if you want to.

I'll resume work on it after the holidays and do a proper update as soon as it's done! I'll make an announcement when the optional update is available, and explain how to get it (don't worry, it's very simple!).

[h1]So what's in the next update?[/h1]
The next update has...
[list]
[*]A full Mastery rework
[*]Endgame/Anomaly rework
[*]A new endgame crafting mechanic called Runes
[*]Many tweaks and fixes
[/list]

[h1]A mastery rework? Is my build nerfed?[/h1]
Most likely not. If your build relied on an OP or broken mechanic/skill/interaction then it's probably nerfed in the sense that it is not OP anymore, however I've tried to keep everything "viable".
With big changes like these, the meta will change, new builds will emerge, and it'll require a few iterations to figure out what's fun and what needs work. So be sure to let me know what you think when this goes live! (Or join the testing, more on this at the bottom)
There has been an overall damage number "squish", so depending on how far you're into the endgame you might see lower numbers pop, but don't panic as everything is being tuned accordingly!
When designing the new Masteries these were my goals:
[list]
[*]Allow a wider array of builds (including adding better support for requested things like better companion build options and thorns scaling)
[*]Make things more fun by making point investment matter more
[*]Make future class changes/additions/tweaks easier to manage and balance
[/list]
And based on initial feedback on test builds, things are looking good!

Here's some screenshots of the new Masteries:
[i]A fully decked out Warlock Mastery[/i]
[img]https://imgur.com/8m9KK1L.png[/img]
Wait what? Caps everywhere but the three in the middle left?
Yup, because now you get bonus damage to all skills in the entire tree when putting any point in the related line, like so:
[img]https://imgur.com/xdLixmK.png[/img]
And the middle three lines doing this:
[img]https://imgur.com/pDpoAcV.png[/img]
Lets you build pretty freely and still always get stronger.


A new addition are the rhombus skills.. these are called perks!
Here's the final perk of the Corruptor line:
[img]https://imgur.com/Qwb6FKD.png[/img]
And the Class Masteries being the middle 3 lines, the only ones with skills without caps.. you still get powerful scaling without having to dump all points into a single skill, like before.

Here's a few other Perk exampels:
[img]https://imgur.com/RRUkHBG.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/uMttg7M.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/7niFLuM.png[/img]
Grand Summoner being one of the picks for the last perk for the Class Masteries...

What do I mean "one of the picks"?
Well...
[img]https://imgur.com/AS4LBvl.png[/img]
Ever single mastery works like the active skill slots in the regular skill trees - you get to pick what goes in the slot! And yes, that means all of them, not just the perks. [i]However there's currently a special synergy slot that only has 1 option[/i].

These are just a few examples from the Warlock class - every class has their own perks and passive picks. And they have a lot of them!

And here is the currently (work in progress) new endgame interface:
[img]https://imgur.com/gttHdEC.png[/img]


And a little peek at the Rune system:
[img]https://imgur.com/wlX6Jxl.png[/img]
[img]https://imgur.com/36XHx1n.png[/img]

And some good news for custom translations: I have also prepared all enchants and legendary powers for translators, as well as adding support for Cyrillic.


I think this update is going to be great :)


If you want to help test this as I am developing it, you are more than welcome to pop in on the Community Discord and join the "tinka builds" - special test builds that I frequently publish to gather feedback. All of the things I showed above are actually playable and available for testing there right now! 

There's a pinned message in the discord with instructions on how to opt-in for these test builds. Join the Community Discord here: https://discord.gg/nSKhPEA

I hope I'll see you there!



Oh, and on December 20th the in-game Christmas event starts - so be sure to check that out. Tinka's been up to no good again...

notes.title: Update 0.82.0 - New engine, new dialogue system, skipable cutscenes, endgame Transmutation recipes, new equipment, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Finally, I've completed the port to the new engine, and finished adding some new features and other goodies to the game!

This update has some cool new features such as skipable cutscenes, a small dialogue system where you can learn about various mechanics and lore (which means that Korem is monologuing a lot less for Act introductions!), a few new transmutation recipes for pushing Anomalies even further, and - as have been heavily requested - a few True Legendary weapons. There will definitely be more of those, so don't worry if this first batch aren't suitable to your playstyle or build.

As this is an engine port there will most likely be some weird bugs occurring that have slipped through testing. Nevertheless I'd like to thank everyone in the Community Discord who have sent me suggestions, bug reports, and done a lot of testing for this update. Thank you!

And, as always, thanks to everyone who have done the same here on the forums, and I hope to continue hearing from all of you as the game is progressing towards being complete!

With that, I can now say that I am looking **preliminary** at the first quarter of the next year for 1.0 and leaving Early Access. ːsteamhappyː

Next up is revamping the Anomaly system and adding more Endgame options, revamped Masteries, some new secret endgame crafting stuff, and Act 5.. in no particular order. Many good things ahead!

Stay tuned!


[h1]0.82.0:[/h1]

notes.title: Status Report: Engine Port & Next Update!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's been a while since I last made an announcement or released an update, so I figured I'd get everyone updated on what's going on!

As you may know, I am using GameMaker: Studio to develop Chronicon, and have been using the 1.4 version for a long time now. However, this version has now been discontinued, meaning it will get no more support or updates in the future. So I was left with no option other than to port the game to the new 2.1 version of GameMaker: Studio.

This version offers better performance and a lot of new tools to make my life easier, as well as many fixes for some annoying issues (yay!). But it also does a lot of things differently, meaning some of the stuff I was relying on no longer exists or has been changed fundamentally. So what might seem like a simple software upgrade turned into having to rewrite a ton of stuff, and in some place write entire new things!

This has been taking longer than expected, but I am now at a place where most things are functional and it's mostly just refinement, tweaking, and testing left. If you want to help out with any of the testing, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/4wrkxJv/]Community Discord Server[/url] and check out the pinned messages for how to opt-in to the special "Tinka Builds", where you get raw, buggy, versions of what I am currently working on. I'd love to hear how it runs for you, especially if you've had problems in the past with low framerates. If you've tested it before, there's a new version available as of this announcement.

There's also some new things coming with this update such as better (and skippable!) boss intros, a new dialogue system for NPC's, a few new Transmutation recipes aimed at endgame content, and some other neat stuff. Should be something for everyone!

The update will be released as soon as possible, but it's too soon to estimate exactly when. So stay tuned!

Thanks!


[i]Note: The Tinka Builds are currently Windows-only.[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.81.0 - Transmuting, Radial Looting, New Equipment, CD/MC tweaks, and much more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

As I was preparing to port the game to a new engine I realized I should probably leave you guys with some fresh content before I disappear for a while working on that, so here's a content update!

This update introduces a lot of new stuff.. could almost have made it a Major Content Update! Some highlights of this update includes the new Transmutation crafting NPC, Theo! He'll help you craft and combine new items from some known recipes.. and some from hidden, unlisted recipes that only the most clever and perceptive heroes will find. He can also help you modify your items in new ways, such as unlocking previously augmented Enchants, or empowering Legendary items to copy the base stats from True legendary items. All for the min/max :-) 

There's also some neat QoL features like "hotswapping" selected active skills, allowing you to pick one of their alternatives at a whim without resetting your point allocations. There's also a new Radial Loot feature, where you will loot everything matching your item filters (set up in the Gameplay options) within your Pickup Radius. Pretty nifty!

This update will also address some recent chance and concerns with my ongoing iterations of the cooldown and resource management. There's always room for improvement, but we have found a pretty good base for things now, I believe!

The game now also officially supports community translations to [b]Simplified Chinese[/b], and all skill descriptions and names has been added to the pool of external text, for anyone to take a look at and/or translate. Future updates will bring item text and the remaining in-game text to a readable format as well! [i]However the game does not ship with any translations at this point.[/i]

As always I'd like to thank everyone for continuing to support the development by reporting bugs, posting feedback, and sharing ideas!

I'll be around for the next few days to keep an eye on things and see if there's any bugs that need fixing, but after that I'll start the porting which, depending on how difficult ti becomes, may result in a bit of an update drought until it's done. But after that you can expect some big things on the horizon!

Stay tuned!

[h1]Update 0.81.0:[/h1]
[b]New Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[b]Transmutation:[/b]
[list]
[*]A new NPC has moved into The Chronicon, speak to him to learn about Transmutation!
[*]Many new items (equipment, consumables, relics) has been added that can only be obtained through Transmutation
[*]Unlocks account-wide after beating Act 3 on any character (yes, retroactively too)
[/list]
[b]Damage Stagger:[/b]
[list]
[*]This is a new stat available to all classes that staggers a portion of all damage taken over 3 seconds
[*]The Berserker has 15% Damage Stagger as base
[*]Damage Stagger is calculated after resistances, Damage Reduction, etc, but before Shields
[*]Damage Stagger stat stacking is multiplicatively calculated, like Damage Reduction, Evasion, etc
[/list]
[b]Global Damage Diminishing Returns:[/b]
[list]
[*]Slightly lowers damage of "shotgunning" effects that happen instantly on the same frame, by lowering the damage of each individual hit that frame
[*]Only affects direct damage, so skill procs etc remain unchanged
[*]It's mostly intended as a way to lower the amount of extreme damage spikes on the player, which along with Damage Stagger makes for a more smooth experience without "cheap shots" - especially in Hardcore mode
[/list]
[b]Radial Looting:[/b]

[*]You can now hotswap skills from the same skill slot in the skill trees, meaning if you for example picked "Cleave" instead of "Shield Slam", you can swap between them without resetting all points spent
[*]The hotswap can be done by right-clicking the skill in the skill tree (as you would when binding it) and clicking "Swap" instead of a hotkey
[*]Note: Hotswapping will clear buffs and companions just like the Elixir of the Mind does, so you can't hotswap between two different buffs (or ultimates) and use both - it is simply a tool to make rapid changes to your build with little effort
[/list]

notes.title: Major Content Update #6! Hardcore Mode, Cooldown + Ultimate skill Overhaul, Companion updates, new stats, items, and much more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Major Content Update #6 is here, and with it, the Hardcore mode!
And not to mention Linux support!

In this update I have changed [i]a lot[/i]. Needless to say you will likely have to tweak your builds a bit, but rest assured that you should be able to get even further now. The changes will be mostly noticeable if you make a new character, as almost all skill cooldowns have been lowered by 30-50%!

That being said, however, many stats have been made multiplicative, including Cooldown Reduction. 

Check out the excellent (and 0.80.0 compatible) builds on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/5/]Builds Forum[/url] - Rahlence and jon_12345 have both been very busy creating new builds and helping me test everything to make sure it all works well! A big thanks to you guys!

And thanks to everyone for your reports, this update should take care of all recent, and some of the more long term issues as well. This being a new major update, I'm moving to a fresh thread with bug reports, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/1696045708644616325/]found here[/url]. Let me know if you encounter any issues and I'll get right on it!

As always with these big updates, there will be a 20% off sale, starting tomorrow (April 27th)!


Below is a summary of the changes, since the whole update notes are too big to fit! You can read the full notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/1696045708644604287/]here[/url].

Enjoy!


[h1]0.80.0:[/h1]
[b]TL;DR:[/b]
[list]
[*]Linux support
[*]Hardcore mode
[*]Ultimate skills overhauled
[*]Skill cooldowns and damage differences improved
[*]Quest log improvements
[*]Quest tracker
[*]50+ new sound effects and improved sound & music quality
[*]Companion improvements
[*]CDR, MCR and effect duration are now multiplicative stats
[*]New stats:
[list] 
[*]Gem Strength and Satellite Damage
[/list]
[*]Base class stats adjusted
[*]Monster damage & AI aggression adjusted
[*]New & updated enchants + Legendary effects
[*]New Legendary and True Legendary items
[*]Difficulty rebalanced
[*]Drop rates rebalanced
[*]Fonts updated
[*]Skill + item cards updated to look better and fit smaller res / higher scaling better
[*]Improved performance
[*]More controllers supported natively
[*]Fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.75.0 - Warlock sets & skills update, performance improvements, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!


The last class update is now complete!
As expected, this one covers the Warlock and all his sets, passive skills, and also features some changes to both utility, companion, and ritual skills.

I also did a lot of performance work, so you should experience much less slowdowns and frame drops during larger and intense fights!

Another noteworthy change is that Shield/absorption effects are now visible on your healthbar, and will also absorb indirect damage such as burns, poison, bleeds - etc. As such, you will also find that the Warlock makes good use of shields in this update.

As always I've fixed all recent reported issues, and even managed to find and fix some of the more elusive, persistent bugs that have stuck around for ages. Hopefully I didn't introduce that many new bugs this time around :-)


Next up is taking a final pass at all the classes, focusing on the ultimate and companion skills primarily, but also taking a look at how some stats and enchants are used and distributed. You can expect ultimates to become a bit more streamlined and all around more useful for a wide array of builds, and companion builds to become stronger overall. I have some exciting and secret new features in the works as well, which I think you'll like! All of this will arrive approximately in mid-late April.

Meanwhile we are also working on the final act, but as you probably already know, it'll take a long time and there are many things to be added in first! I'll be sure to update you when any significant progress has been made.

And lastly I would like to thank everyone for their contributions to the Chronicon community and your continued support of the game!

I hope you'll enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update 0.75.0 - Warlock sets & skills update, performance improvements, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!


The last class update is now complete!
As expected, this one covers the Warlock and all his sets, passive skills, and also features some changes to both utility, companion, and ritual skills.

I also did a lot of performance work, so you should experience much less slowdowns and frame drops during larger and intense fights!

Another noteworthy change is that Shield/absorption effects are now visible on your healthbar, and will also absorb indirect damage such as burns, poison, bleeds - etc. As such, you will also find that the Warlock makes good use of shields in this update.

As always I've fixed all recent reported issues, and even managed to find and fix some of the more elusive, persistent bugs that have stuck around for ages. Hopefully I didn't introduce that many new bugs this time around :-)


Next up is taking a final pass at all the classes, focusing on the ultimate and companion skills primarily, but also taking a look at how some stats and enchants are used and distributed. You can expect ultimates to become a bit more streamlined and all around more useful for a wide array of builds, and companion builds to become stronger overall. I have some exciting and secret new features in the works as well, which I think you'll like! All of this will arrive approximately in mid-late April.

Meanwhile we are also working on the final act, but as you probably already know, it'll take a long time and there are many things to be added in first! I'll be sure to update you when any significant progress has been made.

And lastly I would like to thank everyone for their contributions to the Chronicon community and your continued support of the game!

I hope you'll enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update 0.74.0 - New Warden sets, skills, fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Here comes the Warden update!
All her sets and passives have been revamped, her masteries adjusted, and even some active skills have had some significant updates. If you play a Warden then this update is definitely for you, and if you don't, well, there's never been a better time to roll one!

I've also added a few tweaks to other things, and fixed all reported issues.

The low frame rates tied to energy saving / clock speed problems are still being investigated - thank you for being patient!

If you're on Linux, you'll also be happy to know that there's a functioning, although a little unpolished, Linux build available! It needs a bit more work before I am ready to announce full support. It's mainly targeting Ubuntu, but other distros may also work. Just logging on Steam from a Linux machine should get you the Linux version as expected.

Thanks for the continued reports and feedback, and a special thanks to the guys who helped me test the sets and Linux builds!

Hopefully I didn't break too many things and I'll see you with the Warlock update in a few weeks :-)


[h1]Update 0.74.0:[/h1]
[b]Anomalies:[/b][list]
[*]Killing an Anomaly boss now restores the player and their companions to full health, and removes any harmful effects
[*]Anomaly Bosses now remove all their lingering spell effects such as poison clouds and traps when killed
[/list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b][list]

notes.title: Update 0.74.0 - New Warden sets, skills, fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Here comes the Warden update!
All her sets and passives have been revamped, her masteries adjusted, and even some active skills have had some significant updates. If you play a Warden then this update is definitely for you, and if you don't, well, there's never been a better time to roll one!

I've also added a few tweaks to other things, and fixed all reported issues.

The low frame rates tied to energy saving / clock speed problems are still being investigated - thank you for being patient!

If you're on Linux, you'll also be happy to know that there's a functioning, although a little unpolished, Linux build available! It needs a bit more work before I am ready to announce full support. It's mainly targeting Ubuntu, but other distros may also work. Just logging on Steam from a Linux machine should get you the Linux version as expected.

Thanks for the continued reports and feedback, and a special thanks to the guys who helped me test the sets and Linux builds!

Hopefully I didn't break too many things and I'll see you with the Warlock update in a few weeks :-)

notes.title: Update 0.73.1 - mostly fixes and experimental 4K changes
notes.notes:
Hey guys!


This update is almost entirely a bug fix, taking care of all recent issues, as well as a few older ones. I've included some experimental scaling for those of you who play on 4K, as with some setups the game would run very, very poorly in this resolution. The scaling is on by default, and you have to tick "True 4K" in the Video settings to get the actual full 4K render, or it'll just upscale. However if you had problems with 4K before, don't tick that!

Please let me know how it works, as I don't have a 4K monitor to properly test it myself. :c

I'm also making progress on the Linux build.. I've gotten as far as it starts.. and freezes for seemingly no reason. I'm planning some public tests soon, and will have more info on that later!

Anyway, that's all for now.
Thanks for all reports and support!

Have a good weekend!


[h1]Update 0.73.1:[/h1]
[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an option to render in true 4K (default is now off - it used to always be on when having a 4K monitor, but it can lead to problems such as slowdowns, fps drops, and visual errors) 
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed inconsistent wording on various sources of % thorns
[*]Fixed Star Fall (Templar) not indicating duration

[*]Fixed quest "Chasing Mystery" not always updating properly

[*]Added a double check to quest objectives in multiplayer as they sometimes will only progress for one player (let me know if any newly obtained quests still get stuck)

[*]Fixed issue causing some doors and locks to remain locked even after an objective was met under certain circumstances
[*]Fixed potential crash and state issue with Eazima
[*]Fixed Ruh-Falkas children being able to push her into awkward locations causing some animation issues
[*]Fixed issue which may on rare occasions clone your satellite enchants
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.73.0 - New Templar sets and skill updates, community suggestions, fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

This update is very significant if you play Templar, as all sets and associated skills have been updated, and she's even got a brand new set! I've also put in some general tweaks and additions, as well as a few community suggestions, so there should be something for everyone in this update.

As always, I've also fixed a bunch of issues you guys have reported (thanks!), but lately I've been getting a lot of reports on things that are difficult to verify and find. Because of this, the known issues list is growing pretty large so I'm taking the next week or so to focus entirely on fixing bugs before continuing with the Warden sets & skills.

After the Warden update, only the Warlock remain, and after his rework I'll do a final pass over all classes and make some fine tuning based on your feedback. I'll also be taking a look at the Ultimate skills during this final pass.

Meanwhile, we (me and Jericho, the artist) have also begun work on Act 5, as well as a few other, secret things. As you may know I tend to work on everything at the same time :-). Act 5 will be the final act before 1.0 release, and it will also be the most cool, fun, and quite possibly largest. If you've been a part of the Chronicon community for a while you know the acts take a long time to do, so please be patient as we meticulously work our way forwards!

Anyway, let me know if you have any issues with the update, be it technical or design, and I'll get right on that.

Have a good weekend!

notes.title: Update 0.73.0 - New Templar sets and skill updates, community suggestions, fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

This update is very significant if you play Templar, as all sets and associated skills have been updated, and she's even got a brand new set! I've also put in some general tweaks and additions, as well as a few community suggestions, so there should be something for everyone in this update.

As always, I've also fixed a bunch of issues you guys have reported (thanks!), but lately I've been getting a lot of reports on things that are difficult to verify and find. Because of this, the known issues list is growing pretty large so I'm taking the next week or so to focus entirely on fixing bugs before continuing with the Warden sets & skills.

After the Warden update, only the Warlock remain, and after his rework I'll do a final pass over all classes and make some fine tuning based on your feedback. I'll also be taking a look at the Ultimate skills during this final pass.

Meanwhile, we (me and Jericho, the artist) have also begun work on Act 5, as well as a few other, secret things. As you may know I tend to work on everything at the same time :-). Act 5 will be the final act before 1.0 release, and it will also be the most cool, fun, and quite possibly largest. If you've been a part of the Chronicon community for a while you know the acts take a long time to do, so please be patient as we meticulously work our way forwards!

Anyway, let me know if you have any issues with the update, be it technical or design, and I'll get right on that.

Have a good weekend!

notes.title: Update 0.71.0 - Holiday Event, Berserker set & skill updates, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Happy holidays everyone!

This will be the last update of 2017. It features a neat little holiday event, available for characters level 10 and up, from which you can get some time limited equipment and other things. Mostly just for fun but it'll probably help your characters who aren't max level yet!

In addition to that this update also rolls out the first iteration of the updated sets and passive abilities. First out is the Berserker, with 8 fresh sets and a bunch of skill changes. The set updates are also retroactive so if you already have them you don't have to grind up the new versions.

Now, I know some of you have voiced concerns that because of these updated and very good sets, the game will shift and become heavily set oriented for end-game. This is partially true, as it will lean in favor of sets until near launch where I will be introducing more end-game features to allow deeper builds and itemization. So if sets don't float your boat, hang in there!

In addition to that I've made a few adjustments to progression and difficulty scaling of Anomalies, a few QoL improvements here and there, and a ton of bug fixes.

2017 has been a great year for both me and the Chronicon community, and I remain very thankful and proud of what we've accomplished together. 
Thank you for the hundreds, if not thousands, of bug reports, thoughts, suggestions and feedback you've sent me over the year. The next year I am aiming for 1.0 release and I hope you'll all be along for the ride!

That's all for this time, and unless I broke something (for which I will entirely blame Tinka), we'll see each other again in the next year. Exciting times ahead!

notes.title: Update 0.71.0 - Holiday Event, Berserker set & skill updates, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Happy holidays everyone!

This will be the last update of 2017. It features a neat little holiday event, available for characters level 10 and up, from which you can get some time limited equipment and other things. Mostly just for fun but it'll probably help your characters who aren't max level yet!

In addition to that this update also rolls out the first iteration of the updated sets and passive abilities. First out is the Berserker, with 8 fresh sets and a bunch of skill changes. The set updates are also retroactive so if you already have them you don't have to grind up the new versions.

Now, I know some of you have voiced concerns that because of these updated and very good sets, the game will shift and become heavily set oriented for end-game. This is partially true, as it will lean in favor of sets until near launch where I will be introducing more end-game features to allow deeper builds and itemization. So if sets don't float your boat, hang in there!

In addition to that I've made a few adjustments to progression and difficulty scaling of Anomalies, a few QoL improvements here and there, and a ton of bug fixes.

2017 has been a great year for both me and the Chronicon community, and I remain very thankful and proud of what we've accomplished together. 
Thank you for the hundreds, if not thousands, of bug reports, thoughts, suggestions and feedback you've sent me over the year. The next year I am aiming for 1.0 release and I hope you'll all be along for the ride!

That's all for this time, and unless I broke something (for which I will entirely blame Tinka), we'll see each other again in the next year. Exciting times ahead!

notes.title: Update 0.70.3 available - more fixes and more info about FPS drops (likely solution)
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Another day, another update.
Thanks for the continued reports - hopefully not that many issues left to solve now!

About the FPS drops: with the help of community member Rahlence, I found that the most likely cause for the sudden FPS drops is power saving settings. For some reason, some computers won't recognize the game running as needing processing power and keeps everything in a power saving mode. So check your settings, and make sure it's set to Balanced or Performance, and take a look at your GPU settings as well. More info here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/1291816880493891180/

Now it's just a matter of figuring out *why* some computers won't recognize the game. Oh well.


Anyway, here's the changes of this update:

[h1]0.70.3:[/h1]
[b]AI changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sandworms are now more likely to spawn in the burrowed state (outside of Anomalies), and will burrow more randomly
[*]Added a slight randomization to the "Nova" affix so enemies with it are less likely to burst you down instantly
[/list]
[b]Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed drop order of enemies so that they drop materials/gems/crystals before any loot
[*]Adjusted Magic Find scaling for difficulties and Anomalies - higher difficulty now give more bonus MF than before
[*]The Sandworms now burrow for shorter times and distance
[*]Korem will now direct you to talk to Tinka after finishing Act 4
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a possible bad spawn for areas within Deepwood
[*]Fixed entries to some desert areas like the Arena using the wrong image and appearing in the middle of walls
[*]Fixed Korem being reluctant to giving quests for Acts 3 and 4
[*]Fixed Anomalies unlocking after Act 3 (now unlocks after Act 4)
[*]Fixed bad chest spawns in The Orcish Wastes
[*]Fixed crash related to binding the interact key to the keyboard instead of mouse
[*]Fixed crash when hitting the inventory page hotkey (default "I") when being in a vendor page
[*]Fixed crash when using Intimidation after Soul Replication or when there were any active companions
[*]Fixed Trove being marked in the Hidden Cellar even though it doesn't spawn one
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes available! +info on unstable fps
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Thanks for your resilience and patience with bug reporting!
Was this one shaky update or what?

I've released two small updates since the major content patch which should solve most issues reported. If you find any problem please let me know in the bug report thread!

[h1]Please note:[/h1]If you're experiencing the game to be running slowly, choppy or having weird fps drops, please make sure you've checked "Alternative Synchronization" in the Video options! (Also please let me know if that worked or not)

Anyway, here's a summary of what's been changed:

[h1]0.70.2:[/h1]
[b]Options:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added options (Video Options menu) to enable or disable the heat, bloom, and water shaders
[/list]
[b]Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Player characters won't interupt NPC's talking so frequently
[*]Tweaked some vertex settings which may help with some FPS issues
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed crash when talking to Diana Jones if the Mirage quest had bugged
[*]Fixed crash from Lich's Touch accessory
[*]Fixed crash from companion pathfinding errors
[*]Fixed area corruption happening when taking return portals from a sub area and then trying to get back into the main area
[*]Fixed issue where several bosses would temporarily or permanently turn into zombies
[*]Fixed player being able to interact with self and dying
[*]Fixed Chantie and and Tarot saying "MISSING TEXT"
[*]Fixed Diana Jones sometimes having the wrong dialogue
[*]Fixed not being able to change windowed resolution in-game
[*]Fixed the window resetting its position after each load screen
[/list]


[h1]0.70.1:[/h1]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted Heat shader to not be as intrusive
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed crashes caused by skills being triggered by other skills or similar effects, such as the Storm Pendant triggering Nimbus
[*]Fixed crash from several other skills
[*]Fixed some quests failing to update and not being able to be handed in - if you have a quest that got stuck like this, simply do the objective again and it should update properly (in the case of acquiring an item, like the Pixie key for example, just dropping it and picking it up again should do the trick)
[*]Fixed some quests repeating themselves endlessly
[*]Fixed Diana Jones acting weirdly if you don't talk to her when first entering the Lushlands
[*]Fixed crash when generating The Lost City
[/list]

notes.title: Major Content Update #5 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's finally here - major content update #5!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7kbl0LKlAt8

This is a very big update and not only does it add the whole new Act 4, but it also adds some new content to all three previous acts, as well as a ton of polish to quests, bosses, areas, and more!

In addition to that, you'll be seeing many new enemies and Anomaly bosses and layouts, all with a *slightly* steeper difficulty curve.

Not to mention the all new Spell Scroll and Relic items... this is something you may see much more of in the future!

In addition to that, controllers should now feel even better in combat, the HUD got a slight update, enemies got their resistances re-balanced, most of the mute enemies now got voices, and there's a few new items for you to find.

[b]So what's next?[/b]
I'm working on a Linux port (finally), and I will also be working a lot with existing items and sets, and the mastery trees will see some updates. My focus on the next few updates will be to work towards a greater build versatility and improved progress & itemization.

Stay tuned!

[h1]0.70.0:[/h1]
[b]Act 4 released, summary:[/b]
[list]
[*]30+ new zones and sub-zones filled with new monsters, uniques, loot, quests, secrets, and more!

[*]20 new unique (named) monsters, many with their own unique loot drops
[*]14 new monster types, some making appearances as soon as Act 1
[*]14 new Achievements
[*]11 new Anomaly bosses
[*]Tons of new music and sound effects (100+!)
[*]Many new Anomaly layouts
[*]Act 1 and 2 polished and fleshed out with new quests, areas, and small in-game cutscenes
[*]Controller support improvements
[*]New item type: Relic. These items are special usable items that can be bound to your belt to be used (only a few exists so far)
[*]New exploration mechanic: Troves. These are chests hidden in a few optional areas. These chests contain more loot than Legendary chests and also give experience poitns when opened!
[/list]
[b]Anomalies:[/b]
[list]
[*]11 new bosses
[*]Added a large amount of new monsters from the new Act to fight
[*]Added many new layouts
[*]Improved existing layouts
[*]Updated sprites and animations of several existing Anomaly bosses
[*]The portal to the next area following a boss fight is now only revealed after opening the chest, so you don't accidentally enter it when going for the chest
[/list]
[b]Bosses (Story):[/b]
[list]
[*]Cael'is: Updated with new unique sprite and animations
[*]Feren'el: Updated with new unique sprite and animations
[*]Captain Moore: Changed fight with new mechanics, added new unique sprite and animations
[*]4 new unique boss fights added with Act 4, the later 3 having some more experimentally complex mechanics than before
[/list]
[b]Areas:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Caves:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted cave design somewhat to make more openings between passages
[/list]
[*][b]Rebalanced chest spawns:[/b]
[list]
[*]You'll now see more chests in optional/hidden/secret areas
[*]Some optional areas now spawn a guaranteed Legendary chest
[/list]
[*][b]Added Troves:[/b]
[list]
[*]Select optional areas in each Act spawn Troves, which are chests that contain even more loot, crystals, and materials than a Legendary chest, as well as a decent amount of experience points
[*]There are now new achievements related to finding all of these in each Act
[/list]
[*]Added Practice Dummies to The Chronicon
[*]Traps should now spawn some distance away from waypoint portals and other doors/portals
[*]Monsters now spawn some distance from your entry point in all areas
[*]Adjusted Shrine spawn rates (you should see them more frequently in later zones)
[*]Updated Chronicon tileset a bit
[/list]
[*][b]Unstable Dimensions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added two new affixes to the pool
[/list]
[*][b]Act 1:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new main area - The Temple Gardens, with a new Waypoint
[*]Added a new optional area - The Botany (found in The Temple Gardens)
[*]Updated story flow and progression - added many small cutscenes to make the story more coherent
[*]Changed how many main areas are connected in the later half of Act 1
[*]Removed Forgotten Chambers waypoint
[/list]
[*][b]Act 2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new main area - The Underwood Passage
[*]Added a new optional area - The Den (found in The Underwood Passage)

[*]Added new lights to Clairebourg Exterior, The Courtyard, and Royal Garden
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Character:[/b]
[list]
[*]Slowing effects on the player character now continue to fade during cutscenes
[*]Pull and knockback effects on the player character now either continue or abort during cutscenes, rather than freeze the player mid-air
[/list]
[b]Chronicon & Vendors:[/b]
[list]
[*]Moved Tinka to his next job
[*]The Gambler and Enchanter won't appear until you can actually make use of them, like the Gemcutter
[*]Removed the Enchanter's Codex quest, you now unlock her automatically when finishing Act 1
[*]The Gambler is unlocked by reaching level 10 as usual
[*](These changes won't affect you if you've already unlocked them)
[/list]
[b]Controller/Gamepad:[/b]
[list]
[*]Using skills that land on targets while not having any target will now default them to land on the player (unless it's a movement skill like Leap, then it will use the max range)
[*]Using skills that have a limited range (such as Leap) while having a target will now land that skill on the target, if within range, rather than overshoot - unless it's an utility skill like Hop or Soul Warp (they ignore targets)
[*]Default button mapping for all skill slots changed to be more comfortable
[*]Default sensitivty settings lowered to counter minor hardware defects & differences
[*]By default the player character will now also aim in the direction of movement (use left stick to both move and aim) - can be turned off in gamepad settings
[/list]
[b]Difficulty and scaling:[/b]
[list]
[*]Because of the additional story content, the experience gain growth from monsters has been adjusted to better suit the larger world (the plan is to aim for level 100 by the end of Act 5 in the end)
[*]The base difficulties (Casual - Legendary) now scales enemy health and damage slightly faster and higher
[*](Legendary and beyond scales at the same rate as before, but expect this to change in the future as the skills & item sets get updates/tweaks)
[/list]
[b]Enchants:[/b]
[list]

[list]
[*]Undead Slaying (Major)
[*]Spectral Slaying (Major)
[*]Fae Slaying (Major)
[*]Demon Slaying (Major)
[*]Beast Slaying (Major)
[*]Arachnid Slaying (Major)
[*]Crown Slaying (Epic)
[/list]

[list]

[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved visibility of target healthbar
[*]Added tooltips to health/mana/rage/souls bars
[*]Legendary chests (and Troves) now show on your map when the surrounding area is discovered
[*]Added hotkeys for opening the skill tree and quest log for keyboard, default is K and L respectively
[*]Slightly increased default text scroll speed (you can still interact again to increase speed)
[*]Added a new background for inventory and various interface boxes
[*]Added new character portraits
[/list]
[b]Items & Loot:[/b]
[list]
[*]Currency and Materials now animate much faster when dropping, allowing you to pick them up faster

[*]Adjusted drop quanities of crafting materials (it now caps eventually)

[/list]
[*][b]Added a new special item: Skill scrolls![/b]
[list]
[*]These are single use scrolls that cast a skill from any class
[*]There's currently 17 different scrolls of the rarities Enchanted and Rare
[*]These scrolls can be bound to belt slots, have a very short cooldown, and may trigger any passives, buffs, or enchants related to the skill/element being used
[/list]
[*]Added several new unique items dropped from the unique champions of Act 4

[list]

[/list]
[*][b]Legendary items:[/b]
[list]

[list]

[*]Weyrick's Finery: Always has one of each socket (in additional to random rolls, making a total of 6 sockets possible on this item)

[/list]

[list]

[*]Removed resistance penalties from minion monsters as they are already weaker (less health and damage)

[/list]

notes.title: Major Content Update #5 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's finally here - major content update #5!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7kbl0LKlAt8

This is a very big update and not only does it add the whole new Act 4, but it also adds some new content to all three previous acts, as well as a ton of polish to quests, bosses, areas, and more!

In addition to that, you'll be seeing many new enemies and Anomaly bosses and layouts, all with a *slightly* steeper difficulty curve.

Not to mention the all new Spell Scroll and Relic items... this is something you may see much more of in the future!

In addition to that, controllers should now feel even better in combat, the HUD got a slight update, enemies got their resistances re-balanced, most of the mute enemies now got voices, and there's a few new items for you to find.

[b]So what's next?[/b]
I'm working on a Linux port (finally), and I will also be working a lot with existing items and sets, and the mastery trees will see some updates. My focus on the next few updates will be to work towards a greater build versatility and improved progress & itemization.

Stay tuned!

[h1]0.70.0:[/h1]
[b]Act 4 released, summary:[/b]
[list]
[*]30+ new zones and sub-zones filled with new monsters, uniques, loot, quests, secrets, and more!
[*]20+ new quests
[*]20 new unique (named) monsters, many with their own unique loot drops
[*]14 new monster types, some making appearances as soon as Act 1
[*]14 new Achievements
[*]11 new Anomaly bosses
[*]Tons of new music and sound effects (100+!)
[*]Many new Anomaly layouts
[*]Act 1 and 2 polished and fleshed out with new quests, areas, and small in-game cutscenes
[*]Controller support improvements
[*]New item type: Relic. These items are special usable items that can be bound to your belt to be used (only a few exists so far)
[*]New exploration mechanic: Troves. These are chests hidden in a few optional areas. These chests contain more loot than Legendary chests and also give experience poitns when opened!
[/list]
[b]Anomalies:[/b]
[list]
[*]11 new bosses
[*]Added a large amount of new monsters from the new Act to fight
[*]Added many new layouts
[*]Improved existing layouts
[*]Updated sprites and animations of several existing Anomaly bosses
[*]The portal to the next area following a boss fight is now only revealed after opening the chest, so you don't accidentally enter it when going for the chest
[/list]
[b]Bosses (Story):[/b]
[list]
[*]Cael'is: Updated with new unique sprite and animations
[*]Feren'el: Updated with new unique sprite and animations
[*]Captain Moore: Changed fight with new mechanics, added new unique sprite and animations
[*]4 new unique boss fights added with Act 4, the later 3 having some more experimentally complex mechanics than before
[/list]
[b]Areas:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Caves:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted cave design somewhat to make more openings between passages
[/list]
[*][b]Rebalanced chest spawns:[/b]
[list]
[*]You'll now see more chests in optional/hidden/secret areas
[*]Some optional areas now spawn a guaranteed Legendary chest
[/list]
[*][b]Added Troves:[/b]
[list]
[*]Select optional areas in each Act spawn Troves, which are chests that contain even more loot, crystals, and materials than a Legendary chest, as well as a decent amount of experience points
[*]There are now new achievements related to finding all of these in each Act
[/list]
[*]Added Practice Dummies to The Chronicon
[*]Traps should now spawn some distance away from waypoint portals and other doors/portals
[*]Monsters now spawn some distance from your entry point in all areas
[*]Adjusted Shrine spawn rates (you should see them more frequently in later zones)
[*]Updated Chronicon tileset a bit
[/list]
[*][b]Unstable Dimensions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added two new affixes to the pool
[/list]
[*][b]Act 1:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new main area - The Temple Gardens, with a new Waypoint
[*]Added a new optional area - The Botany (found in The Temple Gardens)
[*]Updated story flow and progression - added many small cutscenes to make the story more coherent
[*]Changed how many main areas are connected in the later half of Act 1
[*]Removed Forgotten Chambers waypoint
[/list]
[*][b]Act 2:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new main area - The Underwood Passage
[*]Added a new optional area - The Den (found in The Underwood Passage)
[*]Updated story flow and progression - added a few small cutscenes and tied toegether the quest start/end points better
[*]Sergeant Jorgen now gives a specific key to his chest, which can only be opened with it
[/list]
[*][b]Act 3:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new optional area - The Dungeon (Found in the Lower Levels)
[*]Renamed Herb Garden to Royal Garden
[*]Added new lights to Clairebourg Exterior, The Courtyard, and Royal Garden
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Character:[/b]
[list]
[*]Slowing effects on the player character now continue to fade during cutscenes
[*]Pull and knockback effects on the player character now either continue or abort during cutscenes, rather than freeze the player mid-air
[/list]
[b]Chronicon & Vendors:[/b]
[list]
[*]Moved Tinka to his next job
[*]The Gambler and Enchanter won't appear until you can actually make use of them, like the Gemcutter
[*]Removed the Enchanter's Codex quest, you now unlock her automatically when finishing Act 1
[*]The Gambler is unlocked by reaching level 10 as usual
[*](These changes won't affect you if you've already unlocked them)
[/list]
[b]Controller/Gamepad:[/b]
[list]
[*]Using skills that land on targets while not having any target will now default them to land on the player (unless it's a movement skill like Leap, then it will use the max range)
[*]Using skills that have a limited range (such as Leap) while having a target will now land that skill on the target, if within range, rather than overshoot - unless it's an utility skill like Hop or Soul Warp (they ignore targets)
[*]Default button mapping for all skill slots changed to be more comfortable
[*]Default sensitivty settings lowered to counter minor hardware defects & differences
[*]By default the player character will now also aim in the direction of movement (use left stick to both move and aim) - can be turned off in gamepad settings
[/list]
[b]Difficulty and scaling:[/b]
[list]
[*]Because of the additional story content, the experience gain growth from monsters has been adjusted to better suit the larger world (the plan is to aim for level 100 by the end of Act 5 in the end)
[*]The base difficulties (Casual - Legendary) now scales enemy health and damage slightly faster and higher
[*](Legendary and beyond scales at the same rate as before, but expect this to change in the future as the skills & item sets get updates/tweaks)
[/list]
[b]Enchants:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Added new enchants:[/b]
[list]
[*]Undead Slaying (Major)
[*]Spectral Slaying (Major)
[*]Fae Slaying (Major)
[*]Demon Slaying (Major)
[*]Beast Slaying (Major)
[*]Arachnid Slaying (Major)
[*]Crown Slaying (Epic)
[/list]

[list]
[*][b]Reach:[/b]
[list]
[*]Condensed roll range, reduced maximum augment cap to 5/6/8/10%, down from 6/8/11/15%
[/list]
[*][b]Effect Duration:[/b]
[list]
[*]Condensed roll range, reduced maximum augment cap to 6/8/10/15%, down from 9/12/15/20%
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]

[*]Improved visibility of target healthbar
[*]Added tooltips to health/mana/rage/souls bars

[*]Added hotkeys for opening the skill tree and quest log for keyboard, default is K and L respectively
[*]Slightly increased default text scroll speed (you can still interact again to increase speed)
[*]Added a new background for inventory and various interface boxes
[*]Added new character portraits
[/list]
[b]Items & Loot:[/b]
[list]
[*]Currency and Materials now animate much faster when dropping, allowing you to pick them up faster
[*]Adjusted drop rates of gems
[*]Adjusted drop quanities of crafting materials (it now caps eventually)

[list]
[*]These items are special usable items that can be bound to your belt to be used - very few exist, all of them hidden, and more will be added soon
[/list]
[*][b]Added a new special item: Skill scrolls![/b]
[list]
[*]These are single use scrolls that cast a skill from any class
[*]There's currently 17 different scrolls of the rarities Enchanted and Rare
[*]These scrolls can be bound to belt slots, have a very short cooldown, and may trigger any passives, buffs, or enchants related to the skill/element being used
[/list]
[*]Added several new unique items dropped from the unique champions of Act 4

[list]

[list]

[/list]
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]

[*]Removed resistance penalties from minion monsters as they are already weaker (less health and damage)

[list]
[*][*]Bats, Spikehogs
[/list]
[*][b]Added new affixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Beast, Burrower, Reaper, Surger, Poison Bomb, Repulsive, Quaker
[*]Stags are now both Fae and Beast
[*]Bats are now Beast
[/list]
[*][b]Updated monster types to have the following resistances, weakneses, and bonuses:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Arachnid:[/b]
[list]
[*]Resist: Poison (+10%)
[*]Weak: Frost (-10%), Fire (-10%)
[*]Bonus: Poison Damage (+10%)
[/list]
[*][b]Beast:[/b]
[list]
[*]Resist: N/A
[*]Weak: Physical (-10%), Poison (-10%)
[*]Bonus: Physical Damage (+10%), Poison Damage (+10%)
[/list]
[*][b]Demon:[/b]
[list]
[*]Resist: Fire (+10%), Shadow (+10%)
[*]Weak: Holy (-15%), Frost (-10%)
[*]Bonus: Fire Damage (+10%), Shadow Damage (+10%)
[/list]
[*][b]Fae:[/b]
[list]
[*]Resist: Holy (+10%), Lightning (+10%)
[*]Weak: Shadow (-15%), Poison (-10%)
[*]Bonus: Holy Damage (+10%), Lightning Damage (+10%)
[/list]
[*][b]Mechanical:[/b]
[list]
[*]Resist: Physical (+10%), Holy (+10%), Shadow (+10%), Poison (+10%)
[*]Weak: Frost (-10%), Lightning (-10%)
[*]Bonus: Physical Damage (+10%), Lightning Damage (+10%)
[/list]
[*][b]Spectral:[/b]
[list]
[*]Resist: Physical (+10%), Frost (+10%), Shadow (+10%)
[*]Weak: Holy (-15%), Lightning (-15%)
[*]Bonus: Shadow Damage (+10%), Evasion (+15%)
[/list]
[*][b]Undead:[/b]
[list]
[*]Resist: Frost (+10%), Shadow (+10%)
[*]Weak: Fire (-15%), Holy (-15%)
[*]Bonus: Shadow Damage (+10%), Poison Damage (+10%)
[/list]  
[i]Note: Bosses have no weaknesses despite their visual appearances[/i]
[i]Champions and Elites may roll affixes to mitigate their weaknesses[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.65.2 - fixes and small tweaks
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Here's another update. This time it's mostly fixes of things you've reported in the past weeks. Thank you for the reports!

I am also making steady progress on Act 4, and as of this update I will focus entirely on it - unless something that needs urgent fixing pops up, of course!

Here's the full update notes:


[h1]0.65.2:[/h1]
[b]Companions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Companions should now respawn much more frequently
[/list]
[b]Items:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]The Skyshard:[/b] Now deals Lightning damage based on the impact damage of the skill that triggered it
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Curse of Doom:[/b] Now applies stacks which increase the damage dealt, refreshing the duration when re-applied and keeping the stacks, rather than resetting the damage bonus on each refresh
[/list]
[b]Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*]Damage Reduction now has diminishing returns by being multiplicative - this is as preparation for the stat to be more widely used in end-game in the future
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Corrected killstreak exp bonus
[*]Fixed some text errors in quests
[*]Fixed some skill description errors
[*]Fixed Comet and Meteor having a minuscule damage radius
[*]Fixed the option to show items behind walls resetting after restarting the game
[*]Fixed several issues regarding companion spawning and re-spawning
[*]Fixed Demon Lord set spawning too many Hellhounds in some cases
[*]Fixed Twister enchant not working correctly
[*]Fixed Storm Mender heals not hitting other players and other companions
[*]Fixed crash when using Root Veil
[*]Fixed consumables and bags showing a value of 0 when dropped
[*]Fixed anomaly boss Nek'rosis spawning his zombies inside walls in some occasions
[*]Fixed the Tome of Vengeance special effect not working
[*]Fixed some incorrect damage calculations of Dancing Blades
[*]Fixed some companions not updating their stats with the player 
[*]Fixed "invisible sockets" on items
[*]Fixed Cooling Off using the procrate of Frost Winds
[*]Fixed NPC unlock quests getting stuck if you complete them on one character while having them active on another
[*]Fixed Mysterious Garden generating too large areas to fit the minimap
[*]Fixed Doublecast not triggering properly

notes.title: Update 0.65.0 Available! New item powers, tons of balance changes, QoL changes, bug fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Thanks for all the feedback and bug reports! This update is heavily based on that, and as such it mostly concerns balance changes to both items and skills, and tons of fixes and quality of life changes. 

There are also 15 new item powers added to Unique and Legendary items! Some of these are completely new, and others are reworked to be more useful and interesting, such as the Jeopardy ring.

With all this in mind, this is a pretty big update, and as per usual that means increased likelyhood that bugs slipped through my testing.

However, I did fix a ton of issues - even some of the more elusive crashes, so I'm hoping for a more stable experience for everyone. Please let me know about any bug or crash that you experience! The more info the easier it is to locate and fix.

Sadly the Windows 10 issues with black/white screens persist, as there has as of yet not been an update to the GameMaker engine. If you have any of these issues, please consult the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/1291816880493891180/]Troubleshooting thread[/url] for temporary workarounds. Hopefully there will be an update soon so we can take care of this for good :)

I will monitor the forums and dedicate the next few days for hotfixing, should it be necessary, so we all can enjoy this solstice weekend!

After any potential issues have been resolved, I will continue work with Act 4. 
It's gonna be a good one!

Anyway - that's all for now. I hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Windows 10 Creators Update issues!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's been brought to my attention that if you have the Windows 10 Creators Update, the game will just turn into a black screen.

Luckily, this can easily be fixed by running the game in compatibility mode for Windows 7!

If you don't know how to do  this, here's a quick guide:

[olist]
[*]Right click Chronicon in your Steam library
[*]Select "Properties"
[*]Go into the "Local Files" tab
[*]Click "Browse Local Files"
[*]Right-click Chronicon.exe
[*]Select "Properties"
[*]Click the "Compatibility" tab
[*]Check "Run in compatibility mode for"
[*]Select Windows 7 in the drop-down list
[*]Hit accept and run the game!
[/olist]


Meanwhile I'll try to figure out why this happens.
Thanks!
