notes.title: Update 0.64.0 available! Sockets, Gems, Material autoloot.. and much more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Long time no update!

Well, it's finally done - update 0.64.0 is here to bring you autolooting of crafting materials, the new socket & gem mechanic, account-wide anomaly progression, money, and material sharing, and much more!

As always there is going to be some issues popping up - just let me know in the bug reports thread and I'll get on fixing them ASAP!

There are many reported issues that haven't yet been fixed because I've had trouble reproducing them to figure out what's wrong. I decided to release this update and then carry on with fixes while you enjoy the new features, rather than hold it for another week or two.

Anyway, that's it for now!

As always, thanks for all the suggestions & bug reports!

Here's the full notes for  this update:

[h1]0.64.0:[/h1]
[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*]New crafting & item mechanic: sockets & gems!
[*]Monsters, bosses, and chests can now drop special Gems!
[*]Find gems and visit Gemma in The Chroncion, and she'll be able to add/change sockets on your equipment, as well as insert gems for you. For a price!
[*][i]Note: Gemma only appears after you've killed Captain Moore & completed the associated quest.[/i]
[*]Auto-pickup of crafting materials
[*]Crafting materials no longer take inventory space
[*]Crafting materials, gems, and currency is now shared across all characters automatically
[*]Anomaly progression and availability is now "account wide", so once you've unlocked it on any single character, all your characters can access it
[/list]
[b]Anomalies:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now account wide, so you only need to unlock the Anoamlies on one character
[*]Progression is done on each character independently as before, however you now have the option to skip ahead to the maximum reached on any of your characters, by using the elixirs sold in Tinka's Domain
[*]The character's and account's maximum Anomaly level can be found on your stat chart, near the bottom
[*]The special Anomaly elixirs are now available at level 1
[*]Note: These will be removed entirely in a future update and replaced with something more convenient
[/list]
[b]Crafting:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enchanting:[/b]
[list]
[*]Rebalanced material costs for enchanting, particularly for Legendary items
[/list]
[*][b]Socketing:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added sockets and gems
[*]Sockets may roll on any item dropped after this update, and may be applied existing equipment by talking to Gemma in the Chronicon
[*]Sockets are of three types: Sphere, Cube, and Star, with Star sockets being more rare and having slightly different effects
[*]Gems are of the same three types and must be matched with the sockets
[*]Gems also come in 3 different rarities: Rough, Cut, and Polished (ordinary/enchanted/rare) and can be combined to reach the next level of rarity (up to Polished)
[*][b]Gems will have different effects in different types of equipment, based on the following equipment groups:[/b]
[list]
[*]1) Helm, Armor, Boots
[*]2) Amulet, Ring, Accessory
[*]3) Weapon, Offhand
[*]Different item types may roll different amounts of sockets, with Armors rolling up to 3 sockets, and Boots only rolling 1
[*]Items always roll the maximum amount of sockets they can, the only difference is the combination of socket types.
[*][i]Note: Star sockets often count as more than one socket, so an item being able to roll 2 cube sockets, will only roll 1 star socket.[/i]
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Crafting Materials:[/b]
[list]
[*]Are now automatically picked up like Crystals
[*]No longer take inventory space, and are instead kept in a separate self-managed inventory
[*]Can no longer be sold
[*]Changed their sprites slightly
[*]All of this also applies to the new Gems
[/list]
[b]Crystals:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now groups together if adjacent, creating large clusters of crystals, improving performance
[*]The floating numbers on crystal pickup no longer stacks and instead replaces eachother for less clutter
[/list]
[b]Enchants:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated descriptions of many enchants to be more clear
[*]Bleed on hit: Now guaranteed to trigger, instead of having a 25% chance
[*]Explode on low health: Now deals Ethereal damage
[*]Frost Nova: Now releases a proper Frost Nova rather than a nova of Ice Spears
[*]Health Regeneration: Increased augment caps
[*]Mana Regeneration: Increased augment caps
[*][b]Updated the following Enchants to use percentages instead of direct values:[/b]
[list]
[*]Thunderous Orb
[*]Frozen Orb
[*]Molten Orb
[*]Voodoo Orb
[*]Angelic Orb
[*]Twister
[*]Hellfire
[*]Burst
[*]Kill Restoration
[*]Kill Recharge
[*]Kill Healing
[*]Gib Heal
[*]Gib Regeneration
[*]Frost Nova
[*]Holy Nova
[*]Death Nova
[*]Discharge
[*]Hurt Poison
[*]Hurt Burn
[*]Sludge Threads
[*]Low Health Explode
[*][i]Note: All your equipment should be automatically updated with the new enchants to reflect these changes, as well as unlocking them, should you want to scramble them. Please submit a report if you still have old versions of the enchants listed above![/i]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Equipment:[/b]
[list]
[*]The value of equipment now grows with higher rolled enchants
[*]Augmenting equipment increases its value
[*]Gems & Sockets does not affect value
[*]Mary's Mirror: now rolls Bleed Damage instead of Physical Damage
[*]Mollug's One Ring: The Goblin companion now benefits from the highest element stat rather than Physical damage. Updated description.
[*]Bat Bat: Now also rolls a Molten Orb enchant.
[*]Sludge Treaders: Now also rolls Poison Damage
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Crafting materials are now listed on the side of the Enchanting interface
[*]Tweaked the display of enchants in the Enchanting interface with new colored icons
[*]Added a dark background behind unclaimed bag slots
[*]Added tabs for 3 separate inventories: the default inventory, materials inventory, and gems inventory
[*]Equipment locked to other classes now have a small padlock icon on them
[*]Adjusted some text positioning on skill info cards
[*]Adjusted Physical damage color
[*]Added option for short numbers (enabled by default), shortening for example 1,500,000 to 1.5M
[/list]
[b]Killstreaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new announcement on an extreme level..
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Saving Cards (f10) now plays a sound
[*]Card images are now saved with the skill or item name as file name
[*]Volume sliders now increment with 5% instead of 10%

notes.title: Update 0.64.0 available! Sockets, Gems, Material autoloot.. and much more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Long time no update!

Well, it's finally done - update 0.64.0 is here to bring you autolooting of crafting materials, the new socket & gem mechanic, account-wide anomaly progression, money, and material sharing, and much more!

As always there is going to be some issues popping up - just let me know in the bug reports thread and I'll get on fixing them ASAP!

There are many reported issues that haven't yet been fixed because I've had trouble reproducing them to figure out what's wrong. I decided to release this update and then carry on with fixes while you enjoy the new features, rather than hold it for another week or two.

Anyway, that's it for now!

As always, thanks for all the suggestions & bug reports!

Here's the full notes for  this update:

[h1]0.64.0:[/h1]
[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*]New crafting & item mechanic: sockets & gems!
[*]Monsters, bosses, and chests can now drop special Gems!
[*]Find gems and visit Gemma in The Chroncion, and she'll be able to add/change sockets on your equipment, as well as insert gems for you. For a price!
[*][i]Note: Gemma only appears after you've killed Captain Moore & completed the associated quest.[/i]
[*]Auto-pickup of crafting materials
[*]Crafting materials no longer take inventory space
[*]Crafting materials, gems, and currency is now shared across all characters automatically
[*]Anomaly progression and availability is now "account wide", so once you've unlocked it on any single character, all your characters can access it
[/list]
[b]Anomalies:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now account wide, so you only need to unlock the Anoamlies on one character
[*]Progression is done on each character independently as before, however you now have the option to skip ahead to the maximum reached on any of your characters, by using the elixirs sold in Tinka's Domain
[*]The character's and account's maximum Anomaly level can be found on your stat chart, near the bottom
[*]The special Anomaly elixirs are now available at level 1
[*]Note: These will be removed entirely in a future update and replaced with something more convenient
[/list]
[b]Crafting:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enchanting:[/b]
[list]
[*]Rebalanced material costs for enchanting, particularly for Legendary items
[/list]
[*][b]Socketing:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added sockets and gems
[*]Sockets may roll on any item dropped after this update, and may be applied existing equipment by talking to Gemma in the Chronicon
[*]Sockets are of three types: Sphere, Cube, and Star, with Star sockets being more rare and having slightly different effects
[*]Gems are of the same three types and must be matched with the sockets
[*]Gems also come in 3 different rarities: Rough, Cut, and Polished (ordinary/enchanted/rare) and can be combined to reach the next level of rarity (up to Polished)
[*][b]Gems will have different effects in different types of equipment, based on the following equipment groups:[/b]
[list]
[*]1) Helm, Armor, Boots
[*]2) Amulet, Ring, Accessory
[*]3) Weapon, Offhand
[*]Different item types may roll different amounts of sockets, with Armors rolling up to 3 sockets, and Boots only rolling 1
[*]Items always roll the maximum amount of sockets they can, the only difference is the combination of socket types.
[*][i]Note: Star sockets often count as more than one socket, so an item being able to roll 2 cube sockets, will only roll 1 star socket.[/i]
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Crafting Materials:[/b]
[list]
[*]Are now automatically picked up like Crystals
[*]No longer take inventory space, and are instead kept in a separate self-managed inventory
[*]Can no longer be sold
[*]Changed their sprites slightly
[*]All of this also applies to the new Gems
[/list]
[b]Crystals:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now groups together if adjacent, creating large clusters of crystals, improving performance
[*]The floating numbers on crystal pickup no longer stacks and instead replaces eachother for less clutter
[/list]
[b]Enchants:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated descriptions of many enchants to be more clear
[*]Bleed on hit: Now guaranteed to trigger, instead of having a 25% chance
[*]Explode on low health: Now deals Ethereal damage
[*]Frost Nova: Now releases a proper Frost Nova rather than a nova of Ice Spears
[*]Health Regeneration: Increased augment caps
[*]Mana Regeneration: Increased augment caps
[*][b]Updated the following Enchants to use percentages instead of direct values:[/b]
[list]
[*]Thunderous Orb
[*]Frozen Orb
[*]Molten Orb
[*]Voodoo Orb
[*]Angelic Orb
[*]Twister
[*]Hellfire
[*]Burst
[*]Kill Restoration
[*]Kill Recharge
[*]Kill Healing
[*]Gib Heal
[*]Gib Regeneration
[*]Frost Nova
[*]Holy Nova
[*]Death Nova
[*]Discharge
[*]Hurt Poison
[*]Hurt Burn
[*]Sludge Threads
[*]Low Health Explode
[*][i]Note: All your equipment should be automatically updated with the new enchants to reflect these changes, as well as unlocking them, should you want to scramble them. Please submit a report if you still have old versions of the enchants listed above![/i]
[/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*]The value of equipment now grows with higher rolled enchants
[*]Augmenting equipment increases its value
[*]Gems & Sockets does not affect value
[*]Mary's Mirror: now rolls Bleed Damage instead of Physical Damage
[*]Mollug's One Ring: The Goblin companion now benefits from the highest element stat rather than Physical damage. Updated description.
[*]Bat Bat: Now also rolls a Molten Orb enchant.
[*]Sludge Treaders: Now also rolls Poison Damage
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Crafting materials are now listed on the side of the Enchanting interface
[*]Tweaked the display of enchants in the Enchanting interface with new colored icons
[*]Added a dark background behind unclaimed bag slots
[*]Added tabs for 3 separate inventories: the default inventory, materials inventory, and gems inventory
[*]Equipment locked to other classes now have a small padlock icon on them
[*]Adjusted some text positioning on skill info cards
[*]Adjusted Physical damage color
[*]Added option for short numbers (enabled by default), shortening for example 1,500,000 to 1.5M
[/list]
[b]Killstreaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new announcement on an extreme level..
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Saving Cards (f10) now plays a sound
[*]Card images are now saved with the skill or item name as file name
[*]Volume sliders now increment with 5% instead of 10%

[*]Tainted Blood: Now adds a minimum of 1 point per rank, even on low levels before it has a chance to grow with the player's level.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased base mana regeneration for all classes
[/list]
[b]Unstable Dimensions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now roll monster spawns just like Anomalies, giving a randomized selection of 5 different types, rather than using the monsters in the current zone
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with save conversion and backwards compatibilty allowing duping of items

notes.title: Update 0.63.4 available! Tweaks, fixes, & more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Here's another update for you.
It was mainly going to be a bugfix update but I threw in some small QoL things and some Anomaly tweaks too. I've fixed most reported issues, but I continue to investigate the cause for save file corruption.

[b]Important:[/b] Steam Cloud has been temporarily disabled as a result of my investigation. Please let me know if you experience save file corruption *after* updating!

Also, as the [url=http://chronicon.wikia.com/wiki/Chronicon_Wiki]Wikia page[/url], guides, and builds discussions are growing, I have included a way in the game for you easily save images of skills & items. I wrote a short guide on how to do it here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=880583004


I have also updated the Enchanting guide to reflect all the recent changes that has been made to Enchanting.

Next up is update 0.64.0, which will feature some new mechanics for inventory, loot, item, and crafting... stay tuned for more info on that!

I hope you enjoy this update!



Here's the full notes for this update:

[h1]0.63.4:[/h1]
[b]Anomalies & Progression:[/b]
[list]
[*]Completing an Anomaly now grants some experience, based on the level of the anomaly
[*]Added a base +100% Magic Find in Anomalies, regardless of level
[*]Adjusted killstreak experience bonuses
[*]Anomaly reward chests are now more rewarding earlier on, dropping additional items at a steeper rate
[*]Anomaly reward chests now have a cap in the number of items they drop, but instead they get a significant boost to the chance of having Legendary (and better) equipment with each Anomaly level
[/list]
[b]Boss:[/b]
[list]
[*]Captain Moore:
[list]
[*]Remove his strong insta-hit abilities, will get new skills later on
[/list]
[*]Maddoc:
[list]
[*]Added target circles for his leap ability
[/list]
[*]Sculptossus (Anomaly):
[list]
[*]Adjusted damage output to be more on par with other bosses
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Controllers:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated controller vibration setting to only vibrate when on low health and receiving critical hits
[*]Added a slight vibration when being resurrected
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Skills now list the requirement amount of points needed to be unlocked
[*]Slightly adjusted the HUD position of players 3 and 4 to account for the zone info and version box
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tweaked damage of Bomber affix
[*]Tweaked health value of Wailing Scholars to be more on par with similar foes
[/list]
[b]Movement:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted movement speed penalty of running into walls
[/list]
[b]Sound:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted overall sound volumes & noise, you may need to tweak your settings
[*]Added spawn sounds to portals created when killing bosses
[/list]
[b]Stats & Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased MF cap to 999%
[*]Thorns can now crit
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed enemies triggering special death effects like explosive when being killed by an Anomaly boss spawn
[*]Fixed inconsistent wording on Critical Hit (was often called Critical Strike)
[*]Fixed Critical Hit Chance enchant being labelled "critrate"
[*]Fixed Crafting Materials appearing on minimap after re-entering the zone
[*]Fixed skill Meteor being considered a Bane skill (it is now Sorcery)
[*]Fixed skill Firestorm being considered a Sorcery skill (it is now Bane)
[*]Fixed Soul Thief not working
[*]Fixed Rituals, Buffs, and other effects sometimes being applied twice, giving incorrect results
[*]Fixed several issues in the Enchanting interface resulting in item duping and corruption
[*]Fixed The Crumbling Reliquary challenge area acting weird
[*]Fixed frame drops when players died in co-op
[*]Fixed extremely long resurrection times in multiplayer
[*]Fixed the Vault key dropping even if the quest was finished, allowing you to open the Vault infinitely
[*]Fixed the personal stash being greyed out while other player was in shared stash tabs
[*]Fixed rare crashing issue with special boss spells
[*]Fixed a crash that may occur of save data was somehow edited during runtime between the last save and the current save
[*]Fixed issue where players were unable to interact with some doors or portals when there was nearby loot and using controller
[*]Fixed slimes having too small hitboxes
[*]Fixed some interaction problems with click to move
[*]Fixed Unstable Dimension portals spawning directly on top of players
[*]Fixed Berserker being able to leap into walls and get stuck
[*]Fixed rare issue causing AI to get stuck on wall edges
[*]Fixed some general issues with wall collisions being slightly offset
[*]Fixed issue with Explosive Punch and Thunder Punch causing the Berserker to get stuck if his movement was somehow altered during the punch
[*]Fixed similar issue with the Templar and her Slice, Charge, and Tackle skills
[*]Fixed Act 2 boss locks (the vines) doing strange things and creating trees when re-entering boss areas after having defeated a boss
[*]Fixed Maddoc's intro speech ignoring the voice volume setting
[*]Fixed Accessory items not rolling Epic enchant(s)
[*]Fixed crash on loading save files from version 0.20.0 (mad old)
[*]Fixed some unresponsiveness issues with click to move
[*]Fixed being able to walk into and through walls & void with click to move when having a movement speed of over 280%
[*]Fixed chests spamming "its locked"
[*]Fixed locked chests triggering traps even if you didn't unlock it
[*]Fixed issue with elemental resistance calculations and Elementium Armor and some other special items
[/list]

Hey guys!

notes.title: Update 0.63.0: New minimap, stash tabs, quick reset for zones, fixes, and much more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

First of all I would like to welcome all new players to our community!
We had a massive influx of players over the last weekend due to a partnership with Chrono.gg, and notably because of the coverage made by Youtuber and streamer, ZiggyD - a big thanks to you guys!

Anyway, the long awaited update 0.63.0 is here!

This one features many requested things such as a [b]better minimap[/b], [b]stash tabs[/b], and the ability to [b]reset zones[/b] easily!

There are also a ton of fixes, tweaks, balance changes, and a few additions here and there, such as a couple of new enchants.

Most reported issues have been fixed and I will devote the next week to keep squashing bugs, old and new. 

Thank you all very much for your thorough reports here on the Steam forums, on reddit, and by email. Special thanks to people going the extra mile and sending me their save files for easy debugging!

Anyway, here's the full update notes.
Enjoy!

[h1]0.63.0:[/h1]
[b]New content:[/b]
[list]
[b]Added stash tabs![/b]
[list]
[*]The stash now has 4 full tabs, each holding 80 slots, giving you a grand total of 320 slots to use - if you can afford it
[*]Stash tabs are automatically added as you purchase more rows like before
[*]You can move items between tabs freely, and the auto sort button sorts the current open tab only
[/list]
[b]Added a new minimap system![/b]
[list]
[*]The default minimap now goes into the top right
[*]It can be cycled into the overlays and hidden completely by pressing tab, or (B) on controllers
[*]Added improved icons and minimap tiles for all areas
[*]Shrines and loot of Unique or higher quality is now visible on the minimap
[*]Minimap opacity setting can now go as low as 5% for the overlays
[/list]
[b]You can now reset areas from the Waypoints in The Chronicon[/b]
[list]
[*]Right click or press (X) with the controller on a selected area i the Waypoint menu and you'll get a confirmation window to reset it, giving you fresh spawns but maintaining the original layout
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Achievements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an additional Achievement related to the stash
[*]Changed the name and description of several Achievements
[/list]
[b]Anomaly:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed many bosses to be more interesting and less punishing for melee characters
[*]Music is now determined by area layout
[*]Changed the portal sound
[/list]
[b]Backwards compatibility and retroactive changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Further work has been done to simplify backwards compatibility and retroactive changes, meaning save files as old as from version 0.20.0 (July 2015) are still compatible with new enchants and such and will be adjusted accordingly
[*]These changes will also affect the shared stash, from this update and forwards
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bonus experience gained from difficulty (and anomaly progression) is now exponential, which should smoothen the progression a bit when you get really far
[*]Bonus exp from killstreaks now starts off at a higher rate but has diminishing returns with difficulty
[*]Adjusted the very steep curve of bonus crystals from killstreaks to be a bit lower
[/list]
[b]Bosses:[/b]
[list]
[*]High Priest: Now Warps around a bit to be less static
[*]High Priest: Boss area now has Shrines in it
[/list]
[b]Companions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Kills by companions now trigger "on kill" effects on the player (from both items and skills)
[*]Companions now use the player's Overpower stat
[/list]
[b]Enchants:[/b]
[list]
[*]Special on hit effects such as chill damage, burn damage, etc has been rebalanced *heavily*
[*]As such, all your items with these enchants have had their damage values adjusted, and the enchants unlocked, in case you no longer desire it
[*]Added two new "on-hit" enchants:
[list]
[*]Smite: Deals instant Holy damage
[*]Blight: Deals shadow damage over time
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Made the quantity numbers and key binding text on belt, skill bar, and inventory much smaller so it doesn't obstruct the actual thing in the slot
[*]Removed "OEM" from many keybind characters
[*]Killstreak bar is now yellow instead of a dark orange
[*]Improved formatting of enchanting costs
[/list]
[b]Items & Loot:[/b]
[list]
[*]Special Unique equipment from Unique monsters, quests, and more, now roll random stats like any other item
[*]Made keys a bit more rare
[*]Magic Essence drop rate tweaked a bit
[*]Potions no longer drop for lower tiers   
[*]Added new Smite enchant as guaranteed roll on the following Templar items:
[list]
[*]Ayeela's Guard
[*]Soulpurger's Garment
[*]Armor of Retribution
[/list]
[*]Added new Blight enchant as guaranteed roll on the following Warlock items:
[list]
[*]Desecrator's Work
[*]Death's List
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Monsters & Affixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Affixes:
[list]
[*]Nova: Now uses actual nova spells rather than firing off projectiles in all directions, preventing insta-kills when too close
[*]Blizzard: Now releases a Frost Nova on death instead of many projectiles, preventing insta-kills
[/list]
[*]Champions & Elite Packs:
[list]
[*]Champions now prefer to use max ranks of skills, whereas Elite packs will generally use rank 1 of skills (such as the Nova affix skills)
[/list]
[*]Unique Monsters:
[list]
[*]The Watcher: Replaced Ice Spear Nova spell with Frost Nova spell
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed the shapeshift effect of Maddoc's Cure temporarily as it caused some issues with some skills
[*]Shrines no longer activate the secret rude effect in Anomalies
[*]Added some info on Companions to the Help Index
[*]Damage number animations adjusted to better show crits
[*]Pressing F10 will now save an image of the current tooltip displayed, such as an item card or skill card - this will help you in making guides and wiki entries etc
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the exp penalties if players are on different levels - the exp gain reduction is not applied until there is a 10 levels difference of player1
[/list]
[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Optimized redundant interface draw calls, slight performance bump for low end machines on interface updates
[/list]
[b]Portals:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now have an opening animation, and cannot be interacted with right away
[/list]
[b]Respawning:[/b]
[list]
[*]Respawn costs are now based on the value of your equipment, instead of your total crystals
[*]In co-op, the cost is based on player 1's equipment
[/list]
[b]Skills & Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*]General:
[list]
[*]Added target circles to several more skills when used by enemies
[*]Thorns triggers now refresh killstreak duration by up to 2.5 seconds
[/list]
[*]Berserker:
[list]
[*]Dragon Spikes: Now increases thorns by 220/260/300%, rather than adding set values
[*]Take Down: Added sound, particles, and screen shake to impact effect
[/list]
[*]Templar:
[list]
[*]Hallowed: Now deals 150% Holy damage (up from 30%)
[*]Expulsion: Proc rate increased to 40%/70%/100% (up from 30%/35%/40%). Damage increased to 80%/120%/160% (up from 25%/30%/35%).
[*]Burning Conviction: Now deals up to 40% of the hitting skills' damage per second for 5 seconds, instead of up to 200% of the hitting skills' damage over 5 seconds. Effect duration now also affects this effect. In addition, the trigger chance has been removed and it now always triggers.
[*]Condemnation: Now deals 120%/160%/200% damage (up from 50%/75%/100%)
[/list]
[*]Warden:
[list]
[*]Nimbus: Increased range to 9 meters (from 7) and it now only casts the thunder spell when it's near a target, rather than at all times. Also added a slight idle movement to it & improved visuals somewhat.
[*]Growth: Duration of mushrooms is no longer increased, and is now capped at 2.5 seconds regardless of rank
[*]Spores: Will now target the closest foe, and travel towards it, up to 10 meters, before fading (or turning into a mushroom with Growth passive)
[*]Spiderlings: The Use effect now only bursts one Spiderling at a time, releasing 3 spores (up from 1). Cooldown lowered to 3 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Spider: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 12 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Treant Guard: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 12 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Treant Strider: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 15 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Sparkies: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 12 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Pixies: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 15 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Alpha Wolf: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 12 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Wolfpack: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 15 seconds (down from 30)
[/list]
[*]Warlock:
[list]
[*]Plague Bearers: The Use effect now only detonates one Plague Bearer at a time. Cooldown lowered to 3 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Zombies: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 15 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Imps: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 15 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Little Devils: The Use effect cooldown lowered to 15 seconds (down from 30)
[*]Fire Nova: Updated particles and light
[*]Frozen Veil: Is now only applied if you don't already have it, meaning it won't refresh itself when rapidly gaining souls
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*]Soul Fade Time is now called Soul Duration, to make it more clear (no mechanics have changed)
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where waypoints could erroneously be linked to a previously visited Act
[*]Fixed several more skill and item typos
[*]Fixed the Shroomtender set giving the 4 part bonus with 3 parts
[*]Fixed issue where having mutliple skills bound to the same key would stop all from being cast if one was a companion skill and the companion was dead
[*]Fixed issue where Shield Overload didn't get bonus damage from its Mastery
[*]Fixed issue where Magnetic Orb didn't crit
[*]Fixed Tooltip delays not working on the skill tree for controllers
[*]Fixed a bug with Flaming Hells, causing it to add super long durations sometimes, granting the associated set extreme damage bonus
[*]Fixed Sky Power adding an absurd amount of damage
[*]Fixed items dropped by Unique monsters rolling stats outside the ranges
[*]Fixed Achievement to open secret doors not working (if you had this bug, try visiting Huu again)
[*]Fixed the Retaliator set not working correctly with other sets and legendary effects
[*]Fixed issue with Plea on use effect showing incorrect buff values
[*]Fixed issue that allowed spells to be cast outside of animations when having very high CDR (~90%) and holding a cast button
[*]Fixed crash due to item corruption as a result of save file editing
[*]Fixed Valkyrie 4 set bonus not working with bleed enchants
[*]Fixed bleed effects not always using Ethereal damage for their calculations
[*]Fixed buff stacks displaying the stack number on foes in red color rather than white
[*]Fixed Ni's bush spawning behind trees in The Northern Advance
[*]Fixed Warlock's Meteor and Comet spells being unaffected by Reach
[*]Fixed Autosave triggering on game entry, forcing backup overwrites, making them useless in a start-related issue
[*]Fixed closing inventory menus with B on controller also toggling map
[*]Fixed being able to "Use" quest items, removing them form inventory
[*]Fixed Take Down not dealing area damage
[*]Fixed stash saying "Unequip" on tooltips rather than withdraw/deposit
[*]Fixed chests spawning behind portals in Unstable Dimensions
[*]Fixed main menu background not being centred
[*]Fixed crashing related to the Nova affix
[*]Fixed several areas in Act 3 having incorrect backgrounds (Chamber of Torment, Unknown Tombs)
[*]Fixed Eastwall Key dropping twice
[*]Fixed some portals not highlighting properly on being hard to click
[*]Fixed an issue causing Wisp corpses to sometimes remain on the ground
[*]Fixed a freeze when attempting to spawn an Anomaly boss in a too narrow area
[*]Fixed issue where player two couldn't attack if player one was inspecting items
[*]Fixed issue where companions dealt too low damage in some cases
[*]Fixed issue where neither companions nor enemies could critically hit
[*]Fixed crash related to a bad interface refresh
[*]Fixed the shared stash being too small (25 slots) for new players
[*]Fixed issues with stash backwards compatibility
[*]Fixed versioning problem with stash (didn't keep track of hotfix/minor updates)
[*]Fixed minimap icons being offset
[*]Fixed some minimap tile issues in The Chronicon
[*]Fixed issue where you'd sometimes get the same items many times in a row when gambling
[*]Fixed issue where a Crystal Puzzle could spawn on Lieutenant Fredricks in Deepwood
[*]Fixed triggered effects sometimes adding multiple kills to killstreak when killing an enemy
[*]Fixed shrine Thorns buff remaining until you changed equipment
[*]Fixed crash when rapidly changing max sounds option in-game
[*]Fixed foes being interrupted, stunned, or frozen not cancelling their "Flailing" affix attacks
[*]Fixed Lightning WYrms, Hungering Call, Provoke, and Bone Spears pulling unspawned foes closer such as the Gargoyles in the Dark Tower
[*]Fixed Healthbars showing up on foes that weren't targetable or hadn't finished spawning
[*]Fixed Shrines providing too strong buffs
[*]Fixed being able to increase extra ambient light beyond 100%
[*]Fixed augment and re-roll costs not being visible when using controller
[*]Fixed some mouse interface buttons being drawn when using controller
[*]Fixed Rumbling Voice not having a range on the stun effect
[*]Fixed critical strike chance going over cap
[*]Fixed boss spells & summons remaining after they die, potentially killing the player
[*]Fixed a bunch of skills not breaking breakables
[*]Fixed mouse not working in menu if clicking a dropdown and then hitting esc
[*]Fixed crystal puzzles spawning partially behind cave walls
[*]Fixed things going invisible on mouseover when shaders had failed to compile
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.62.2 - Fixes & balance
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

This update will fix most of the reported issues, and also adds some balance tweaks.

I will continue to work on fixing the reported issues, some will require more time and attention than others, so I've decided to roll out these weekly-ish updates to keep things going smooth. 

Next week I also begin work on a new minimap! 
So be on the lookout for that :)


Anyway, as always, thanks for all the feedback and bug reports!


[h1]0.62.2:[/h1]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted Anomaly boss damage values
[*]Adjusted enemy "static" affix damage values
[*]Adjusted the chill, burn, poison, bleed, and chain lightning enchant values
[*]Players now have a very small hidden cooldown when taking thorns damage from enemies, making them immune for very short durations to prevent insta-death from striking a large group of foes with thorns, or attacking very rapidly
[*]Resistance caps raised to 80%
[*]Increased the chance to get rare equipment from gambling, and this chance now also grows with your level (you are now more than twice as likely on level 100)
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered the requirements of the "Greed" Achievement
[*]Buff/debuff system was rewritten to fix a few bugs and prevent some possible errors & headaches, as well as increase overall performance
[*]DoT effects like poisons & burns may feel more powerful as a result of resolving some issues related to the old system
[*]Added an experimental conversion algorithm to character loading, which may be used to do retroactive changes to enchants
[list]
[*]This should convert old Mana/Health injectors who weren't able to augment in 0.62.1
[*]It should also convert old Burn/Poison/Chill etc effects to the new effects
[*]This should also lower the cap of augmented Burn/Poison/Chill etc effects as of their nerf (if you are unhappy with these lower caps they have also been unlocked so you can scramble the item)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Templar:
[list]
[*]Holy Fire: Range now increases with each point spent in skill & now uses the reach modifier of the caster when applied to friends in co-op
[/list]
[*]Warden:
[list]
[*]Nimbus: Now only targets foes which have a line of sight to the player and is within a 7 meter radius
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some heavy stuttering when accessing the stash
[*]Fixed stuttering when saving
[*]Fixed some skill description errors
[*]Fixed many misc typos and grammar errors
[*]Fixed several Unique items rolling old bleed enchants
[*]Fixed several issues with shrines and their chill/burn/poison/lightning buffs
[*]Fixed Holy Fire dealing way too much damage
[*]Fixed Storm Mender rushing into combat
[*]Fixed an issue sometimes preventing players from interacting with stuff after entering a new game
[*]Fixed issue with stat comparisons sometimes showing incorrect damage, health, or mana changes
[*]Fixed issue with Warden Wisps not dealing correct damage
[*]Fixed Nimbus spawning from Storm Pendant going off very far and finding targets through walls
[*]Fixed issues with skills including Shield Throw, Chain Lightning, Bone Spears, Lightning Wyrms, and other similar skills that would automatically target invulnerable, exploding, or dead foes
[*]Fixed a too low Augment cap on Helm of Might
[*]Fixed crashes related to old items
[*]Fixed being able to use Companion "use" commands when the companions were dead
[*]Fixed some monsters having too low health compared to other monsters of same difficulty
[*]Fixed being able to kill Maddoc before he has engaged in the fight
[*]Fixed Shadowclone enemies spawning inside walls & pillars
[*]Fixed some "on cast" effects happening at animation start rather than on the actual spell cast
[*]Fixed portal nametags backgrounds being too small
[*]Fixed inspect boxes getting stuck on the screen when opening the inventory
[*]Fixed Soul Warp not being affected by attack speed stat
[*]Fixed not being able to unequip bags with a controller
[*]Fixed items being deposited while accessing stash and hitting (A) on bag slots with a controller
[*]Fixed issue where Anomalies could get stuck in a boss spawn mode
[*]Fixed issue where DoTs that were continuously re-applied would also restart their timers
[*]Fixed issue where some enchants would roll outside their intended range
[*]Fixed issues with effects like Sludge Threads and Blaze which should only trigger while moving
[*]Fixed issue where Health injector and Mana injector special enchants wont show up in the enchanter view
[*]Fixed being able to stun spawning/exploding/invulnerable foes
[*]Fixed Enchanting Index cutting off the final listed enchant from the list
[*]Fixed rare crash that could occur when updating a companions stats from the player in the exact same moment as it died
[*]Fixed issue that would allow the Warlock to keep his permanent Infernal Demon companion after unequipping the related item
[*]Fixed issue that didn't despawn the Hellhounds from the Demon Lord set after unequipping it
[*]Fixed not being able to bring up the Enchant Index and several other errors with Enchanting while using a controller
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.62.0 - Community suggestions, difficulty overhaul, new items, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

With the weekend just around the corner I figured I'd release a new update!
Unlike most updates, this one does not fix all reported issues, but rest assured that I will fix them over the coming weeks, in smaller updates.

In addition to new items and many added community suggestions, this update changes the difficulty scaling [i]entirely[/i] so be prepared for a real challenge in high anomalies!

As such, your Anomaly progress have been reverted down to Anomaly level 50.

Anomaly level 200 is approximately equal to what Anomaly level 1000 used to be, and it scales in a much steeper curve now, so I'm looking to gather as much feedback as I can on the new difficulty curve. This is also a good opportunity to mention that I will [i]never[/i] wipe your saves or anything like that, but things like Anomalies may suffer resets due to balance changes.

Hopefully the new difficulty is in a good place!

I expect that I will need to tweak it based on your feedback, so I look forward to hearing your thoughts!

I also realize most Legendary and True Legendary equipment is focused on offense, so expect more defensive options in the near future as well. I threw in two samples of this in the shape of a new helmet and ring, which I hope you will find useful! If you are doing companion builds you may find the ring especially helpful.

Aside from that, I have added many community suggestions, and I have more on the list still. Something I really wanted to add was a new minimap, but I wasn't able to squeeze that and some other things with this update, so update 0.63.0 will focus a bit more on community suggestions! Expect it in a few weeks time.

Meanwhile, I am also working on Act 4, so that isn't too far away either - expect it around March-April somewhere, with plenty of content updates up until then.


Anyway, I look forward to hearing your thoughts on the new difficulty scaling. I hope you enjoy it!

Thanks!

[h1]0.62.0: Community Suggestions & Balance Update - part 1[/h1]
[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]With large changes to difficulty scaling, you can expect more defensive options in both Mastery and equipment in the future
[/list]
[b]Achievements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted some values on the stat Achievements "Elemental Master" and "Elementalist"
[/list]
[b]Anomalies:[/b]
[list]
[*]Some small Anomalies have been made a bit larger
[/list]
[b]Area Layouts:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted many odd spawn locations of doors in Act 2 and Act 3
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Melee classes (Berserker & Templar) now take a flat 30% less damage from all sources to compensate for their need to be closer
[*]Mastery exp requirement has been increased, particularly after reaching over level 300
[/list]
[b]Companions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Idle companions now target the monster the player attacks
[*]Companions now slowly regenerate health when not in combat
[*]Companions now copy player resistances, with a minimum of 0% (can't go into negatives because of difficulty penalty)
[*]Companions can now receive "damage reduction" from special items, lowering their total damage taken
[*]Companions now also mirror the player's "crit damage" stat
[*]This means that the following stats are now transferred to companions:
[list]
[*]Crit chance
[*]Crit damage
[*]Movement speed
[*]Resistances
[*]Damage and Health based on listed skill values
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Difficulty:[/b]
[list]
[*]Completely rebalanced to better suit the new skills and Mastery systems - some tweaking is likely needed
[*]Difficulty now scales more steep, especially from Legendary and up
[*]However Casual difficulty should feel a lot more Casual now, too
[*]Anomaly difficulty is highly affected by the changes, and you will be lowered to Anomaly 50 if you have made it further
[*]Anomaly Level 200+ roughly translates into what was previously 1000+
[*]Monster extra affixes has been capped at 6 for Champions and 5 for Elites, and are now more consistent through the difficulties
[/list]
[b]Enchanting:[/b]
[list]
[*]Scrambling and freshly generated items now properly follow the same set of rules. These rules have been updated to the following:
[list]
[*]Rings and Amulets must always roll an additional enchant, this additional enchant is always an Epic enchant
[*]Weapons, Armor, and Boots have a 25% chance to replace one of their Major enchants with an Epic enchant.
[*]Scrambling Weapon, Armor, or Boots, may replace the Epic enchant with a Major, and vice versa. You can only roll one Epic enchant per item.
[/list]
[*]You can now enchant directly from your equipment rather than only from the inventory
[*]You can now also Augment (lock) enchants that have rolled their maximum value
[*]There is now a full index of all possible enchants when you hover/inspect an item placed in the enchanting slot
[*]Enchanting materials no longer drop until you finish the Missing Codex quest, and Chantie will tell you where to find them when completing the quest
[*]The "Chance to burn on hit" and similar enchants are now using percentages, making it scale much better in endgame. These enchants can now also be Augmented very high. The old versions have been made absolete.
[*]Bleed enchants now use "Bleed Damage" instead of Physical damage, ignoring enemy resistances and relying on the "Bleed Damage" stat.
[*]Health Injector power can be augmented a little higher
[/list]
[b]Equipment:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 2 new True Legendary items:
[list]
[*]Life Guard
[*]Unbreakable Bond
[/list]
[*]Added new powers to the following Legendary items:
[list]
[*]Berserker:
[list]
[*]Brutal Stompers
[*]Firebreather (previously known as Cataclysm)
[/list]
[*]Warden:
[list]
[*]Forest Embrace (was previously not exclusive to Warden)
[*]Packleader's Vest
[*]Storm Pendant (previously known as Stormcaller's Pendant)
[/list]
[*]Warlock:
[list]
[*]Infernal Horns
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Updated Set:
[list]
[*]Sun & Moon: now buffed to be more useful and an endgame alternative for mixed fire/frost builds
[/list]
[*]Updated Power:
[list]
[*]Golden Guard: Now deals thorns damage as holy damage in the form of holy bolts (does not replace thorns), rather than just flat holy damage
[*]Nature's Barbs: Now also turns Thorns into Poison damage
[/list]
[*]Tweaked drop rates of True Legendary items (they are now separated from regular Legendaries in their own loot pool)
[*]Updated names and base enchants of many items
[*]Lowered level requirements of several Legendary items
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added support for tiny healthbars that are always visible - check the Interface menu to toggle "Display Enemy Healthbars"
[*]Player Overhead Healthbars and Companion Overhead Healthbars are now also tiny
[*]You can now also toggle companion nametags on or off regardless of healthbar visibility
[*]Champion, Elite, Unique, and Boss monsters have been given slightly larger healthbars with a golden accent
[*]"The Name Tag Scale" option is now a "Healthbar & Name Tag Scale" option, allowing you to adjust the new healthbars
[*]Damage Number, Text, and Name Tag scaling sliders now scale to each 10% rather than each 100%
[*]Empty skill snows now have a "+" icon on them to make it more clear they are selectable
[*]You can now hover on your skill bar to get your selected skills' info rather than having to enter the skill tree to check
[*]You can now also hover the skill notification icons for a text notice, and you may also click to open the skill trees
[*]You can also hover the experience bar for exact details on your experience and mastery experience
[*]Player healthbar now gives off a shine when below 30% health
[*]Added a new option to enable cooldown numbers on your skill bar
[*]Mouse over will now prioritize enemies over loot so you don't get loot tags or pick up loot in combat when trying to attack
[*]The bag slots now have bag icons on them & the belt slots have potion icons
[*]Added a dark background behind portal names so they're easier to read
[/list]
[b]Killstreaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now awards more Crystals, and exponentially increases with large streaks!
[*]Now also awards some more experience, depending on difficulty and size of streak
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Crystals now shoot out of chests and monsters in a rapid stream rather than all at once (I just thought it looks neat)
[*]Improved load times in some large forest areas
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Putridus: Now always drops a 4 slot pouch
[*]Thorns and DoT effects now deal a maximum of 10% of the player's health
[*]Explosive monsters can no longer kill the player in one hit, and will at the very most deal 50% of their health (non-champion monsters deal much less)
[*]Mana leechers now drain a maximum of 5% mana per hit
[*]Bosses now drop more Crystals
[/list]
[b]Quests:[/b]
[list]
[*]Protect And Serve: Now rewards a 6-slot bag in addition to the helmet
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]General:
[list]
[*]Projectiles should no longer count breakables as hits and trigger effects / proc / spend hits

notes.title: Update 0.62.0 - Community suggestions, difficulty overhaul, new items, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

With the weekend just around the corner I figured I'd release a new update!
Unlike most updates, this one does not fix all reported issues, but rest assured that I will fix them over the coming weeks, in smaller updates.

In addition to new items and many added community suggestions, this update changes the difficulty scaling [i]entirely[/i] so be prepared for a real challenge in high anomalies!

As such, your Anomaly progress have been reverted down to Anomaly level 50.

Anomaly level 200 is approximately equal to what Anomaly level 1000 used to be, and it scales in a much steeper curve now, so I'm looking to gather as much feedback as I can on the new difficulty curve. This is also a good opportunity to mention that I will [i]never[/i] wipe your saves or anything like that, but things like Anomalies may suffer resets due to balance changes.

Hopefully the new difficulty is in a good place!

I expect that I will need to tweak it based on your feedback, so I look forward to hearing your thoughts!

I also realize most Legendary and True Legendary equipment is focused on offense, so expect more defensive options in the near future as well. I threw in two samples of this in the shape of a new helmet and ring, which I hope you will find useful! If you are doing companion builds you may find the ring especially helpful.

Aside from that, I have added many community suggestions, and I have more on the list still. Something I really wanted to add was a new minimap, but I wasn't able to squeeze that and some other things with this update, so update 0.63.0 will focus a bit more on community suggestions! Expect it in a few weeks time.

Meanwhile, I am also working on Act 4, so that isn't too far away either - expect it around March-April somewhere, with plenty of content updates up until then.


Anyway, I look forward to hearing your thoughts on the new difficulty scaling. I hope you enjoy it!

Thanks!

notes.title: Major Content Update #4 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's finally ready for you!

https://youtu.be/w3EFlawRycY
Full notes: http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/154644928864353864/

This update introduces the full new skill trees, giving each class around 180 skills to choose from, and an additional 70 Mastery Skills from the new infinite progression system!

This update also introduces the first crafting mechanic - Enchanting.
Enchanting allows you to alter and power up your favorite equipment to fit your playstyle!

The update also introduces a looong list of improvements and tweaks - not to mention bug fixes!

You'll find that combat is more fluid, skills feel more responsive, loot feels more balanced, and many other things!

Now, this is a very large update - massive even, so there will likely be issues popping up. Don't worry though, I'll monitor the forums carefully and fix anything that pops up as fast as I can!

The next few updates will add a lot more equipment to the game, and re-add some now missing old special effects on legendary items. I've had to change it all to fit the enchanting system, and not everything has made it back in yet. But it'll all be back, and improved!


This has been an amazing year for me and Chronicon, and it wouldn't have been possible without this awesome community! Let's hope the next year is just as amazing, if not better!

Many thanks, Happy Holidays, and a Happy New Year to all of you!

notes.notes:
Hey guys!

This update includes 4 new large skill trees, the Mastery tree, and 8 new Legendary sets! I've also thrown in a lot of changes, balancing, misc. tweaks and fixes!

I will be updating with further equipment in the weeks ahead, and releasing the Warlock next.

Stay tuned!


Full notes:

[h1]041216[/h1]
[b]Warden Added!:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 4 fully featured skill trees and a Mastery tree for the Warden
[*]Added 8 Legendary sets for the Warden
[list]
[*]High Ranger's Gear
[*]Wind Caller's Regalia
[*]Everspring Raiment
[*]Shroom Tender's Garb
[*]Stormcaller's Regalia
[*]Armor of the Wispmother
[*]Torrential Raiment
[*]Snowstorm Armor
[/list]
[*]More legendaries coming soon!
[/list]
[b]Boss:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shortened intro for Feren'El
[*]Medella's fight room tweaked so you can't lob spells over the pillars anymore. But you have larger cover now, instead.
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated basic visuals of many Frost effects
[*]Sharp Steel (Templar) now only triggers on Physical skills - may change 
[*]Skills are now unlocked at 4, 9, 14, 19, etc points spent, making them available at levels 5, 10, 15, 20 -- etc.
[*]Cooldowns rebalanced to be more generalized:
[list]
[*]Tier 1 (Base) remain at 0 seconds
[*]Tier 2 Active skills are now 4-6 seconds (was 3-6)
[*]Tier 3 (Aura, heritage, Companion) remain at 30 seconds
[*]Tier 4 Active skills are now 9-12 seconds (was 5-10)
[*]Tier 5 Active skills are now 30 seconds (was 30-35)
[*]Tier 6 (Ultimate) remain at 100 seconds
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Character:[/b]
[list]
[*]The color of your characters clothing is now adjusted depending on the element of the skill tree in which you've invested the most points
[*]This color is now also visible on the Hero Select screen
[/list]
[b]Companions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Companions now list their upgrades as buffs above their nametags, if nametags are enabled
[/list]
[b]Sound:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new volume slider for Speech, such as boss intro, boss death, and boss special attack speech
[*]Added a new volume slider for rare loot (Unique + Legendary drop sound)
[*]Improved sound looping of skills like Boulder, Tornado, Gust, etc
[/list]
[b]Quests:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Enchanter's Codex should now drop more frequently
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]All types of Pixies are now Evasive
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Crystal costs of resurrection now separate thousands with commas to make it easier to read
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed several issues with click to move and holding shift (force attack)
[*]Fixed click to move stopping characters at actors and objects
[*]Fixed click to move speed while walking through packs of foes or densely placed objects
[*]Fixed issue where using click to move could control all players in multiplayer
[*]Fixed not being able to loot items by clicking the item tag displayed when holding Alt
[*]Fixed not being able to move to an item by clicking the item tag when using click to move
[*]Fixed the skill trees not properly indicating whether a new tier is unlocked or not
[*]Fixed issue with shield type buff such as Grace (Templar passive) not correctly disappearing from the UI when depleted
[*]Fixed rounding errors and bad/incorrect presentation of values on many buffs
[*]Fixed some passive skills using incorrect calculations and values otehr than those represented
[*]Fixed buff tooltip not being properly anti-aliased
[*]Fixed Templar skill "Shattered Shield" not being affected by Reach stat
[*]Fixed issue drawing all buffs on targets and companions as negative, even if they were positive
[*]Fixed rare crash from certain wind/gust based skills (monster and player)
[*]Fixed rare issue with damage percentage calculations
[*]Fixed game getting stuck if attempting to pause during a loading screen
[*]Fixed Fulmination and Thunderstrike (Templar) not having a skill type (is now Magic)
[*]Fixed Rumbling Voice stunning everything on the screen (whoops)
[*]Fixed Frostbite not correctly showing a debuff on affected foes
[*]Fixed Berserker ultimates not being affected by cooldown reductions from Mastery
[/list]

notes.title: Test build updated with new equipment, 4:3 and 16:10 support, improved menus, fixes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Here's another update for the test builds. This should take care of all reported issues on the test build so far, as well as adding several new items to try out. Some new True Legendaries, too! Thank you so much for your feedback and bug reports!

Progress on the Warden is very good, and she'll be ready quite soon. And then there's only the Warlock left before we take all this live!

Also, for those of you asking for additional language support, like Chinese - I am looking into the possibilities of translations but please understand that it may take a while!

Anyway, enjoy the update!

[h1]101116:[/h1]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added proper support for 4:3 and 16:10 monitors
[*]Added many new windowed resolutions to the video options
[*]Split Video and Interface options into separate menus
[*]Improved menu buttons visuals
[*]Added a new and improved Hero Select screen
[*]You no longer have to set the difficulty each time you enter the game, a new "Play" button has been added that skips this step and uses your last played difficulty
[*]A "Difficulty" button has been added to go to the difficulty screen as previously
[/list]
[b]Items:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 4 new True Legendary items:
[list]
[*]Amulet of Despair (Amulet)
[*]The Quadruplets (Accessory)
[*]The Skull Mask (Helm)
[*]Royal Armor (Armor)
[/list]
[*]Added Berserker Legendary items:
[list]
[*]Bad Boys (Fists)
[*]Arsonists (Fists)
[*]The Thunder Claps (Fists)
[*]The Icebergs (Fists)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an "Evade" mechanic, used exclusively by the Warden and various monsters
[*]Evade gives a chance to completely avoid damage
[/list]
[b]Companions & general AI:[/b]
[list]
[*]A lot of stats and mechanics were changed for the AI, allowing companions to have Thorns and the new Evasion stat, among other things
[*]Some minor AI tweaks

[b]Monster Affixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Spectral Affix now adds 20% evasion to monsters
[*]Evasive Affix now adds 15% evasion to monsters
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed skill type damage not being properly applied for the Berserker
[*]Fixed stuns wearing off from enemies during cutscenes or times when the player did not have control
[*]Fixed a lot of text alignment problems in the menus
[*]Fixed being able to click through item tags so you accidentally interact with other items/portals/enemies/etc
[*]Fixed not being able to select bottom items in dropdown lists in menus, if clicking on the bottom half of the item
[*]Fixed being able to pick a windowed resolution larger than your screen, creating all sorts of problems
[*]Fixed some skill typos
[*]Fixed rare issue causing freezing sometimes on item generation (like gambling)
[*]Fixed some skill-boosting items dropping before the skill is available
[/list]

notes.title: Test Build updated with Berserker + combat, stat, skill, and loot changes!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's finally here, The Berserker is available for testing on the Test Builds!
(Learn more about Test Builds [Url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/4/360671727314415102/]here[/url])

[img]http://i.imgur.com/psaH2rk.png[/img]

A massive thanks to everyone who has been providing feedback and bug reports during the testing period so far! I think you will enjoy some of the recent changes.

I will be adding some tweaks as needed, as well as adding in more Legendary items for the Berserker during the week. After that I start work on the next class, the Warden! The Warden should hopefully take less time to develop, as I've set up a lot of things to help me out. Thanks for being so patient!

Full update notes: 
[h1]241016[/h1]
[b]Classes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added The Berserker!
[*]Added new unique stats for the Berserker: Rage, Minimum Rage, Maximum Rage, Rage Generation
[*]All classes have received double base Health Regeneration
[*]The Berserker now has double base Health Regeneration & Mana Regeneration of other classes
[*]The Berserker now has the highest base Health of all classes, but no longer get bonus resistances (like the Templar)
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated the tier 1 active skill descriptions to be more clear about being default attack replacements
[*]Many skills have had their durations scale up faster or start at maximum duration on rank 1 to make them more attractive at low points
[*]Many skills also got nerfed, balanced, and reworked
[*][b]Templar:[/b]
[list]
[*]Magnetic Charge: Now lasts 5 seconds from rank 1 (was 3 at rank 3)
[*]Electrified: Now lasts 5 seconds from rank 1 (was 9 at rank 3)
[*]Wish: Now lasts 5 seconds from rank 1 (was 4 at rank 3)
[*]Flare: Now has a higher base time (5 seconds) and grows less per rank (still 6 seconds at max)
[*]Heated: Now lasts 5 seconds from rank 1 (was 4)
[*]Charred: Now lasts 5 seconds from rank 1 (was 3 at rank 3)
[*]Sharp Steel: Now lasts 3 seconds from rank 1 (was 3 at rank 3)
[*]Bladed Shield: Now lasts 3 seconds from rank 1 (was 3 at rank 3)

[*]Prayer: Lowered base effect bonus by 5%, and growth by 1% (now caps at 15%, down from 25%)
[*]Alacrity: Corrected bonus from other stacking passives and lowered the base bonus by 2%, lowered cooldown cutoff on usage by 2 seconds (now caps at 14% with all stacked passives, down from 19%)
[*]Devotion: Lowered total effect bonus by 5% (caps at 20%, down from 25%)
[*]Effect: Lowered total effect bonus by 5% (caps at 20%, down from 25%)
[*]Ignite: Lowered base effect by 5% and growth by 5% (now caps at 20%, down from 40%)
[*]Cauterize: No longer grants poison immunity

[*]Purged Through Holy Flames: Now gives foes under the effect of Burning Conviction a chance to trigger Expulsion when being hit

[*]Blessing: Now heals based on Maximum Health, 15/20/25/30/35%
[*]Healing Touch: Now heals based on Maximum Health (per tick), 6/7/8/9/10%
[*]Purify: Now heals based on Maximum Health, 8/11/14/17/20%

[*]Grace: Now has an extra 10% proc chance while wearing a tome
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cooldowns now start ticking right away as you begin performing the skill, this makes most skills usable more rapidly, and it also prevents skills that lowers cooldowns to lower their own cooldown (this was unintended)
[*]DoT's, thorns, and misc non-direct damage can now gib foes, if striking hard enough!
[*]Hidden cooldown added to knockback and pull effects, grating temporary immunity. 2 seconds for knocks, 1 second for pulls. Applies to both player and AI.
[/list]
[b]Chests:[/b]
[list]
[*]All chests now have a small chance to drop extra crafting materials
[*]Legendary chests now have an additional small chance to drop extra high quality loot
[/list]
[b]Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*]Overpower has been changed. Instead of being a chance to ignore resistances, it is now a "resistance piercing" stat.
[*]Enemy bonus resistances are now lowered by your Overpower%. So if a foe has 20% Fire Resistance, and you have 50% Overpower, that resistance is now considered to be at 10%.
[*]This makes damage output much more even and reliable, as opposed to relying on RNG and sudden bursts.
[/list]
[b]Controls:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a keyboard override key for click to move, allowing you to move towards cursor while tapping/holding spacebar (can be changed from controls menu)
[*]Added keyboard support for main menu (identical to gamepad controls; use arrow keys and enter)
[/list]
[b]Items & Enchants:[/b]
[list]
[*]Special items that previously rolled unusually high stats now cap their rolls at the max augment (they still roll high so you might not even need to augment these items)
[*]Slightly lowered the maximum rolls of cooldown reduction on items (~2% per tier)
[*]Sludge Threads no longer keep killstreaks active and trigger on-hit effects
[*]Slightly boosted droprate of Crystal Essences
[*]Caches & Containers no longer stack
[*]Temporarily disabled most Berserker Legendary items until they have had their powers updated to match new skill tree
[*]Items:
[list]
[*]Elementium Armor: now has a % rate of which it increases resistances
[*][b]Sets:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Reckoning: [/b]
[list]
[*]All items now roll Thorns damage
[/list]
[*][b]Valkyrie: [/b]
[list]
[*]Now works better due to Spectrals no longer being immune to bleed
[/list]
[*][b]Caine's:[/b]
[list]
[*]3) Also adds 20% movement speed to Flare
[*]4) Also adds 10 seconds duration to Flare
[/list]
[*][b]Avatar of Ayeela:[/b]
[list]
[*]The blade now gives Health on Hit instead of the Angelic Orb
[/list]
[*][b]Added 8 new Berserker sets:[/b]
[list]
[*]Physical: Bloodsoaked Garb, Cataclysm
[*]Lightning: Spiritual Garb, Breath of the Sky
[*]Fire: Dragonfire, Volcano
[*]Frost: Northern Rage, Gust of the Frost Wyrms
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Spectral foes are no longer immune to bleed effects because it makes several builds completely nonviable
[*]Lowered damage of the Anomaly Gargoyle boss
[*]Added a new modifier: Collector
[*]Collectors drop large amounts of Enchanting Materials
[*]Can be found on both Champion and Elite monsters
[*]Can spawn in Unstable Dimensions
[/list]
[b]Anomaly & Challenge:[/b]
[list]
[*]Anomaly & Challenge bosses are now Sturdy (immune to knockback and pulls)
[*]Clattergore: Now has bleeding effects and bonus critrate
[/list]
[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved(?) some chain lightning effects with particles
[*]Added a lot of new types of visual effects for the Berserker skills
[*]Added red target circles for some attacks like the Meteors, giving you a chance to avoid them
[*]A few player skills will use these to mark their radius, but they will be a different color
[*]Moved some fire effects to be drawn behind players and foes for visibility improvement
[*]Improved frost/chill damage visuals 
[*]Added freeze visuals
[/list]
[b]NPC & Vendor:[/b]
[list]
[*]Gave Chantie her intended look
[*]Gambling items now mention that they only roll up to Legendary quality
[/list]
[b]Boss (Story):[/b]
[list]
[*]Captain Moore now throws a barrage of swords instead of swinging wildly
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]The stat pages now display more relevant information to your class, for example only the elements used are displayed on the first page, and the unused can be found on the last page
[*]Condensed "on hit" and "misc" effects into a single page
[*]Updated some help texts in the menu with new stats etc
[/list]
[b]Sound:[/b]
[list]
[*]Debuff trigger noises (such as bleed effects) now only play if the debuff doesn't already exist, i.e. refreshing an effect wont repeatedly play the sound
[/list]
[b]Test Build Specifics:[/b]
[list]
[*](These changes are made to make testing easier)
[*]Increased droprates of rare items tenfold
[*]You can now gamble True Legendary items (NOTE: You still need to be on Legendary difficulty because reasons)
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed not being able to sort stashes with auto sort
[*]Fixed mouse being able to hover and interact with invisible belt slots while in the stash
[*]Fixed some incorrect sounds
[*]Fixed skills being queued up before death still executing on respawn
[*]Fixed some enchants having incorrect augment and roll caps
[*]Fixed some items still rolling old (removed) enchants
[*]Fixed some skill select boxes disappearing randomly
[*]Fixed not gaining Health and Mana Regeneration from the Fire Mastery skill "Battle Thrill"
[*]Fixed some visual effects of buffs and debuffs remaining on foes after they've died or been gibbed
[*]Fixed some skills hitting dead foes (may be more like this)
[*]Fixed Sharpened Blade bleed effect apply to foes immune to bleed effects
[*]Fixed being able to stun Bosses, dead foes, and misc objects
[*]Fixed repeated messages of "Stunned!" if rapidly repeatedly stunning an already stunned foe
[*]Fixed Divine Intervention not being able to be re-applied if casted before the effect wore off
[*]Fixed issue where Alacrity could reduce its own cooldown when used
[*]Fixed stash eating caches
[*]Fixed caches being destroyed/overridden/merged while dropped out of inventory or picked up
[/list]

notes.title: Test Build updated with new Legendary sets, auto sorting, quick selling, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Nnbj4Tf.png[/img]

Another update for the test builds!
This time it's a lot of fixes and general tweaks and improvements, but also an auto sort and quick sell option to the inventory and shops!
Additionally, I've added 3 full new Legendary sets for the Templar, and some nice new art for loading screens and the menu.

I know many of you are waiting for it, so I'm also happy to announce that the next update will be the Berserker one!

Many thanks for all the feedback you've been giving me so far - the game is really shaping up nicely! Keep it up!


[h1]090916:[/h1]
[b]Test build specific:[/b]
[list]
[*]New characters in the test build now get a new special "cache" item on creation, each cache contains a full legendary set
[*](this prevents flooding the ground and your bags with everything)
[/list]
[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*]All ground burn effects now have smaller flames to less obstruct the view
[*]Medella now shows a red barrier on herself when going invulnerable (when going nuts, and when teleporting)
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added auto sorting button for the inventory
[*]Added quick sell buttons for common, uncommon, and rare items
[*]Added new menu background and loading images
[*]Minimap now reveals walls in a larger radius around the player(s)
[*]New internal handling of interface redrawing and updates (much faster, no more stuttering on low end machines), let me know if anything appears odd
[*]Added tooltip info that you can hold ctrl to spend 5x points in skill tree
[*]Mastery level ups now display similar to regular level ups
[*]Updated the stat screen making it more readable, and adding the new stats such as Reach, and some additional tracking such as crystals spent on resurrections, etc
[*]Stat screen will now also show class specific stats, but only to characters of that class (eg blocking for Templar)
[/list]
[b]Enchanting:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted material costs to make better use of Magic Essence
[*]Rerolls are now cheaper, and augments more costly (let me know if *too* costly)
[/list]
[b]Anomalies & Difficulty:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the progress calculations to be more accurate, especially in smaller and high level anomalies
[*]Resistances are now reduced by an additional 1% per 10 floors after floor 30 (it used to cap at -30% on floor 50)
[*]Adjustments has been made to all difficulty settings and difficulty scaling, both in story mode and Anomalies. More adjustments will be made (in particular monster health and damage on higher levels)
[*]Difficulty information updated 
[/list]
[b]Loot & Items:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the rate of which Elite monsters drop Magical Essence
[*]Caine's Battlegear 4 set bonus: Blaze now deals 600% extra damage, up from 500%
[*]Health on Hit has been limited to Weapon, Ring, and Offhand (shield, tome, arrow, etc)
[*]Mana on Hit has been limited to Weapon, Amulet, and Spellbooks (Warlock offhand)
[*]Added a Bleed Damage% enchant to items. May roll on weapons, offhands, and rings.
[*]Renamed "Armor of the Valkyrie" to "Armor of the Shield Maiden" to not be confused with new Valkyrie set
[b]Added 3 new Templar sets![/b]
[list]
[*]War God
[*]Soulpurger's Regalia
[*]Valkyrie Battlegear
[*](New lightning set coming soon)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Monster skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Meteor spell now drop less meteors but with a larger range and larger damage
[*]Blizzard, Meteor, Thunderous, Flailing, and Eruption deals increased damage for each level of difficulty
[/list]
[b]Templar skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Magnetic Overload now has 6/8/10% chance to pull on spawn, rather than 100%
[*]Molten Armor now splashes molten steel around the Templar when recieving damage, rather than dealing thorns damage as fire
[*]Blaze damage increased to 125/160/195% from 110/140/170%
[*]Flare proc chance increased to 15/20/25% from 9/12/15%
[*]Expulsion proc chance increased to 35/40/45% from 6/8/10%
[*]Expulsion range reduced to 2/2.5/3 meters from 3/3.5/4 meters
[*]Swapped places of Sword and Magic mastery lines
[/list]
[b]Respawning & Death:[/b]
[list]
[*]Respawning now grants a 2 second invulnerability buff that is cleared if you attack
[*]Increased speed of respawning
[*]Changed visuals of respawning somewhat
[*]You no longer lose experience on death before level 5
[*]Mastery experience isn't lost upon death until Mastery level 5 (approx character level 21)
[*]Dying inside a challenge area now resets all your cooldowns
[*]Choosing to spawn in town will also reset all cooldowns
[/list]
[b]Sounds:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tweaked some sound effect volumes (particularly lightning/chain lightning sounds and explosions)
[b]Performance:
[*]Pretty much everything related to interface, like stash, inventory, skill trees, etc. has recived a performance boost and all known stutters/chops have been removed
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*]Preparations for Berserker
[*]Preparations for something secret :^)
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Death now correctly also steals 5% Mastery experience (as it does regular experience)
[*]Fixed Self Buff and Aura use function not properly activating passives
[*]Fixed the 3 set bonus of Caine's Armor not being applied until 4 pieces were worm
[*]Fixed issue where monster levels weren't updated on level up (thus lowering exp gain)
[*]Fixed some skills such as Repulse and Magnetic lock shaking the screen like crazy
[*]Fixed Wish not granting critical hit chance
[*]Fixed being able to exit anomalies during bossfights if going through the entrance portal
[*]Fixed cooldowns on the display not scaling with a display of 200% or more in size
[*]Fixed skills being queued up prior to death being performed after reviving
[*]Fixed active skill selection popup drawing rectangles outside the popup when moving the mouse outside
[*]Fixed issue with Expulsion not dealing damage correctly
[*]Fixed particles of Expulsion showing too short range
[*]Fixed loading issue that could cause crash on load screens, especially Anomalies (there may still be issues here.. let me know if it freezes or becomes unresponsive!)
[*]Item stacking in the world should no longer stack with stuff out of reach or behind walls
[/list]

notes.title: Test Build: Small update with fixes and tweaks
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

<Test build update>
I've previously only written these announcements for larger or more significant updates, and just quietly published small updates. I figured I'd ask if you want an update note like this for each update! Please leave a comment to let me know what you think!

Anyway, I've taken care of the issues reported and tweaked and changed some stuff too. You should for example find more Crystal Essences now!

Let me know if you encounter any more problems.
Thanks!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/4/360671727314415102/]>Read more here on how to join the test builds.[/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/4/]>Post feedback in this forum.[/url]


Here's the full list of changes:
[h1]310816:[/h1]
[b]Items:[/b]
[list]
[*]Elementium armor changed: now increases all resistances except your highest resistance by 25-45% of your highest resistance (cap at 65%)
[/list]
[b]Sound:[/b]
[*]Updated some sound effects for several events and most Thunder-based spells
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the base range of Charge, Slice, and Tackle
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now shows icons when you have Mastery or Skill Points to spend (mouse-over text will be added soon)
[/list]
[b]Loot:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the rate of which Elite monsters drop Crystal Essences
[*]Chests now drop all Crafting Materials
[*]Legendary and Locked chests may drop Soul Essences on Veteran or higher difficulty (like Champion monsters)
[*]Rare crafting loot no longer plays the rare drop sound
[/list]
[b]Enchanter:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now right click an item in the Enchanter to stop enchanting it
[*]You can now drag and drop items down into the enchant slot
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Renamed quest "Missing Manual" to "Missing Codex"
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Completing the quest for Enchanting should now properly remove the Enchanter's Codex from your inventory
[*]Fixed not being able to drop items from the Enchanting menu
[*]Fixed item duping in the Enchanter by moving / equipping items while enchanting
[*]Fixed enchanter showing gamepad control info when using mouse
[*]Fixed enchanter not showing info for players 2-4
[*]Fixed some incorrect item sounds
[*]Moved the crystal counter slightly so it doesn't cover the Anomaly progress bar
[*]Fixed a lot of areas spawning the entrance and NPC's in the wrong spots
[*]Fixed rare items not playing their item sound when dropping (was overridden by rare drop sound)
[*]Fixed items granted through scroll of testing not rolling enchants
[/list]
