notes.title: Test Build updated with Enchanting (reforge), and combat + QoL changes!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's been a busy couple of weeks, but finally the first crafting mechanic, Enchanting (to some known as reforging), has been added to the test build!

I've also done a lot of work with various quality of life things, and a lot of polish. Among other things, you should find both combat and movement more responsive, and stackable items now automatically stack on the ground with nearby items of the same kind. Pretty nifty!

Anyway.. thanks for all the feedback so far! 
I'm looking forward to hearing your thoughts on the Enchanting system!

Thanks!


How to join test builds: http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/4/360671727314415102/

Full notes:
[h1]290816[/h1]
[b]New mechanic: Enchanting[/b]
[list]
[*]Speak to Chantie in the Chronicon to start a quest to unlock Enchanting
[*][b]With Enchanting you can..[/b]
[list]
[*]Scramble items, generating a fresh set of enchants (locked enchants remain)
[*]Re-roll selected unlocked enchants for a random strength
[*]Augment selected enchants, locking them and improving them beyond the roll caps (based on quality of item)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Movement and Collision:[/b]
[list]
[*]Players no longer collide with eachother in multiplayer
[*]Walking through foes or objects now slows you by 40% instead of forcing a set 50% base movement speed (so if you have higher movement speed, you can move through stuff faster now)
[/list]
[b]Health and Mana pickups:[/b]
[list]
[*]Health and Mana pickups are now a bit more regular, and more frequent while above 50% health/mana (they will appear up to 70%)
[*]Health pickups are also no longer guaranteed when at low Health, but the rate is still significantly higher than when at high Health
[*]Health pickups now restore 20% health (down from 30%)
[*]Mana pickups now restore 15% Mana (down from 25%)
[*]Champions, Elites, and Unique monsters now drop health pickups more frequently
[*]Pickups fade away faster
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Blaze: Maximum damage increased by 30%, flame size reduced for visibility
[*]Fiery Blaze: Now also adds 20% movement speed to Blaze
[*]Holy Fire: now triggers on hit effects
[*]Using an Aura/buff's "Use" effect now has an animation and will trigger "on cast" and other special passive effects and skills
[*]You can now right click (or (Y) on gamepad) a selected skill with 0 points spent in it to bring up the skill select again if you want to change it
[*]Hitting a skill key will now queue up that skill to be performed next
[*]There is a half second window in queuing up skills, meaning you can queue something that is just about to come off cooldown, and it'll be performed as soon as possible
[*]Hitting a different key will override the queued up skill if there is time (eg mid-animation of another skill)
[*]You can hold down any other skill key while queuing up other skills - whatever you queue is performed in between the skill that you are holding down, if possible
[*]Skills are now placed at the target / location of your aim at the time of the button press, rather than at your target / location at the time of animation end
[/list]
[b]Unstable Dimensions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Smaller in size
[*]Doesn't spawn as frequently
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new loading screen illustrations and a simple loading bar
[*]Music for the next zone starts directly on loading screen rather than after entering now
[*]Cooldowns and buff durations no longer tick during cutscenes
[*]Holding a movement key while holding an attack key no longer moves your character slightly between attacks
[*]Blocking now displays a "Blocked!" text if enabled
[*]Repeated info text from the same source no longer create multiple texts
[/list]
[b]Items & Loot:[/b]
[list]
[*]Items now stack in 100 instead of 99 cause that was stupid
[*]New item type: Crafting Material
[/list]
[*][b]New items:[/b]
[list]
[*]Magical Essence (material)
[*]Crystal Essence (material)
[*]Soul Essence (material)
[/list]
[*]Crafting Material stack in 1000
[*]Nearby stackable items of the same type will now stack up as they drop, so the ground is less cluttered and you do less clicking
[*]Item tags now also show quantity
[*]Added a small effect to items stacking and picking up items
[*]Added a crystal counter that adds upp all crystals collected within a few seconds
[/list]
[b]Sound:[/b]
[list]
[*]New sound effects for interacting with npc's, gaining mastery levels, some skills, and a lot of interface stuff
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed incorrect swapping of belt slots when stacking items
[*]Fixed issue with mastery experience not being reset when creating a new character after playing an existing, causing the new character to end up in negatives
[*]Fixed Holy Fire buff tooltip showing incorrect amount
[*]Fixed Shield Slam getting assigned all points that was spend in your Mastery Tree
[*]Fixed crash from speaking to Tinka's Other Brother before reaching level 10
[*]Fixed the skill select popup being active and in the wrong place after swapping skill tree with it open
[/list]

notes.title: Test builds updated with new Mastery mechanic!
notes.notes:

[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.55.0 - Anomaly and monster tweaks!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Based on your feedback over the past week, I have made a lot of changes and upgrades to the Anomalies! I've also fixed a ton of bugs, so a big thanks for your reports, as always!

Updates will once again slow down now as I work entirely with the new Act. Of course, I'll fix any problems as they arise on the side, pushing small bugfixes.

Keep an eye on the forums.. I might post some teasers!

[h1]Version 0.55.0[/h1]
[b]Anomalies:[/b]
[list]
[*]The reward chest now drop an increased number of items the deeper you go
[*]Reduced the size of all layouts
[*]Drastically reduced size and mazyness of the forest and cave layouts
[*]Added a new layouts for caves, using larger rooms and more open spaces, as an alternative to the regular caves
[*]Added a new layout, which is similar to the forest but much more open
[*]Dying in an Anomaly now takes you to Tinka's Domain rather than The Chronicon
[*]Dying in an Anomaly on the boss fights now resets that floor and spawns you in Tinka's Domain
[*]Anomaly portals are now announced on screen when spawning
[*]Tinka's Brother now sells elixirs which can lower or increase your Anomaly level
[*]Sarek and Tinka's Brother now sell unlimited quantities of Elixir of The Mind
[/list]
[b]Areas:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the color scheme of the tileset for the "Mystery Garden"
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Monster "Thorns" damage has been adjusted to have a maximum cap and a longer internal cooldown
[*]Added a visual effect to the Thorns damage triggering
[*]Resistance affixes now sets the resistance at a solid 50% on all difficulties (previously it would scale up on higher difficulties)
[*]Nerfed "Poison Cloud" affix damage
[*]Nerfed "Poisoned" affix damage
[*]All burn, bleed, and poison effects applied by enemies have recived a maximum damage cap
[*]Spectral monsters are now immune to bleed effects
[/list]
[b]Loot:[/b]
[list]
[*]True Legendary items now have a range on their stats like other items instead, of rolling maxed values. This range is higher than that of regular Legendary items.
[*]Some enchant rolls made less wordy and more concise
[/list]
[b]Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bleed damage and effects are no longer considered Physical, and instead uses the "Ethereal" element, ignoring all resistances, but it will also be unaffected by your elemental bonuses
[*]"Ethereal Damage" (unlisted - from special items) is now an element that matches your highest elemental damage, and ignores all resistances of enemies
[/list]
[b]Minimap:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated minimap to have more easily distinguishable colors for walls in caves and some other areas
[*]Anomaly portals now visible on minimap
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed missing tiles in the Unstable Dimension and Challenge areas
[*]Fixed Unstable Dimension and Challenge area portals not closing properly in some cases
[*]Fixed Ironsoles make you immune to damage from all types of traps in chests
[*]Fixed Ironsoles making you immune to the damage from the Crumbling Reliquary
[*]Fixed some targeting issues where monsters would target traps
[*]Fixed difficulty setting not being properly saved
[*]Fixed unique monsters spawning repeatedly
[*]Fixed monster being able to throw spells over walls and summoning spells behind walls blocking their line of sight
[*]Fixed portals drawing their destination name on mouse over (redundant)
[*]Fixed issue with some "Frost Spear" based skills not properly calculating their chance to trigger perforation and similar effects
[*]Fixed a rare error related to the perforation calculation when done on "Frost Spear" skills cast just as the caster had died
[*]Fixed some tile errors with the "mystery garden" layout in Anomalies
[*]Fixed trees in Anomaly forest layouts not correctly changing colors
[*]Fixed summons (Infernal Demon, Tendrils of Death, Soul Replica), and item-granted companions/summons dying instantly in fights
[*]Fixed True Legendary items having affixes in their name (this was actually not intended for them, although the stats and enchants will still be rolled)
[*]Fixed secret buttons not doing anything in some cases
[*]Fixed Anomaly portals not highlighting on mouse over
[*]Fixed Warlock's skill "Combustion" not dealing enough damage
[*]Fixed several passives and buffs not adding the critical strike chance properly
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.54.0 - Endless Dungeon, New Loot, & More!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I recently asked on the forums if you'd rather see Act 4 or some endgame content next, and the majority wished for the endgame content. I did some planning and realised I could throw in some of it without delaying Act 4 - how great isn't that?

And as such, I present to you, the endless dungeon feature!
I'm calling them "Anomalies", it's basically a very random mix of detailing objects, setting, light, and monsters thrown together creating a small-medium sized "dungeons". Each level is different, and you can go as deep as you can survive, with each level adding some difficulty and reward!

I'll be expanding these with more locations and monsters as I add the next acts.. I will also add some more features to them! 

While I was at it, I also threw in a few items of a new endgame rarity... a little taste of what's to come!

Anyway, I've also fixed a ton of bugs - so a big thanks for reporting them to me!

That's it for now, enjoy!


[h1]Version 0.54.0[/h1]
[b]New Mechanic: Anomalies:[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlocked after finishing the current available content. Speak to Tinka!
[*]An infinite dungeon, each Anomaly Level gets harder, starting from Normal difficulty on Anomaly Level 1
[*]As the dungeon is automatically scaling in difficulty, it ignores the difficulty setting of the rest of the game, however each Anomaly Level adds some magic find, bonus experience, etc, scaling in a similar manner as difficulties
[*]Clear most of the level to spawn the portal to the next level. Every 3 levels will spawn a boss fight and extra rewards!
[*]Each level is randomized in look, layout, and spawns, meaning you can get for example elves and skeletons fighting you together in a cave.
[*]Delve as deep as you can... and claim massive riches!
[/list]
[b]Companions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Companions granted from skills can now be issued an attack command by targeting a foe and hitting the hotkey assigned to the companion
[*]Companions will no longer abort attacks to return to you
[*]Companions are now directly affected by your stat changes when determining their health and damage. This means that certain buffs, elixirs, and auras may benefit them, too.
[*]Note: health, damage, critrate, and damage elements are the only stats affecting the companions.
[*]Companions now benefit from your elemental bonuses
[/list]
[b]Difficulties:[/b]
[list]
[*]Slightly increased the gap between each difficulty setting
[*]Difficulty information is now less bloated.. and the monster bonus strengths are now hidden from the description
[*]The game now remembers your last played difficulty (per character) and will default to it in the difficulty selection screen
[/list]
[b]Loot & Items:[/b]
[list]
[*]Legendary 12-slot bags are now less rare
[*]Added a new item rarity for endgame items, found only on Legendary difficulty on level 100
[*]Some existing Legendary items have been buffed and moved to the new rarity
[*]Added 16 new Unique and Legendary items, and 6 new item sets
[*]Added 16 new items in the new rarity, and 2 sets for this rarity
[*]Slightly increased drop rates again, was accidentally too low
[*]Melee weapons no longer roll Knockback
[*]Resistance rolls has been slightly lowered
[*]Can now gamble the same items regardless of difficulty (the no Legendary until Veteran difficulty from the last update blocked this)
[*]Note: The new item rarity is NOT found through gambling
[/list]
[b]Sets:[/b]
[list]
[b]Added 8 new sets available for all classes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Thief's Gamble (2 piece)
[*]The Bond (2 piece)
[*]The Harvest (2 piece)
[*]Sun & Moon (2 piece)
[*]Summoner's Garb (4 piece)
[*]Furious Retaliation (4 piece)
[*]All For One (2 piece)
[*]One For All (2 piece)
[b]Updated old set:[/b]
[list]
[b][*]Seeker's Gambit: 3-part bonus now adds 50% MF instead of 20% MF
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[b]Templar:[/b]
[list]
[*]Titan: No longer adds cooldown reduction. (Too stronk)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Load times should be shorter and your average FPS should now be higher, especially in the larger areas (mostly noticable on laptops and low-end machines)
[/list]
[b]Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*]Health and Mana on hit scales differently now, larger hits and crits will still generate more, but it doesn't grow at a linear rate as it previously did
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Frozen affix monsters are less likely to slow you, and when they do they slow you for a lower amount
[*]Treant's roots now only grab you for 1 second at the most
[*]Lowered the volume of Pixie sounds slightly
[*]Resistance and stoneskin monsters now have a set resistance value, ignoring any base resistances, so certain combinations won't become near invulerable
[/list]
[b]Unstable Dimensions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Treasurers and Hoarders less common
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Players are now invulnerable during cutscens and during the fade in/out after loading/generating areas
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a killstreak timer bar
[*]Updated some keyboard key names to be shorter (less clutter on skill bar)
[*]Added a 4:3 low resolution option to the options. Note: 4:3 looks a bit weird currently, I will improve it with a future update
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed temp data being permanent for players with non-english windows logons
[*]Fixed monster and breakable spawns all happening at generation time (should be a major performance & load time boost for those having issues)
[*]Fixed issue where stacking buffs wouldn't be affected by Buff Duration stat
[*]Fixed the Vault spawning too few chests
[*]Fixed mathematical error that caused killstreaks to award very large amounts of experience after a certain point
[*]Fixed withdraw/deposit options appearing on equipment when using gamepad in the stashes
[*]Another attempt at fixing the HUD being cluttered with random stuff after loading 
[*]Fixed some items not being locked to classes that were intended to be that
[*]Fixed screenshakes not happening while setting was at 50% or below
[*]Fixed issue where many monsters had higher attack speed than intended
[*]Fixed issue where the entrance to The Living Barricade could spawn in an unreachable area
[*]Fixed some chain lightning effect triggers not playing any sound
[*]Fixed getting permanently slowed on occasion from certain skills
[*]Fixed Ribshot unique monster using melee attacks at range
[*]Fixed some text alignment problems causing some letters to be cut off at certain resolutions
[*]Fixed the poison orb satellite poisoning foes for a much longer time than intended
[*]Fixed damage over time effects keeping killstreaks active
[*]Fixed Maddoc and some other bosses permanently idling when player becoming invisible
[*]Fixed some issues causing monsters and companions to get stuck inside walls
[*]Fixed hotkey labels on the skill bar being drawn too low some times
[*]Fixed some spells granted through items calculating wrong skill level and damage output (too low on all counts)
[*]Fixed being able to lob spells over walls if you had a target behind the wall
[*]Fixed some incorrect skill tooltips & descriptions
[*]Fixed satellite orbs incorrectly triggering some on hit effects
[*]Fixed holy bolts animation not facing their direction of movement
[*]Fixed exiting an area just as something died causing them to respawn with 0 hp so they could be killed again upon re-entering the area
[*]Fixed issue with challenge portals not always appearing when using the scrolls
[*]Fixed companions spawning outside the map after entering a new area
[*]Fixed an issue which caused performance drops after long fights
[*]Fixed a performance drop in multiplayer
[*]Fixed skills displaying wrong damage calculations in multiplayer
[*]Fixed cooldowns being drawn incorrectly in multiplayer
[*]Fixed gambling prices for multiplayer (is now individual per player based on level)
[/list]

notes.notes:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/1/541907675755463252/

[h1]Version 0.53.0[/h1]
[b]Loot:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bags should now drop more frequently
[*]Reduced drop rates of consumables somewhat
[*]Tweaked drop rates of magical items - scaled too much with Magic Find & difficulty bonuses
[*]Unique and Legendary now start dropping on level 10
[*]Rings and Amulets now start dropping on level 10
[*]Rare items now start dropping on level 5
[*]**Note that exceptions to these drop rules apply to unique monster drops and quest rewards
[*]Dropping a stack of items no longer fills the entire screen with items, but only throws out a single one containing the full stack
[*]Keys are now more rare
[*]Challenge scrolls should drop more frequently
[*]Added 4 new unique items dropping from select unique monsters across the 3 acts
[*]Old ones have been updated with more interesting enchants or stronger enchants
[b]New item enchants:[/b]
[list]
[*]Phasewalk (Boots, allows walking through objects and monsters unhindered)
[*]Sludge (Boots, poison trail)
[*]Ironsole (Boots, immune to spike trap damage)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Stats:[/b]
[list]
[*]Health on hit and Mana on hit now restore more the larger the damage dealt compared to your based damage, so for example crits and hard hitting skills will restore much more

[/list]

[list]
[*]The item type and slot text is no longer in the same color as the item's quality, making it more distinct

[*]Added option to hide monster affixes

[/list]

[list]
[*]Lowered the amount of spike traps spawning by quite a bit
[*]Reduced the number of spiderlings spawning from eggs, and made them "pop" out a bit
[*]Reduced the number of spider eggs in The Old Tunnels, The Spider Cavern, and the Infested Cellar
[*]Added many new possible affixes for the Unstable Dimension area
[*]Unstable dimensions are now also more rare
[*]Update the Chronicon a little
[*]Added a new Personal Stash! This stash is directly tied to your character and has 50 slots
[*]Added 6 new bosses to the challenge areas
[*]Challenge area bosses are now much stronger!
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Unique monsters are now much more balanced with difficulties and levels
[*]Unique monsters are generally more dangerous and should be considered mini-bosses
[*]Tweaked health growth on some of the tankier enemies, making them less tanky on lower levels
[*]Reduced experience gained from minion & summoned monsters as it was disproportionate to regular monsters
[*]Some newer monsters had their experience values tweaked (for instance Gargoyles had it increased quite a bit)
[*]Monsters dropping the special challenge scrolls are now called "<name> The Challenger" to make it more clear
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tweaked controller vibrations, should now line up better with the amount of screenshake going on (less vibrations in general)
[*]Companions can now pick up money and mana/health pickups for you. They will not actively seek them out, but in case they get close to them they'll grab them. (They have the same pickup radius as you have)
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed static summons like the Tendrils of Death following the player into new locations
[*]Fixed the game getting stuck in gamepad mode if it had been unplugged between sessions
[*]Fixed Band of Nature dropping on level 20 instead of 30 (granted a level 30 skill)
[*]Fixed Templar's Condemnation passive not triggering 
[*]Fixed possible freeze from the Warlock's "Outbreak" skill
[*]Fixed possible freeze from breakable objects being hit by multiple attacks at the exact same frame
[*]Fixed issue where player could get stuck in an attack animation upon pausing
[*]Fixed not being able to purchase more stash tabs when using controller
[*]Fixed resistance stats being shown as being at 0 while they were in the negatives
[*]Fixed negative resistance not being properly calculated in damage calculations
[*]Fixed the trapdoor chest not opening, (for good this time I hope)
[*]*The chest should now also re-appear until you actually open it so you don't miss out in case it bugged out on you the first time
[*]Fixed rare issue where you could spawn outside the game world
[*]Fixed being able to click a path to move with click-to-move just as you died, causing your corpse to slide away
[*]Fixed rare issue with getting stuck in animation after being knocked away mid-attack
[*]Fixed being able to get stuck in walls/void if opening the inventory while character is walking with click-to-move
[*]Fixed chill effects not being applied properly
[*]Fixed quest "Vault Hunter" not indicating what zone it is in
[*]Fixed item sets not properly counting all parts in some cases
[*]Fixed achievement "Highscore" not triggering
[*]Fixed Berserker's "Dodge Roll" rolling towards enemies rather than cursor
[*]Fixed co-op players not being able to expand the stash
[*]Fixed charging monsters charging to your exact location rather than to where they would impact you
[*]Fixed items sometimes not stacking properly when buying / picking up
[*]Fixed old and new versions of the same item not stacking (eg potions)
[*]Fixed a lot of weird issues with all types of portals not being removed when they should, and being removed/not spawning when they shouldn't
[*]Fixed issues with scroll of challenge not popping portals
[*]Fixed item count on belt slots not showing correct ammounts
[*]Fixed an issue where monsters health would be properly re-calculated after leveling up
[*]Fixed issue where town portals put cooldown on your elixir of the mind instead of itself (whoops)
[*]Fixed melee skills being able to strike through walls
[*]Fixed a lot of incorrect spawns of secret area buttons
[*]Fixed loot tags disappearing if clicking one with full inventory
[*]Fixed Warden's "Overdraw" passive not triggering properly
[*]Fixed potions not being automatically rebound to the belt when a stack was emptied
[*]Fixed the belt not correctly finding and assigning a better stack of potions of you used the last one bound
[*]Fixed Templar's "Charge" skill hitting the same foe multiple times if they were immune to knockback (like bosses)
[*]Fixed Templar's "Charge" skill sometimes stopping her when it shouldn't
[*]Hitting esc while in the waypoint menu no longer opens inventory
[*]Possible fix for blank save files upon PC crash, let me know if you get this bug.. really need to fix that
[i]*I have a permanent fix for this ready, however it relies on functions broken for people with non-english windows logons, so I cannot deploy it yet as it would make these people unable to even save. Will be deployed ASAP.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.52.2 - Bugfixes all around!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Decided to throw in another bugfix, because why not?

Thanks for the reports, and keep them coming!


[h1]Version 0.52.2[/h1]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased range of most melee skills a bit
[*]Incresed the melee range of smaller monsters, so they are less likely to end up directly ontop of you, and making you miss them
[/list]
[b]Quests:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now finish quests to gather specific items even if you somehow lost the item after finding it (you just need to pick it up once)
[*]Monsters who drop items associated with quests will now drop the item so long as the quest isn't completed, even if you don't have the quest yet
[*]Keys and other items to be gathered for quests will now start any associated quest upon picking it up, if you don't already have it, and advance it to the correct state
[*](e.g. it should now be impossible to get stuck because you threw out a key or killed the carrier before getting the quest)
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed getting stuck after teleporting while being in an attack animation
[*]Fixed Berserker's pummel showing incorrect values
[*]Fixed Berserker's pummel also having an incorrect proc rate
[*]Fixed melee skills not properly hitting targets who are too close (you need to hover/target them and the spells will snap to them if they are within the max range)
[*]Fixed several issues with hitting large or flying enemies, especially from below 
[*]Fixed screenshake not working, and smoothened it a bit
[*]Fixed the Hidden Cellar trap not letting you out (I hope!)
[*]Fixed an issue with seed generation for act 3 areas, so your layouts may be different now
[*]Fixed the special statue in the courtyard sometimes not spawning
[*]Fixed enemy healing pylons healing the player sometimes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.51.0 - Stat tweaks, fixes, and a few new things
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I've fixed all the reported issues, and done a bit of tweaking with items and stats. With all the new equipment slots and increased number of stats rolls per items, it was possible to get some stats much higher than I had intended, so I've had to bring in some caps to them. Overall it brings a pretty sweet balance to things!

I will probably need to do a couple of these balance updates over the coming week to get it just right, so please report any imbalances you find to me!

As always, thanks for the error reports and suggestions! 
Keep 'em coming :)

[h1]Version 0.51.0[/h1]
[b]Stats & Enchants:[/b]
[list]
[*]Some stat values rolled on items have been tweaked, in particular to make a clear difference in the ranges between the item's rarity (though not for all stats)
[*]Elemental damage bonuses has been made slightly more rare, and more valuable (high gear score + sell/buy value)
[*]Some stat rolls have been removed from some items, as it would easily go beyond the caps:
[list]
[*]Buff Duration no longer rolls on Boots and Armors
[*]Cooldown Reduction no longer rolls on Armors
[*]Mana Reduction no longer rolls on Helmets
[/list]
[*]Enchants on items now have some caps added to them, since it is possible to roll the same enchant many times, certain enchants need a maximum to keep the balance:
[list]
[*]Cooldown Reduction caps at 25% per item
[*]Resist All Elements now caps at 25% per item
[*]Mana Cost Reduction caps at 30% per item
[*]Bonus Experience caps at 30% per item
[*]Buff Duration caps at 35% per item
[/list]
[*]Some stats needed caps on the player as well, to prevent problems:
[list]
[*][i]Note: these caps are applied after penalties from harder difficulties, so they are reachable on all settings, they also include all passive and aura skills[/i]
[*]Cooldown Reduction now caps at 99%
[*]Mana Cost Reduction now caps at 100%
[*]Knockback Chance caps at 100%
[*]All non-physical Resistances caps at 100%
[*]Physical Resistance caps at 70%
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Monsters:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a "poison trail" affix to the monster affix pool
[*]Added some new random names for many champion monsters
[*]Monster chill effects (such as the Frozen affix) will now also slow attack speed in addition to movement speed
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Warden's "Storm" tree renamed to "Winter"
[*]Maddoc's Cure now plays a sound when triggering
[*]Added an option to always show consumable items on "inspect nearby" regardless of your filters
[*]Quest Items are always shown on "inspect nearby"
[*]Added a strong vibration to gamepads when getting hurt below 30% hp (where the help callout triggers)
[*]Breakable objects can now sometimes spawn monsters (for now only zombies & slimelings)
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Abilities no longer get locked with too high cooldown reduction (caps at 99%)
[*]Buff duration stat is now properly applied 
[*]Fixed fatal error crash
[*]Fixed sattelite orbs disappearing when entering a new area or a portal
[*]Fixed Maddoc's Cure not triggering properly in some cases
[*]Fixed animation speeds of transformations
[*]Fixed "show full item inspect info" not updating properly when changed
[*]Fixed toggle "inspect nearby items" option getting stuck if disabled after it had been toggled
[*]Fixed some stat calcultions for monsters when loading an area
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.50.0 - Act 3, Inventory & Equipment Overhaul, & Much More!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's been a while since my last update, but oh man have I been busy!

This is the largest update I've ever done, and it features the whole new Act 3, and inventory and equipment overhaul, puzzles, almost 100 new items, many class changes, tons of balancing, progression & difficulty tweaks, and much, much more.

You can watch this little announcement video I've made:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wMjx38m-ezk

Or you can read the full notes here (long read!):
http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/368542585862397928/

As always, with updates of this magnitude there might be a few hiccups along the way, so please do report any bugs you find in this thread:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/368542585862409006/

I received an incredible amount of feedback for the last update, and I am so very grateful for it! Thank you!

I'll be actively monitoring the forums in case there are any problems surfacing!

[b]Here's some highlights of this update:[/b]

[list]
[*]Act 3 added to the game! Discover the mysterious Clairebourg Castle, and the madness within it...
[*]Crystal puzzles: Randomized crystal puzzles of varying difficulties now spawn in the game world.. solve them for great treasure!
[*]Itemization overhaul: Items roll enchants differently, over 30 new enchants added, affixes quadrupled, and much more!
[*]Expandable inventory and stash: Pick up bags to expand your inventory size, and purchase new rows of stash space!
[*]More equipment slots: Characters now have many more equipment slots, and special class items that provide unique bonuses!
[*]Revamped buff and debuff system: Stack up those poisons! your damage over time effects are now much more powerful, and buffs last through zones!
[*]Difficulties re-balanced: Harder difficulties are now much harder, but in return provide reward!
[/list]

Anyway, I hope you'll enjoy the new content!
Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Cause for persistent dungeons and unable to delete saves
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

With the help of a community member called Japooka, I have found the cause of a bug some of you have experienced. The bug where the dungeons won't reset and you can't delete or rename your characters.

It appears to be a problem with GameMaker: Studio (which I use to develop Chronicon) and non-ASCII characters in your username. That means that if you have a windows login username that uses letters that aren't in the English language, GameMaker: Studio won't be able to access and delete saved data. This is unfortunately out of my hands at the moment, but I will do what I can to solve this.

See the workarounds provided here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/458605613389351315/
to see what you can do meanwhile.

Again, I'm really sorry about this. Thank you for understanding.

notes.title: Update 0.43.0 - New skills, features, and fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Another update is here, and this time I've added 16 new passive skills (4 per class) and changed the skill tree layouts a bit, granting you some more interesting things earlier on. Some skills have also been changed, and you'll also find some new sound effects here and there!

I've also updated the sound system a little, adding a little extra effect to it! Your characters will now also comment on certain areas in the game, giving them a little character, so to speak.

Good luck :-)

notes.title: Update 0.42.0 - the largest small update yet
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I got a bit carried away with this update - so this is the largest small update I've ever released! I can't even fit the whole update notes in the announcement, so you can read them here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/541907675755502652/

With this update I've added a bunch of new areas to the existing chapters, many new accessory items, a few quests, and much more!

I've also done many changes to monsters, difficulty, many spells - and of course fixed a ton of issues. There's also a new menu option to reset your progress, should you want to do another clear of the game with your character. 

Leveling pace for new characters is also much faster until level 5, then it resumes as normal. Just so you get to that next skill tier fast :)

Some of the community suggestions I've added this time is: use left stick on gamepad to navigate menus etc, player level visible on HUD, more responsive movement, and able to hover the mouse over dropped items for some info (can be disabled).

As always, thanks for reporting all those pesky bugs to me - keep them coming and I'll keep squashing.

Anyway, I hope you enjoy this one!
I'm off to begin work on Act 3 :D

notes.title: Happy New Year! + Future plans
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It's been the most exciting year of my life, and this community has played a large part in making it so. I want to thank everyone for supporting me in chasing my dream to become a game developer, and wish you all a Happy New Year! 
Let's hope that the next one is just as exciting!


[H1]The Future[/h1]
Recently there has been a large amount of let's plays popping up on YouTube, and they're all excellent. Take a look:

https://www.youtube.com/results?search_sort=video_date_uploaded&filters=week&search_query=chronicon

Pretty awesome!

This has also brought many issues to my attention and as such, you can expect a [b]new update in a week or so[/b] which will make the lower levels a bit faster in pace and flesh out the early areas a bit. For example the rather massive Lower Temple Halls will receive a makeover and be less of a grind to get through!

You can also expect a bunch of new items.. this time I've given the accessories some love.

After that I shift my focus to the next major content update. That is, the much anticipated [b]act 3![/b] There will also be an [b]inventory and equipment revamp[/b] somewhere around this update. 

If any issues arise in the meantime I will be sure to fix them with small updates whenever possible, as I usually do!

After that, in no particular order, the following major items are on my list:
[list]
[*]Act 4
[*]Act 5
[*]Puzzles & traps
[*]Skill modifying system
[*]Improved questlog and quests
[*]Some form of additional/alternative gameplay to the story (secret things!)
[/list]

Along with maaaany smaller things. The future is bright! (And busy!)

Thank you again, and I'll see you next year.
-Daniel




[i]PS. Are you a [b]redditor?[/b] Be sure to check out the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Chronicon]official Chronicon subreddit![/url][/i]

notes.title: Update 0.41.0 - New loot!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Another small update is already ready! I've added a bunch of new items with strong elemental properties, so each class has at least 2 unique or better quality weapons per appropriate element they can use! While I was at it, I also updated over 30 existing items' sprites, and fixed a bunch of bugs.

Anyway, I hope you enjoy the new loot!


[h1]Update 0.41.0[/h1]
[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 19 new Unique and Legendary weapons with high elemental properties!
[*]These all drop from level 5 and upwards, granting some much needed weapon variations to the early game.
[b]Bows:[/b]
[list]
[*]Icewind
[*]Bolt
[*]Cael'is' Aim
[*]Hailstorm
[*]Thunderstorm
[*]Marruu's Rose
[/list]
[b]Fists:[/b]
[list]
[*]Flamers (old Flamers renamed to Arsonists)
[*]Floes
[*]Thunder Claps
[*]Icebergs
[/list]
[b]Staves:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shatterfrost
[*]Firebug's Rod
[*]Hellstaff
[*]Kennerth
[*]Bile Rod
[/list]
[b]Swords:[/b]
[list]
[*]Atlas (old Atlas renamed to Iapetus)
[*]Helios
[*]Jupiter
[*]Hallowed Blade
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated sprites of 30+ unique and legendary items
[*]Moved the closing walls in Altar of Ayeela down a little
[*]Bosses now drop holiday gifts, too! (and lots of them)
[*]Medella will now occasionally pull you closer
[*]Healer monsters only heal other monsters in their line of sight and within 10 meters now, rather than all on the screen
[*]The random heal effect from shrines now have a visual effect and heals companions as well
[*]The Treasury no longer consumes the key as you open it
[*]The player now gives a hint when interacting with the Altar in Upper Temple Halls
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed character sometimes getting stuck after a cutscene
[*]Fixed Medella not spawning if you hugged the walls in her chamber
[*]Fixed companions being locked out from the large boss fights
[*]Fixed some skills not destroying breakable objects
[*]Fixed Medella targeting herself and casting spells to the right when you had companions
[*]Fixed Medella aiming bad with her blood bolts
[*]Fixed weird things happening with click to move sometimes when a cutscene starts
[*]Fixed shrines spawning monsters inside walls
[/list]

notes.title: Holiday event update
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I've updated the game with a small holiday event - monsters will now drop gifts! The gifts come in all rarities, and the more rare the gift, the higher  chances of good loot! 

I also fixed a few bugs, and I am still working on some others that you've reported to me.

Also, if you experience the bug where the game areas won't reset between sessions, please try running both the game and Steam as an Administrator and let me know if that fixes it for you!

Anyway.. have fun hunting down the gifts!

[h1]Update 0.40.1[/h1]
[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added holiday gifts! Monsters will drop these randomly, open them for loot!
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tome of Knowledge now rolls a powerful bonus experience enchant
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Warden's area-of-effect arrow skills striking twice
[*]Those skills now also work properly with the Overdraw passive ability
[*]Fixed rare crash when gambling on a low level character
[*]Fixed some item minimum drop levels being way too high, and a few class set ones being too low, but lower level characters should see more variation in unique and legendary drops than before
[/list]

notes.title: Major Content Update #2 - The Skill Overhaul!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

After many weeks, the skill overhaul is finally done!
I think you're gonna like this one. 

[i]([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/541907675755502652/]Update notes here[/url])[/i]

With this update, the total number of skills available is just over [u]200[/u]!
This is a massive increase from the previous 60. Now each class has around 50 skills each!

Here's a little gif of the Warlock's new skill trees:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/lFi1r1n.gif[/img]
[i]Four trees per class, each tree focusing on an element. Pretty neat huh?[/i]

I've also added a whole 8 new legendary sets, and changed the previous ones a little to better fit the new skills. Along with all the new stuff comes a lot of balancing to loot drop rates and monster health. Legendary items are pretty hard to find, but higher difficulties increase your chance to find them much more now... especially from Champion monsters! 

That being said, higher difficulties should generally be more difficult now. The update information in-game on the difficulty select screen should help you pick something that fits you!

There's also some new sound effects, updated visual effects, and a ton of bug fixes!



With this update I have also added many community suggestions. Some notable ones would be character name change, more gamepad options, better item inspection features, and the ability to re-bind all skill slots. No more useless default attacks on high levels!

As always, there's a new [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/494632768634504212/]bug report thread[/url] for this version. I've tried to squash as many as I could find, but with an update of this magnitude there's always something.

I also want to thank the people who took part in the public test builds that I've written so many announcements about lately. You guys helped me [i]so much[/i], and I am very thankful. [b]Thank you![/b]

The full update notes are [i]too big[/i] to fit in this announcement, that's just crazy! You can read all the changes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/0/541907675755502652/]in this thread instead[/url].


I hope you enjoy the new stuff!
Happy holidays!

notes.title: Skill Overhaul Update #7 - New items and balancing! (final test update)
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

The final test build update is ready!
Next week it will go live as the next major content update! Woot!

This update adds a lot of new items, specifically the new sets for the new skill trees! There's also a lot of balancing for the difficulties, skill mana costs, equipment and character mana levels and regeneration, and drop rates of high quality items.

A lot of new options for controllers have also been added.

I've added a "general feedback" thread on the test forum if you have any thoughts, here: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/2/494632506579788213/]General Feedback[/url].

Let me know if you have any problems and I'll get right on it!
Thanks!

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added possibilty to click on the item name tags to pick them up when using the "inspect all" feature. With click to move your character will walk towards it, otherwise you still have ot be pretty close to it on the ground.
[*]Added options for the "inspect all" feature, can now toggle the minimum quality to find and if it should ignore items locked to other classes (gameplay options menu)
[*]Added a key binding for forced attacks when using click to move (eg hold this key [default Shift] to force attacks when clicking)
[*]Added experimental support for odd aspect ratios and ultra-wide screens
[*]Added the following options for gamepads:
[list]
[*]Vibration strength
[*]Left stick sensitivity
[*]Right stick sensitivity
[*]Aim in walking direction (single stick usage)
[*]Smooth walking (walking speed depending on how far you pull stick)
[/list]
[*]Added 32 new legendary items fitted in 8 new item sets!
[b]Berserker:[/b]
[list]
[*]Punisher's Tools (lightning - helm, armor, weapon, accessory)
[*]Power of the Frostborn (frost - helm, armor, weapon, accessory)
[/list]
[b]Templar:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cain's Battlegear (fire - helm, armor, weapon, accessory)
[*]Titan's Armor (physical - helm, armor, weapon, accessory)
[/list]
[b]Warden:[/b]
[list]
[*]Nature's Vengeance (poison - helm, armor, weapon, accessory)
[*]Winter's Touch (frost - helm, armor, weapon, accessory)
[/list]
[b]Warlock:[/b]
[list]
[*]Corruptor's Plague (poison - helm, armor, weapon, accessory)
[*]Death's Embrace (shadow - helm, armor, weapon, accessory)
[/list][/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]"Inspect all" tags now highlights on mouseover, and the lines are a bit more clear
[*]Many legendary and unique items have had their class restrictions removed
[*]Some base helmets such as hoods have had their class restrictions removed
[*]Potions drop much less frequently from regular monsters
[*]Class restricted items no longer roll elemental damage to unused elements of that class
[*]Reduced drop rate of Unique and Legendary items from regular monsters by a lot, but increased the bonus rate granted from champion and elite kills
[*]For example champions now have 200% + 30% * affixes bonus drop rate, added to the players magic finding rate.
[*]Bosses and chests have a much higher rate of dropping high quality items now
[*]The most rare chests no longer require keys to open
[*]Removed the extra elemental resistances granted on high difficulties for enemies, but instead increased their health by a lot!
[*]Also increased the bonus magic and crystal finding rates on high difficulties
[*]Updated difficulty screen information with detailed information
[*]Updated burn and poison particles
[*]Reduced the mana stat rolled on items
[*]Reduced mana gained from mana potions
[*]Improved visuals of ground burning effects such as the effect left from Molten Shield
[*]Spiders and Beholders now have different colored blood and gibs
[*]Monster multiplayer health bonus increased to 50% per player, up from 30% per player
[*]The Berserkers default attack is once again a double jab
[*]Updated the requirements for some stat-based achievements (eg +magic find achievement ignores the difficulty bonus)
[/list]
[b]Spells:[/b]
[list]
[*]Mana cost of most skills has been increased, ultimates reduced
[*]Note; maximum mana cost means the mana cost on level 100. Mana costs levels 1-100 is calculated based of a minimum and maximum value, higher max means higher on each level.
[b]Templar:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shield Dance maximum mana cost increased to 300 (up from 250)
[*]Sword Dance & Magnetic Orbs maximum mana cost increased to 750 (up from 500)
[*]Repulse maximum mana cost increased to 350 (up from 200)
[*]Blessing maximum mana cost increased to 500 (up from 400)
[*]Holy Light & Star Fall maximum mana cost reduced to 800 (down from 1000)
[*]Holy Fire damage per rank nerfed to 10% (down from 15%)
[/list]
[b]Berserker:[/b]
[list]
[*]Jawbreaker, Arc Punch, Slam maximum mana cost increased to 400 (up from 300)
[*]Leap, Explosive Punch, maximum mana cost increased to 700 (up from 400)
[*]Glacial Roll maximum mana cost increased to 650 (up from 400)
[*]Thunder Punch maximum mana cost increased to 600 (up from 300)
[*]Thunderstomp, Flamewrath, & Shattering Blow maximum mana cost increased to 750 (up from 600, 500, & 500)
[/list]
[b]Warden:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tumble maximum mana cost increased to 250 (up from 200)
[*]Arrow Hail, Acid Rain, Thunderstorm, & Hailstorm   maximum mana cost increased to 750 (up from 500)
[*]Ball Lightning maximum mana cost increased to 550 (up from 500)
[*]Frost Bomb maximum mana cost increased to 600 (up from 350)
[/list]
[b]Warlock:[/b]
[list]
[*]Poison Nova, Hellfire, maximum mana cost increased to 600 (up from 400)
[*]Pool of Corruption, Comet, Inferno, & Tendrils of Death maximum mana cost increased to 750 (up from 400)
[*]Frost Nova maximum mana cost increased to 450 (up from 400)
[*]Blizzard maximum mana cost increased to 600 (up from 400)
[*]Poison Skull now has more feedback upon exploding
[*]Occult Rituals now drains more health
[*]Hellfire damage nerfed (110% base, +5% per level - down from 130% base, +10% per level)
[/list]
[b]All:[/b]
[list]
[*]All Ultimates has had their mana cost reduced to 1500 (down from 3000)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed "inspect all" tags overlapping or having extra space around them depending on settings
[*]Fixed crash on monsters using certain spells
[*]Fixed crash on using Infernal Demon in combination with Hellstone Amulet
[*]Fixed using gamepad and summoning/casting spells outside of the view, they should now land just on the edge of it
[*]Fixed the delay when using berserker skills "Icicles" and "Thunder Stomp"
[*]Fixed "Lightning Jab", "Blazing Fists", and "Frozen Fists" dealing physical damage instead of their intended element
[*]Fixed chests spawning in front of entrances in forest areas
[*]Fixed Spider Cavern potentially generating unreachable areas
[*]Fixed bug where belts weren't properly updated and would sometimes bind non-bindable items such as equipment to belt slots
[*]Possible fix for people experiencing a fully persistent game world across saves
[*]Fixed HUD not being updated after swapping gamepad / keyboard controls in-game
[*]Fixed HUD sometimes not being updated after performing changes to belt slots in the inventory
[/list]

[*]Bosses and chests have a much higher rate of dropping high quality items now
[*]The most rare chests no longer require keys to open

[*]Updated burn and poison particles

[*]Reduced mana gained from mana potions

[*]Spiders and Beholders now have different colored blood and gibs
[*]Monster multiplayer health bonus increased to 50% per player, up from 30% per player
[*]The Berserkers default attack is once again a double jab
[*]Updated the requirements for some stat-based achievements (eg +magic find achievement ignores the difficulty bonus)

[list]

[*]Sword Dance & Magnetic Orbs maximum mana cost increased to 750 (up from 500)
[*]Repulse maximum mana cost increased to 350 (up from 200)
[*]Blessing maximum mana cost increased to 500 (up from 400)
[*]Holy Light & Star Fall maximum mana cost reduced to 800 (down from 1000)
[*]Holy Fire damage per rank nerfed to 10% (down from 15%)

[*]Leap, Explosive Punch, maximum mana cost increased to 700 (up from 400)
[*]Glacial Roll maximum mana cost increased to 650 (up from 400)
[*]Thunder Punch maximum mana cost increased to 600 (up from 300)
[*]Thunderstomp, Flamewrath, & Shattering Blow maximum mana cost increased to 750 (up from 600, 500, & 500)
[/list]
[b]Warden:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tumble maximum mana cost increased to 250 (up from 200)
[*]Arrow Hail, Acid Rain, Thunderstorm, & Hailstorm   maximum mana cost increased to 750 (up from 500)
[*]Ball Lightning maximum mana cost increased to 550 (up from 500)
[*]Frost Bomb maximum mana cost increased to 600 (up from 350)
[/list]
[b]Warlock:[/b]
[list]
[*]Poison Nova, Hellfire, maximum mana cost increased to 600 (up from 400)
[*]Pool of Corruption, Comet, Inferno, & Tendrils of Death maximum mana cost increased to 750 (up from 400)
[*]Frost Nova maximum mana cost increased to 450 (up from 400)
[*]Blizzard maximum mana cost increased to 600 (up from 400)

[*]Fixed crash on monsters using certain spells

notes.title: Skill Overhaul Update #5 - Warden changes & fixes, new skill slot
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I've made some changes for the Warden, fixed a few things, and added a new skill slot! This should make auras feel more worth your while as you won't have to sacrifice as much to use them now. I have also updated the existing set items for the Warden, they should be very useful (and powerful!) now.

Loving the enthusiasm and feedback, guys, keep it up!

[b]Note: This is for the Public Test builds which you can read more about here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/2/496880503071153159/ [/b]

Here's a full list of changes: 

[h1]Skill Overhaul Update #5:[/h1]
[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a 6th skill slot! Let me know how it feels. Default keybinding is [4] for keyboard, and (X) for gamepad
[*]Added a new Warden skill "Barkskin" that increases resistances
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Skills are now available at levels 1/5/10/20/30/40 (down from 1/5/15/25/35/50)
[b]Warden Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tumble: Cooldown increased to 5 seconds (up from 3)
[*]Overdraw: proc rate improved to 3/6/9/12/15 (up from 2/4/6/8/10)
[*]Multishot: damage per rank nerfed to 5% (down from 10%)
[*]Treant: base health reduced a little and health per rank nerfed to 15% (down from 20%) - but total max health is now higher due to more skill points
[*]Pixie: damage per rank nerfed to 1% (down from 2%) and based damage reduced by 5%
[*]Spiderling: damage per rank nerfed to 3% (down from 6%) - moved from tier 4 to tier 5 skills to make room for Barkskin (new skill)
[*]Alpha Wolf: base health reduced a little and health per rank nerfed to 5% (down from 10%), damage per rank increased to 4% (up from 3%)
[*]Companion skills (Treant, Pixie, Spiderlings, Alpha Wolf): Now have 10 ranks instead of 5
[*]Winter Storm: No longer requires a point in Frost Arrow
[*]Spores: Increased proc rate to 6/9/12/15/18% (up from 4/6/8/10/12)
[*]Roots: Increased range to 3.5 meters (up from 2.5)
[*]Eye of The Storm: Now causes players underneath Thunderstorm to cast Chain Lightning repeatedly
[*]Arrow Hail, Thunderstorm, and Hailstorm: Fixed being placed over player rather than cursor
[*]Poison Vial: Now behaves correctly and cannot be thrown over walls (but over pillars)
[/list]
[b]Templar Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Holy Fire: Added new visual effect. Fixed range being too short.
[/list]
[b]Warden items:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Stormcaller and Sharpshooter sets have been updated to fit the new skills
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Spiderlings having massive hitboxes
[*]Fixed Pixies having too small hitboxes 
[*]Fixed crash on summoning the Berserker's Hyenas
[*]Fixed transparency issues with inventory and skill tree menus
[*]Fixed binding skils to LMB removing cooldowns
[*]Fixed some timing issues with very high attack speeds
[*]Fixed some skill description typos and lengths
[*]Fixed some passive skills granting their base effect even while at rank 0
[/list]

notes.title: Skill Overhaul Update #4 - The Warden
notes.notes:
Hey Guys!

The Warden is finally ready for testing!
Sorry about the delay.

Not only does the update add the Warden's new skills, but also a few more options, some visual upgrades, and a ton of fixes!

Like with the other classes, I've added a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/2/492378806378921746/]new thread[/url] on the public test forums for the discussion and feedback on the new skill trees, and I hope to hear from you there!

I've also created a [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Chronicon/]subreddit[/url] for Chronicon, so if you're on Reddit, stop by and say hello!

Enjoy :)

[b]Note: This is for the Public Test builds which you can read more about here: [/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/2/496880503071153159/ 

Here's a full list of changes: 


[h1]Skill Overhaul Update #4[/h1]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the Warden skills!
[*]Can now change names of characters from the Load screen
[*]Added a basic system for "hit effects", eg an enemy taking lightning damage will appear electrocuted for a short duration. Only works for electric damage currently
[*]Added new interface options to disable damage over time numbers and/or only show critical hits
[*]Added sound effect for spike traps
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]New aura visuals
[*]New chill & poison visual effect
[*]Test build characters now get 99x Elixir of the Mind for fast and easy skill changes
[*]The base attacks for each skill tree now informs you that they can be used as a substitute for default attacks
[*]Improved pathfinding for companions when they follow you
[*]Damage number colors are now based on the element of the attack. Players getting hurt is still in red for clarity (may change)
[*]Poison damage over time effect and bleed effect now ticks 4 times per second
[*]Burn damage over time effects now ticks 6 times per second
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed numbers being presented with decimals where unnecessary (eg 10.0 is now just 10)
[*]Fixed some skill descriptions saying "you" instead of "the <class>" etc.
[*]Fixed issue with spell cooldown calculation (was in some cases much shorter than intended)
[*]Fixed most damage over time time effects dealing too much damage, they were doing the intended total damage each second instead for the entire duration
[*]Fixed issue with targeting not finding the correct position to place spells
[*]Fixed buffs and debuffs being removed before performing their last planned "tick"
[*]Fixed monster "Blizzard" spell incorrectly drawing the icicles
[*]Fixed notices like "immune" not popping up
[*]Fixed issue with immobilize effects not fully immobilizing foes
[*]Fixed skills not being properly performed even if animation plays when having very fast attack speed
[*]Fixed Berserker skills Dodge Roll and Arctic Roll not working correctly with gamepad
[*]Fixed not being to properly navigate the skill trees for Berserker & Warden with gamepad
[*]Fixed critical hit damage being incorrectly calculated in some cases
[/list]

notes.title: Public Test Update #3 - The Berserker!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

It took a bit longer than expected, but he's finally playable!
This update adds the Berserker's new skills, and changes and fixes many other things! Just like with the Templar, you can instantly level up to 100 and try all his skills out. I hope you like it!

I've added a new thread on the public test forums for the discussion and feedback on the new skill trees, I hope to hear from you there!

[b]Note: This is for the Public Test builds which you can read more about here:[/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/2/496880503071153159/ 

Here's a full list of changes:

[h1]Public Test Update #3[/h1]
[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Berserker skill trees added!
[*]Made it possible for effects to be triggered from critical hits (eg "chance on crit to do X")
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[b]Templar Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Many passives have been moved to be available at level 1 to make them more accessible for all types of builds
[*]Justice tree: "Tank" is now available at level 1. Shield Maiden moved to level 25 (from 15)
[*]Vengeance tree: "Critical Charge" is now available at level 1.
[*]Conviction tree: "Warmth" and "Taunt" are now available at level 1. "Retribution" moved to level 15. "Overheat" Fire damage bonus increased to match that of "Jolt"
[*]Avatar of Caine: Removed mana cost reduction but now has a 50% chance to cause explosions upon scoring critical hits!
[*]All ultimates now have a 20 second duration instead of 15.
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated some fonts for readability
[*]Players can now become gibbed like monsters
[*]Damage over time effects, thorns, and some other effects no longer cause gibbing
[*]Changed color of Physical damage "element" text and skill outline
[*]Damage over time effects no longer play sounds until I get some more subtle elemental sounds for this purpose (got super annoying with frost skills for example)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Templar skill "Critical Charge" not giving correct amount of critical hit chance
[*]Fixed critical hit damage on items granting 100x the listed amount (whoops)
[*]Fixed Avatar of Caine benefiting from bonus buff duration stat twice, and having too low base duration
[*]Fixed Avatar of Ayeela and Titan animations ending sooner than intended with extended buff duration
[*]Fixed cooldowns and mana costs not being correctly calculated on skill tree information and the skill bar
[*]Fixed error sound playing if clicking a "slot" where there is no skill in the skill tree
[*]Fixed some skill references not being highlighted in skill descriptions (should now be green)
[*]Fixed description on Avatar of Ayeela being too long
[*]Fixed descriptions of ultimates not including durations
[*]Fixed stat comparison values sometimes being drawn without parentheses or without + and - signs
[*]Critical hits are now properly calculated BEFORE applying effects like burns and such, making the damage scale correctly
[*]Can now only actually only equip one Ultimate skill as the description says
[*]Skill reset elixir now properly plays potion drinking sound when used
[/list]

See you on the forums!

[*]Conviction tree: "Warmth" and "Taunt" are now available at level 1. "Retribution" moved to level 15. "Overheat" Fire damage bonus increased to match that of "Jolt"
[*]Avatar of Caine: Removed mana cost reduction but now has a 50% chance to cause explosions upon scoring critical hits!
[*]All ultimates now have a 20 second duration instead of 15.
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated some fonts for readability
[*]Players can now become gibbed like monsters
[*]Damage over time effects, thorns, and some other effects no longer cause gibbing
[*]Changed color of Physical damage "element" text and skill outline
[*]Damage over time effects no longer play sounds until I get some more subtle elemental sounds for this purpose (got super annoying with frost skills for example)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Templar skill "Critical Charge" not giving correct amount of critical hit chance
[*]Fixed critical hit damage on items granting 100x the listed amount (whoops)
[*]Fixed Avatar of Caine benefiting from bonus buff duration stat twice, and having too low base duration
[*]Fixed Avatar of Ayeela and Titan animations ending sooner than intended with extended buff duration
[*]Fixed cooldowns and mana costs not being correctly calculated on skill tree information and the skill bar
[*]Fixed error sound playing if clicking a "slot" where there is no skill in the skill tree
[*]Fixed some skill references not being highlighted in skill descriptions (should now be green)
[*]Fixed description on Avatar of Ayeela being too long
[*]Fixed descriptions of ultimates not including durations
[*]Fixed stat comparison values sometimes being drawn without parentheses or without + and - signs
[*]Critical hits are now properly calculated BEFORE applying effects like burns and such, making the damage scale correctly
[*]Can now only actually only equip one Ultimate skill as the description says
[*]Skill reset elixir now properly plays potion drinking sound when used
[/list]

See you on the forums!

notes.title: Public Test Update #2
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

I've fixed the reported issues and done a bit of balancing and tweaked a bunch of skills. I've also added a new skill for the Templar! Not to mention Gamepad support is back in for the skill trees so it works in multiplayer :)

[b]Note: This is for the Public Test builds which you can read more about here:[/b] http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/2/496880503071153159/

Here's a full list of changes!


[h1]Public Test Update #2[/h1]
[b]Templar Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new Justice skill: Shield Dance: Lowers physical damage taken by 50% for 5 seconds.
[*]Repulse: Increased cooldown of skill but now also deals 100% damage as lightning to all nearby.
[*]Magnetic Orbs: Increased cooldown to 35 seconds (up from 30) as it lasts for a while. No longer pulls monsters (too stronk) and orbits the player at a closer range (so you cannot push them through walls to attack enemies behind)
[*]Avatar of Caine: Now also reduces mana cost of all skills by 50%.
[*]Avatar of Ayeela: Will actually cast the Blessing spell on hit instead of just applying the effect, so it now benefits from the Consecration passive ability. Now also reduces mana cost of all skills by 50%.
[*]Titan: Now also reduces the cooldown of all skills by 50%.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Retribution: Fixed skill listing a mana usage and cooldown, even though its passive.
[*]Smite: Fixed typo.
[*]Should not be able to earn Achievements now.
[*]Stats are no longer pushed to steam while in the test build(s) (because it would activate a load of Achievements when exiting testmode)
[*]Fixed killstreak "Carnage" effect fireballs not moving
[*]Fixed potential crash on fighting certain enemies which were using old (and removed) skill data
[*]Fixed some general "chance to cast X" legendary items casting incorrect spells or just doing plain weird stuff
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added gamepad support for the new skill trees!
[*]Updated keybindings menu text to reflect how skills now can be bound to any slot
[/list]

notes.title: Experimental test builds now available!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

As you may know I've been busy working with the skill tree overhaul. It's been taking a very long time, but from now on things should speed up a bit, as I've got the first class ready for testing right now!

First out is the Templar, and I've given her a massive 48 skills! Some of the old have been reworked and some have been removed entirely. So there's 30-something completely new skills!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/LN0SjoX.gif[/img]

I will be releasing the characters new skills in a set of update in a separate channel, as it will render the non-updated characters unplayable for the duration, and I don't want to mess up anyone's save files!

[h1]Here's how you access the test builds:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Locate Chronicon in your Steam Library.
[*]Right-click it and select Properties.
[*]Select the "BETAS" tab.
[*]Select the "public_testing" option from the drop-down list.
[*]If you cannot see the "public_testing" option, restart Steam (I had to do it myself)
[*]Click close and wait for Steam to update the game!
[/list]

[h1]Now, there are some things to keep in mind for this test build..[/h1]
[list]
[*]The Templar's new skills have all been added, although note that many are missing proper animations and effects at this point!
[*]Some Templar Unique & Legendary (and set) items have been redesigned to fit the new skills. More to come!
[*]Some Templar Unique & Legendary items have had their effects temporarily removed as they have become obsolete, and will have new ones added later
[*]You cannot earn achievements
[*]You cannot load old saves, test builds uses a separate save data
[*]You will be granted an item that levels you to level 100 for quick testing
[*]Gamepad DOES NOT current work with the skill trees in this build (will do so very soon, though!)
[/list]


I have opened a separate sub forum for these builds, with a separate bugtracking thread and a discussion thread for the Templar! These builds are mainly intended for feedback and to give players a chance to shape the final outcome, so please try it out and join the discussion here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/375480/discussions/2/

See you on the forums!

notes.title: Halloween greetings and an update from the dev!
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween, everyone!

I figured I'd take some time to tell you all what's going on and what my plans are, so keep on reading to stay up to date!


[h1]Skill Tree Overhaul[/h1]
I'm currently working on a complete skill tree overhaul for all classes! It's coming along nicely but it takes a lot of time to get it right, as each class will have 40-something skills available, up from the previous 15. That's a lot of skills!

Here's a sneak peek at the current setup for the Templar class!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Wj8D8hs.gif[/img]

[b]When?[/b]
I will be rolling out this update slowly and in several parts, because it is so big and there are so many things to balance and get right. So I will be releasing one class at a time, the Templar being available sometime next week!

[b]How?[/b]
As it's an entire new system for dealing with skills, including all enemy skills, I will be making a separate branch so these updates are optional until they are 100% complete. This way it won't mess up anyone's gaming experience. I will provide a guide on how to opt in for these updates when I release the first one. So keep an eye out for that announcement!

These "preview" updates will be mostly technical, so there will be missing animations, icons, and spell effects. Simply because I will be changing things around a lot before it'll be done!

I will also be setting up a separate sub-forum where we can discuss the changes and you guys can leave feedback if you want!



[h1]The Community[/h1]
The community is growing and there is more and more activity, which makes me very happy to see! 

If you're playing a Warlock (or maybe thinking of playing one) you should check out this guide by Ciaren!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=541769822

Anyway, that's all for now. 
Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Update 0.33.0 - Crash fixes, quality of life improvements, polishing
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Another update is available - this time I've focused on adding many of the recent suggestions, polishing and tweaking many existing mechanics, and of course fixing all reported bugs!

You've done a great job reporting bugs to me, as always!
Keep it up and Chronicon will be a polished gem :-)


[b]What's next?[/b]
After this update I will focus on the next Major Content Patch.
I will fix any bugs reported with small updates, but beyond that it will be a little quiet for a while, as these large updates take a little longer!

[b]Friend Requests[/b]
I've been getting an increasing number of friend requests lately, so I feel this needs to be addressed. I do not accept any friend requests simply because I do not use the chat, which I guess would be the reason to add me. I only log in via the browser to check on forums and such! So if you've been declined, I hope you will not be offended.

If you want to get in touch with me, you can always tweet at me @sqrbt, write on the forums, or pop me an email at contact@subworldgames.com and I'll get back to you ASAP!

However, if people are hanging out in the community group chat, I might just join in for a bit!

Anyway, here are the notes for this update!

[h1]Version 0.33.0[/h1]

[b]Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*]Attempting to perform a skill while out of mana now defaults to the standard attack instead (LMB), rather than no action or a forced movement using click to move
[*]Defensive (RMB) abilities like the Warden's Tumble or Berserker's Dodge Roll now takes priority over other skills and will interrupt those, so that you can quickly get away from hectic situations
[*]Monsters will be dropped from sticky target if they move outside of the view
[*]Corpses and dying enemies are now collision free
[*]Most projectiles (ice shards, arrows, etc) now stick to walls for a short while instead of instantly disappearing
[*]Companions respawn faster
[*]Companions who fall behind and out of view either by being engaged in combat or for some reason getting stuck, will now teleport back to the player
[*]Companions will now attempt to destroy any objects blocking their path when returning/following the player, so they are less likely to get stuck
[/list]
[b]Interface & Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now toggle healthbars over your companions and yourself, check the Video & Interface options for the setting
[*]Added new, better looking healthbars in the same style as the GUI ones
[*]You can now unbind skills from the skill tree
[*]You can now hit "Esc" to back all menus (changes to options are saved)
[*]Added many new windowed resolution options for both 16:9 and 16:10
[*]Added a fade in effect to menu
[/list]
[b]Templar:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cast speed of "Shield Throw" increased somewhat
[/list]
[b]World:[/b]
[list]
[*]All chests now drop crystals (rare chests drop more)
[*]Shimmering chests has a new cool opening effect
[*]Waypoints in most boss areas now spawn slightly to the sides to not block movement routes and interfere with click to move
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Picking up an item of Unique or higher quality will save your character (just in case, since there have been some instability lately, I'd hate to see you lose progress)
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed potential crash on meteor spells
[*]Fixed elite and champions that had the "minion" affix, after having it removed, putting their new affixes in the wrong order and therefore getting the wrong name rolled
[*]Fixed "bomber" spell projectiles not moving and just bouncing on the monster
[*]Fixed typo in "Seeker's Gambit" set bonus
[*]Fixed unique item "Bat Bat" having super slow attack speed and granting you some negative 2 billion damage..
[*]Fixed being able to get knocked into walls while using click to move
[*]Fixed weird menu issues with 16:10 and 4:3 aspect ratios
[*]Fixed Warden's Wolves taking very long to respawn
[*]Fixed Warden's Wolves doing too much damage
[*]Fixed Warden's Wolves having too long range on their pull effect (10x intended range)
[*]Fixed Warden's Wolves spawning with a very fast animation speed 
[*]Fixed issue with player aim locking to the right
[*]Fixed issue with player twitching and being unable to move in some cases when using click to move
[*]Fixed returning companions getting stuck by repeatedly both trying to chase a nearby target and returning to the player
[*]Fixed the delay in minimap getting refreshed when entering an area sometimes causing graphical errors (especially on Intel cards)
[*]Fixed click to move causing the player to "rubberband" back and forth in some rare cases
[*]Fixed rare crash on click to move where the character would mistake itself for an item and attempt to put itself in the inventory (silly huh)
[*]Possibly fixed the game potentially eating your character in the same situation as above
[*]Knockback now properly cancels movement while using click to move
[*]Can now correctly perform Tumble and Dodge mid-walking using click to move as you can using WASD/gamepad
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.32.0 is out! A ton of bugfixes, more options, and some general tweaks!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

So I was originally planning on adding some more stuff before I released this one, but a lot of bugs were reported so I really needed to address that first! This is mostly a bug fix update, but it has a few new options in the options menu, such as vsync and screenshake intensity controls.

I also made companions a lot easier to deal with, making them match your movement speed and ignore collisions with you so they won't block you anymore. Some general improvements, basically!

There has been a lot of new people on the forums lately so a big welcome to you all! I also expect a wave of new players coming over from Project Patch very soon, so let's make sure they feel welcome :)

As always, you've done a great job reporting bugs!
Hopefully there won't be so much to report this time around..
Keep it up guys!


[h1]Version 0.32.0[/h1]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Extra Ambient Light setting now has a greater effect so you might need to tweak that after updating (in Video & Interface options)
[*]Added a Vsync option in the Video & Interface options
[*]Added a Camera Smoothing option to the Video & Interface options (it is enabled by default - disable it if you experience stuttering with "click to move")
[*]Added a Screenshake Intensity option in the Gameplay options
[*]Added a new menu background
[*]Added dark boxes behind text in the options and help menus to make it easier to read
[*]Medella animates her teleport spells faster
[*]Changed lighting of Shrine of Ayeela to something more subtle that won't take colors away from Medella
[*]Removed the feature that puts random screenshoots as menu background
[*]Minimap scale now scales more freely (20% per tick rather than a full 100%)
[*]Players no longer collide with their companions and vice versa
[*]Companions now match your movement speed so they don't fall behind as easily
[*]Scroll of Challenge is now an Unique quality item so it's much easier to spot when dropped, and the droprate has been increased slightly
[*]Picking up quest items related to an unobtained quest should now start that quest
[*]Click to move controls updated to be more smooth
[*]In-game update notes now list the more recent on top, and also has a scroll bar cause the list got too big
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed crash on hitting Esc while in certain sections of the pause menu
